===== FILE: src\dllmain.rs =====
//! `dllmain.cpp`. The Windows DLL entry point plus the init thread
//! that runs every filesystem / module-load / detour operation.
//!
//! Everything that touches the loader (LoadLibraryW), the registry,
//! or the filesystem runs on a worker thread. `DllMain` itself only
//! does `DisableThreadLibraryCalls` and dispatches to that worker, so
//! no work happens under the loader lock.

#![allow(dead_code)]

use std::ffi::c_void;
use std::path::Path;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicPtr, Ordering};
use std::sync::OnceLock;

use crate::platform::dynamic_library::{self, ModuleHandle};
use crate::utils::cloud_redirect::host as cloud_redirect;
use crate::utils::config::{config, config_file_watcher, lua_config, lua_file_watcher};
use crate::utils::logging;
use crate::utils::steam_metadata::{ipc_loader, manifest_donor, pattern_loader, steam_diagnostics};
use crate::utils::tokeer::bridge as tokeer_bridge;

// ── Module globals ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

/// `HMODULE` for `steamclient64.dll`. Populated by the init thread.
pub static CLIENT_HMODULE: AtomicPtr<c_void> = AtomicPtr::new(std::ptr::null_mut());

/// `HMODULE` for `steamui.dll`. Populated by the init thread.
pub static UI_HMODULE: AtomicPtr<c_void> = AtomicPtr::new(std::ptr::null_mut());

/// The fake AppId used by `-onlinefix` (SpaceWar).
pub const K_ONLINE_FIX_APPID: u32 = 480;

#[inline]
pub fn set_client_hmodule(ptr: *mut c_void) { CLIENT_HMODULE.store(ptr, Ordering::Release); }

#[inline]
pub fn set_ui_hmodule(ptr: *mut c_void)     { UI_HMODULE.store(ptr, Ordering::Release); }

#[inline]
pub fn client_hmodule() -> *mut c_void      { CLIENT_HMODULE.load(Ordering::Acquire) }

#[inline]
pub fn ui_hmodule() -> *mut c_void          { UI_HMODULE.load(Ordering::Acquire) }

// ── Runtime paths ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

/// All the fixed paths the init thread resolves once and every other
/// module reads afterwards. Stored in a `OnceLock`, so after init they
/// are effectively immutable.
pub struct RuntimePaths {
    pub install: String,
    pub client: String,
    pub ui: String,
    pub diversion: String,
    pub lua_dir: String,
    pub config: String,
}

static PATHS: OnceLock<RuntimePaths> = OnceLock::new();

pub fn paths() -> Option<&'static RuntimePaths> { PATHS.get() }

// ── Constants ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

// These values are documented in the Win32 SDK. `windows-sys` does not
// re-export them from LibraryLoader on this version.
const DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH: u32 = 1;
const DLL_PROCESS_DETACH: u32 = 0;

// ── Init thread ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/// Build the six runtime paths from the current working directory and
/// load `steamclient64.dll` / `steamui.dll`. Called once, on the init
/// thread, before any hook installation.
///
/// The C++ uses fixed-size `char[260]` buffers; this port builds
/// `String`s and stores them in a `OnceLock`.
fn initialize_steam_components() -> bool {
    let install = dynamic_library::get_current_directory_path();
    if install.is_empty() {
        LOG_ERROR!("InitializeSteamComponents: GetCurrentDirectoryPath returned empty");
        return false;
    }

    let client_path    = format!("{}\\steamclient64.dll",  install);
    let ui_path        = format!("{}\\steamui.dll",        install);
    let diversion_path = format!("{}\\bin\\diversion.dll", install);
    let lua_dir        = format!("{}\\config\\stplug-in",  install);
    let config_path    = format!("{}\\rustytools.toml", install);

    let client_h = dynamic_library::load(Path::new(&client_path));
    if client_h.is_null() {
        LOG_ERROR!(
            "Load steamclient64.dll failed: {} (err={})",
            client_path, dynamic_library::get_last_error_code(),
        );
        return false;
    }
    set_client_hmodule(client_h.0);
    LOG_INFO!("Loaded steamclient64.dll from {}", client_path);

    let ui_h = dynamic_library::load(Path::new(&ui_path));
    if ui_h.is_null() {
        LOG_ERROR!(
            "Load failed for steamui.dll: err={}",
            dynamic_library::get_last_error_code(),
        );
        return false;
    }
    set_ui_hmodule(ui_h.0);

    let _ = PATHS.set(RuntimePaths {
        install,
        client: client_path,
        ui: ui_path,
        diversion: diversion_path,
        lua_dir,
        config: config_path,
    });
    true
}

/// The worker entry point. Mirrors `InitThread` in `dllmain.cpp`.
fn init_thread(self_module: ModuleHandle) -> u32 {
    logging::init(self_module);
    LOG_INFO!("[wf] init_thread: enter");

    LOG_INFO!("[wf] initialize_steam_components: enter");
    if !initialize_steam_components() {
        LOG_ERROR!("InitializeSteamComponents failed");
        LOG_INFO!("[wf] initialize_steam_components: FAILED");
        return 1;
    }
    LOG_INFO!("[wf] initialize_steam_components: done");

    let Some(paths) = PATHS.get() else {
        LOG_INFO!("[wf] PATHS.get: FAILED (should never happen)");
        return 1;
    };

    LOG_INFO!("[wf] config::load: enter");
    config::load(&paths.config);
    LOG_INFO!("[wf] config::load: done");

    LOG_INFO!("[wf] logging::init_modules_public: enter");
    logging::init_modules_public();
    logging::install_platform_log_sink();
    LOG_INFO!("[wf] logging::init_modules_public: done");

    LOG_INFO!("[wf] steam_diagnostics::initialize: enter");
    steam_diagnostics::initialize(&paths.client, &paths.ui);
    LOG_INFO!("[wf] steam_diagnostics::initialize: done");

    LOG_INFO!("[wf] pattern_loader::load (steamui): enter");
    pattern_loader::load(ModuleHandle(ui_hmodule()), &paths.ui, "steamui");
    LOG_INFO!("[wf] pattern_loader::load (steamui): done");

    LOG_INFO!("[wf] pattern_loader::load (steamclient): enter");
    pattern_loader::load(ModuleHandle(client_hmodule()), &paths.client, "steamclient");
    LOG_INFO!("[wf] pattern_loader::load (steamclient): done");

    LOG_INFO!("[wf] ipc_loader::load: enter");
    ipc_loader::load(&paths.client);
    LOG_INFO!("[wf] ipc_loader::load: done");

    LOG_INFO!("[wf] lua parse: enter");
    let watch_dirs = lua_config::merge_watch_dirs(&config::get_lua_paths(), &paths.lua_dir);
    for dir in &watch_dirs {
        lua_config::parse_directory(dir);
    }
    LOG_INFO!("[wf] lua parse: done");

    LOG_INFO!("[wf] lua_file_watcher::start: enter");
    lua_file_watcher::start(watch_dirs);
    LOG_INFO!("[wf] lua_file_watcher::start: done");

    LOG_INFO!("[wf] config_file_watcher::start: enter");
    config_file_watcher::start(&paths.config, &paths.lua_dir);
    LOG_INFO!("[wf] config_file_watcher::start: done");

    LOG_INFO!("[wf] install_steamui_hooks: enter");
    crate::hook::framework::install_steamui_hooks();
    LOG_INFO!("[wf] install_steamui_hooks: done");

    LOG_INFO!("[wf] install_steamclient_hooks: enter");
    crate::hook::framework::install_steamclient_hooks();
    LOG_INFO!("[wf] install_steamclient_hooks: done");

    LOG_INFO!("[wf] report_missing_functions: enter");
    pattern_loader::report_missing_functions();
    LOG_INFO!("[wf] report_missing_functions: done");

    LOG_INFO!("[wf] cloud_redirect::initialize: enter");
    cloud_redirect::initialize(&paths.install);
    LOG_INFO!("[wf] cloud_redirect::initialize: done");

    LOG_INFO!("[wf] manifest_donor::start: enter");
    manifest_donor::start();
    LOG_INFO!("[wf] manifest_donor::start: done");

    // The bst:// URI scheme registration writes to
    // HKCU\Software\Classes\bst\shell\open\command, which is a known
    // persistence location. AV/Defender can hold that write for
    // seconds while it scans the payload. Do not block init on it:
    // spawn a detached thread and let init complete.
    LOG_INFO!("[wf] register_uri_scheme: spawning on detached thread");
    let dll_path = format!("{}\\RustyTools.dll", paths.install);
    let dll_path_owned = dll_path.clone();
    let spawn_ok = std::thread::Builder::new()
        .name("ost-uri-register".into())
        .spawn(move || {
            LOG_INFO!("[wf] register_uri_scheme: enter (thread)");
            tokeer_bridge::register_uri_scheme(&dll_path_owned);
            LOG_INFO!("[wf] register_uri_scheme: done (thread)");
        })
        .is_ok();
    LOG_INFO!("[wf] register_uri_scheme: spawn ok={}", spawn_ok);

    LOG_INFO!("rusty_tools init complete");
    LOG_INFO!("[wf] init_thread: exit");
    0
}

// ── Host detection ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

/// True only when the host process is `steam.exe`. The proxy DLLs
/// already gate injection to Steam, but `rundll32` loads this DLL
/// directly to service a `bst://` link — there we must NOT run the
/// Steam-injection machinery.
fn is_steam_host() -> bool {
    use std::ffi::CStr;
    let mut buf = [0i8; 260];
    let n = unsafe {
        windows_sys::Win32::System::LibraryLoader::GetModuleFileNameA(
            std::ptr::null_mut(),
            buf.as_mut_ptr() as *mut u8,
            buf.len() as u32,
        )
    };
    if n == 0 { return false; }
    let s = unsafe { CStr::from_ptr(buf.as_ptr()) }.to_string_lossy();
    let name = match s.rfind('\\') {
        Some(i) => &s[i + 1..],
        None => &s[..],
    };
    name.eq_ignore_ascii_case("steam.exe")
}

// ── DllMain ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/// # Safety
/// Called by the Windows loader. `hmodule` is the base address of this
/// DLL for the lifetime of the process.
#[cfg(windows)]
#[no_mangle]
pub unsafe extern "system" fn DllMain(
    hmodule: *mut c_void,
    reason: u32,
    _reserved: *mut c_void,
) -> i32 {
    match reason {
        DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH => {
            LOG_INFO!("[wf] DllMain DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH is_steam_host={}", is_steam_host());
            windows_sys::Win32::System::LibraryLoader::DisableThreadLibraryCalls(hmodule);
            if !is_steam_host() {
                // e.g. rundll32 servicing a bst:// handler. No
                // injection machinery runs; the TokeerUri export does
                // its work standalone.
                return 1;
            }
            // Hand off all real work to a worker thread. `DllMain`
            // itself must not touch the filesystem, load a module, or
            // open a detour transaction — all of that would run under
            // the loader lock.
            let self_module = ModuleHandle(hmodule);
            let _ = std::thread::Builder::new()
                .name("ost-init".into())
                .spawn(move || { init_thread(self_module); });
            1
        }
        DLL_PROCESS_DETACH => {
            LOG_INFO!("[wf] DllMain DLL_PROCESS_DETACH");
            if is_steam_host() {
                let _ = std::panic::catch_unwind(|| {
                    config_file_watcher::stop();
                    lua_file_watcher::stop();
                    crate::hook::framework::uninstall_steamui_hooks();
                    crate::hook::framework::uninstall_steamclient_hooks();
                    cloud_redirect::shutdown();
                });
            }
            1
        }
        _ => 1,
    }
}

/// Non-Windows stub so the crate still builds elsewhere. The real
/// `DllMain` only exists on Windows; on other targets the symbol is
/// simply not exported.
#[cfg(not(windows))]
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn DllMain(_h: *mut c_void, _reason: u32, _r: *mut c_void) -> i32 { 1 }

===== FILE: src\hook\decryption.rs =====
//! `Hooks_Decryption.cpp`. Serves Lua-provided depot decryption keys and
//! exposes the cached appticket stored in the client's local config store.

use std::ffi::{c_void, CString};
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicPtr, Ordering};

use crate::steam::enums::EConfigStore;
use crate::steam::types::AppId_t;
use crate::utils::config::lua_config;
use crate::{hook_fn, install_hook_c, uninstall_hook};

/// Captured from the first `GetBinary` call on the UserLocal store. Read
/// by [`get_cache_app_ownership_ticket`] to pull cached apptickets.
static G_PCONFIG_STORE_LOCAL: AtomicPtr<c_void> = AtomicPtr::new(std::ptr::null_mut());

/// The literal suffix the C++ searches for: backslash, then
/// `DecryptionKey`. Written as `"\\DecryptionKey"` on the Rust side to
/// mean the same one-byte-backslash plus the ASCII tail.
const DECRYPTION_KEY_SUFFIX: &str = "\\DecryptionKey";

/// Extract the `<depotId>` component from a key like
/// `"...\<depotId>\DecryptionKey"`. Returns `None` when the shape does
/// not match or the digits do not parse.
///
/// The C++ uses `std::stoul` here, which throws on malformed input and
/// is uncaught. This port returns `Option` instead and lets the caller
/// fall through to the original — a safer divergence with the same
/// observable behavior for well-formed input.
fn try_extract_depot_id(key_name: &str) -> Option<AppId_t> {
    let suffix_at = key_name.find(DECRYPTION_KEY_SUFFIX)?;
    let before = &key_name[..suffix_at];
    let last_backslash = before.rfind('\\')?;
    let digits = &before[last_backslash + 1..];
    crate::platform::numbers::parse_u32(digits)
}

hook_fn! {
    fn ConfigStoreGetBinary(
        p_object: *mut c_void,
        e_config_store: i32,
        key_name: *const i8,
        key: *mut i8,
        key_size: u32,
    ) -> i32 {
        // `e_config_store` is declared as i32 rather than the EConfigStore
        // enum so a caller passing an out-of-range discriminant does not
        // trip UB at the ABI boundary. The comparison against UserLocal
        // reproduces the C++ check exactly.
        if e_config_store == EConfigStore::UserLocal as i32
            && !p_object.is_null()
            && G_PCONFIG_STORE_LOCAL.load(Ordering::Acquire).is_null()
        {
            G_PCONFIG_STORE_LOCAL.store(p_object, Ordering::Release);
            LOG_DECRYPTIONKEY_DEBUG!(
                "ConfigStoreGetBinary: captured local ConfigStore at {:p}",
                p_object
            );
        }

        if !key_name.is_null() {
            let name = std::ffi::CStr::from_ptr(key_name).to_string_lossy();
            LOG_DECRYPTIONKEY_DEBUG!(
                "ConfigStore::GetBinary called for pObject={:p}, eConfigStore={}, KeyName='{}'",
                p_object,
                e_config_store,
                name
            );

            if let Some(depot_id) = try_extract_depot_id(&name) {
                let key_bytes = lua_config::get_decryption_key(depot_id);
                if !key_bytes.is_empty() {
                    if (key_size as usize) >= key_bytes.len() && !key.is_null() {
                        LOG_DECRYPTIONKEY_INFO!(
                            "Providing decryption key for depot {}: {}",
                            depot_id,
                            hex::encode(&key_bytes)
                        );
                        std::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(
                            key_bytes.as_ptr(),
                            key as *mut u8,
                            key_bytes.len(),
                        );
                        return key_bytes.len() as i32;
                    }
                    LOG_DECRYPTIONKEY_WARN!(
                        "Decryption key for depot {} is too large ({} bytes) for buffer ({} bytes)",
                        depot_id,
                        key_bytes.len(),
                        key_size
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        o_ConfigStoreGetBinary(p_object, e_config_store, key_name, key, key_size)
    }
}

/// Read `apptickets\<app_id>` out of the captured local config store.
/// Returns empty when the store is not yet captured or the key is
/// missing.
fn read_config_store_local_binary(key_name: &str) -> Vec<u8> {
    let store = G_PCONFIG_STORE_LOCAL.load(Ordering::Acquire);
    if store.is_null() || unsafe { O_CONFIG_STORE_GET_BINARY.is_null() } {
        LOG_DECRYPTIONKEY_WARN!(
            "GetConfigStoreLocalBinary: ConfigStoreGetBinary not ready, cannot get binary value"
        );
        return Vec::new();
    }

    let cname = match CString::new(key_name) {
        Ok(c) => c,
        Err(_) => {
            LOG_DECRYPTIONKEY_WARN!(
                "GetConfigStoreLocalBinary: key name has interior NUL: {}",
                key_name
            );
            return Vec::new();
        }
    };

    let mut value = vec![0u8; 1024];
    let result = unsafe {
        o_ConfigStoreGetBinary(
            store,
            EConfigStore::UserLocal as i32,
            cname.as_ptr() as *const i8,
            value.as_mut_ptr() as *mut i8,
            value.len() as u32,
        )
    };
    if result <= 0 {
        LOG_DECRYPTIONKEY_DEBUG!(
            "GetConfigStoreLocalBinary: failed to read KeyName='{}'",
            key_name
        );
        return Vec::new();
    }
    value.truncate(result as usize);
    LOG_DECRYPTIONKEY_DEBUG!(
        "GetConfigStoreLocalBinary: got value for KeyName='{}' ({} bytes)",
        key_name,
        value.len()
    );
    value
}

pub fn get_cache_app_ownership_ticket(app_id: AppId_t) -> Vec<u8> {
    let ticket = read_config_store_local_binary(&format!("apptickets\\{}", app_id));
    if ticket.is_empty() {
        LOG_DECRYPTIONKEY_DEBUG!("no cached ticket for AppId {}", app_id);
        return ticket;
    }
    LOG_DECRYPTIONKEY_DEBUG!(
        "got cached ticket for AppId {} ({} bytes)",
        app_id,
        ticket.len()
    );
    ticket
}

pub fn install() -> bool {
    install_hook_c!(ConfigStoreGetBinary)
}

pub fn uninstall() -> bool {
    uninstall_hook!(ConfigStoreGetBinary)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn extract_depot_id_typical() {
        let id = try_extract_depot_id("UserLocal\\appinfo\\730\\DecryptionKey");
        assert_eq!(id, Some(730));
    }

    #[test]
    fn extract_depot_id_no_prefix() {
        // The C++ uses `find_last_of("\\", last - 1)` to locate the
        // backslash immediately before the depot id. A key with no
        // directory component (`730\DecryptionKey`) has no such
        // backslash, so the C++ returns npos and skips the override
        // path. The Rust port matches.
        assert_eq!(try_extract_depot_id("730\\DecryptionKey"), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn extract_depot_id_missing_suffix() {
        assert_eq!(try_extract_depot_id("730\\SomeOtherKey"), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn extract_depot_id_non_numeric() {
        assert_eq!(try_extract_depot_id("abc\\DecryptionKey"), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn extract_depot_id_no_backslash_before() {
        assert_eq!(try_extract_depot_id("730DecryptionKey"), None);
    }
}


===== FILE: src\hook\framework.rs =====
//! Detour transaction helpers and the module-level install
//! orchestrators that mirror `HookManager.cpp`.
//!
//! Sub-batches grow this file as modules land:
//!   6a: callback
//!   6b: decryption, misc, steamui
//!   6c: manifest, package
//!   6d: ipc
//!   6e-1: netpacket

use crate::platform::detour;

pub struct Transaction { begun: bool }

impl Transaction {
    pub fn begin() -> Self { Self { begun: detour::begin_transaction() } }

    pub fn commit(self, all_ok: bool) -> bool {
        if !self.begun { return false; }
        let c = detour::commit_transaction();
        std::mem::forget(self);
        c && all_ok
    }
}

impl Drop for Transaction {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if self.begun { detour::abort_transaction(); }
    }
}

pub fn install_steamclient_hooks() {
    let txn = Transaction::begin();
    let mut ok = true;
    ok &= crate::hook::callback::install();
    ok &= crate::hook::decryption::install();
    ok &= crate::hook::ipc::install();
    ok &= crate::hook::manifest::install();
    ok &= crate::hook::misc::install();
    ok &= crate::hook::netpacket::install();
    ok &= crate::hook::package::install();
    let _ = txn.commit(ok);
}

pub fn uninstall_steamclient_hooks() {
    let txn = Transaction::begin();
    let mut ok = true;
    ok &= crate::hook::callback::uninstall();
    ok &= crate::hook::decryption::uninstall();
    ok &= crate::hook::ipc::uninstall();
    ok &= crate::hook::manifest::uninstall();
    ok &= crate::hook::misc::uninstall();
    ok &= crate::hook::netpacket::uninstall();
    ok &= crate::hook::package::uninstall();
    let _ = txn.commit(ok);
    crate::hook::veh_common::disarm_all();
    crate::hook::veh_common::remove_handler();
}

pub fn install_steamui_hooks() {
    let txn = Transaction::begin();
    let mut ok = true;
    ok &= crate::hook::steamui::install();
    let _ = txn.commit(ok);
}

pub fn uninstall_steamui_hooks() {
    let txn = Transaction::begin();
    let mut ok = true;
    ok &= crate::hook::steamui::uninstall();
    let _ = txn.commit(ok);
}


===== FILE: src\hook\ipc.rs =====
//! `Hooks_IPC.cpp`. Hooks `IPCProcessMessage` and dispatches registered
//! pre/post handlers by `(interfaceID, funcHash)`.

use std::ffi::c_void;
use std::sync::Mutex;

use once_cell::sync::Lazy;

use crate::hook::misc as hooks_misc;
use crate::steam::ipc_facades::{IPCInterfaceCall, IPCHandshakeReq, IPCRequest};
use crate::steam::ipc_messages::{EIPCCommand, EIPCInterface};
use crate::steam::structs::{CPipeClient, CUtlBuffer};
use crate::steam::types::HSteamPipe;
use crate::utils::config::lua_config;
use crate::utils::steam_metadata::ipc_loader;
use crate::{hook_fn, install_hook_c, resolve_c, resolve_fn, uninstall_hook};

// ── Handler signature ───────────────────────────────────────────────

pub type IpcHandlerFn = unsafe fn(
    pipe: *mut CPipeClient,
    p_read: *mut CUtlBuffer,
    p_write: *mut CUtlBuffer,
);

pub struct HandlerEntry {
    pub interface_name: &'static str,
    pub method_name: &'static str,
    pub pre: Option<IpcHandlerFn>,
    pub post: Option<IpcHandlerFn>,
}

impl HandlerEntry {
    pub fn debug_string(&self) -> String {
        format!(
            "{}::{} pre={} post={}",
            self.interface_name,
            self.method_name,
            if self.pre.is_some() { "yes" } else { "no" },
            if self.post.is_some() { "yes" } else { "no" },
        )
    }
}

// ── Resolved handler ────────────────────────────────────────────────

#[derive(Copy, Clone)]
struct ResolvedHandler {
    interface_id: u8,
    func_hash: u32,
    pre: Option<IpcHandlerFn>,
    post: Option<IpcHandlerFn>,
}

static G_HANDLERS: Lazy<Mutex<Vec<ResolvedHandler>>> =
    Lazy::new(|| Mutex::new(Vec::new()));

// ── Pipe getter ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

resolve_fn! {
    fn GetPipeClient(p_engine: *mut c_void, h_steam_pipe: HSteamPipe) -> *mut CPipeClient
}

unsafe fn get_pipe(p_server: *mut c_void, h_steam_pipe: HSteamPipe) -> *mut CPipeClient {
    if O_GET_PIPE_CLIENT.is_null() { return std::ptr::null_mut(); }
    o_GetPipeClient(p_server, h_steam_pipe)
}

// ── Dispatch ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

#[derive(Copy, Clone)]
struct IpcDispatch {
    pipe: *mut CPipeClient,
    pre: Option<IpcHandlerFn>,
    post: Option<IpcHandlerFn>,
    handler_found: bool,
}

impl IpcDispatch {
    fn empty() -> Self {
        Self { pipe: std::ptr::null_mut(), pre: None, post: None, handler_found: false }
    }
    fn enabled(&self) -> bool { !self.pipe.is_null() && self.handler_found }
}

fn find_handler(iface: u8, func_hash: u32) -> Option<ResolvedHandler> {
    let g = G_HANDLERS.lock().expect("ipc handlers mutex poisoned");
    g.iter().find(|h| h.interface_id == iface && h.func_hash == func_hash).copied()
}

unsafe fn resolve_dispatch(
    p_server: *mut c_void,
    h_steam_pipe: HSteamPipe,
    p_read: *mut CUtlBuffer,
) -> IpcDispatch {
    let mut d = IpcDispatch::empty();
    d.pipe = get_pipe(p_server, h_steam_pipe);
    if d.pipe.is_null() { return d; }

    let req = IPCRequest::from_cutl(p_read);
    if !req.ok() { return d; }
    if req.command_raw() != EIPCCommand::InterfaceCall as u8 { return d; }

    // Ignore calls when appId is not resolved or not in the Lua config.
    if !lua_config::has_depot(hooks_misc::resolve_app_id(), false) { return d; }

    let call = IPCInterfaceCall::from_body(req.body());
    if !call.ok() { return d; }

    if let Some(h) = find_handler(call.interface_id_raw(), call.func_hash()) {
        d.pre = h.pre;
        d.post = h.post;
        d.handler_found = true;
    }
    d
}

// ── Handshake ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

unsafe fn handle_handshake(
    p_server: *mut c_void,
    h_steam_pipe: HSteamPipe,
    p_read: *mut CUtlBuffer,
) {
    let req = IPCRequest::from_cutl(p_read);
    if !req.ok() { return; }
    if req.command_raw() != EIPCCommand::Handshake as u8 { return; }

    let hs = IPCHandshakeReq::from_body(req.body());
    if !hs.ok() { return; }

    let pipe = get_pipe(p_server, h_steam_pipe);
    if pipe.is_null() { return; }

    // set client PID
    (*pipe).m_clientPID = hs.pid();

    LOG_IPC_DEBUG!(
        "Received handshake from pipe={:p} pid={} tid={} ver={}",
        pipe, hs.pid(), hs.tid(), hs.version(),
    );
    crate::bridge::pipe_manager_on_handshake(pipe);
}

// ── NetworkingSockets detection ─────────────────────────────────────

unsafe fn detect_networking_sockets(p_read: *mut CUtlBuffer) {
    if !hooks_misc::is_onlinefix_active() { return; }
    if hooks_misc::should_report_onlinefix_app_id() { return; }

    let req = IPCRequest::from_cutl(p_read);
    if !req.ok() { return; }
    if req.command_raw() != EIPCCommand::InterfaceCall as u8 { return; }

    let call = IPCInterfaceCall::from_body(req.body());
    if !call.ok() { return; }
    if call.interface_id_raw() == EIPCInterface::IClientNetworkingSocketsSerialized as u8 {
        hooks_misc::notify_networking_sockets_used();
    }
}

// ── Hook ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

hook_fn! {
    fn IPCProcessMessage(
        p_server: *mut c_void,
        h_steam_pipe: HSteamPipe,
        p_read: *mut CUtlBuffer,
        p_write: *mut CUtlBuffer,
    ) -> bool {
        handle_handshake(p_server, h_steam_pipe, p_read);
        detect_networking_sockets(p_read);

        let dispatch = resolve_dispatch(p_server, h_steam_pipe, p_read);
        if !dispatch.enabled() {
            return o_IPCProcessMessage(p_server, h_steam_pipe, p_read, p_write);
        }

        if let Some(pre) = dispatch.pre {
            pre(dispatch.pipe, p_read, p_write);
        }

        let result = o_IPCProcessMessage(p_server, h_steam_pipe, p_read, p_write);

        if result {
            if let Some(post) = dispatch.post {
                post(dispatch.pipe, p_read, p_write);
            }
        }
        result
    }
}

// ── Public API ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

pub fn install() -> bool {
    resolve_c!(GetPipeClient);

    crate::hook::ipc_isteamuser::register();
    crate::hook::ipc_isteamutils::register();

    {
        let g = G_HANDLERS.lock().expect("ipc handlers mutex poisoned");
        LOG_IPC_INFO!("Hooks_IPC: {} handlers registered", g.len());
    }

    install_hook_c!(IPCProcessMessage)
}

pub fn uninstall() -> bool {
    uninstall_hook!(IPCProcessMessage)
}

pub fn register_handlers(entries: &[HandlerEntry]) {
    let mut g = G_HANDLERS.lock().expect("ipc handlers mutex poisoned");
    for e in entries {
        match ipc_loader::find_by_name(e.interface_name, e.method_name) {
            None => {
                LOG_IPC_WARN!("[Handler Disabled] no IPC spec for {}", e.debug_string());
            }
            Some(m) => {
                g.push(ResolvedHandler {
                    interface_id: m.interface_id,
                    func_hash: m.func_hash,
                    pre: e.pre,
                    post: e.post,
                });
                LOG_IPC_DEBUG!(
                    "Hooks_IPC: resolved {} -> hash=0x{:08X} fencepost=0x{:08X} argc={}",
                    e.debug_string(), m.func_hash, m.fencepost, m.argc,
                );
            }
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {

    #[test]
    fn handler_entry_debug_string() {
        let e = HandlerEntry {
            interface_name: "IClientUser",
            method_name: "GetSteamID",
            pre: None,
            post: None,
        };
        assert_eq!(e.debug_string(), "IClientUser::GetSteamID pre=no post=no");
    }

        // The registry is process-global. Other tests in this crate do
        // not register handlers, so a fresh lookup on an unused hash

}


===== FILE: src\hook\ipc_isteamuser.rs =====
//! `Hooks_IPC_ISteamUser.cpp`. Post-handlers for the four
//! `IClientUser` methods the tool intercepts:
//!
//! * `GetSteamID` — spoof the SteamID for Lua-managed apps.
//! * `GetAppOwnershipTicketExtendedData` — serve a forged or
//!   credential-store appticket.
//! * `RequestEncryptedAppTicket` — record the async call so the
//!   callback can be answered later, and mint a fresh nonce-bound
//!   eticket when the strict-Denuvo path is active.
//! * `GetEncryptedAppTicket` — serve the fresh or credential-store
//!   eticket.

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::Mutex;

use once_cell::sync::Lazy;

use crate::bridge;
use crate::dllmain::K_ONLINE_FIX_APPID;
use crate::hook::ipc::{register_handlers, HandlerEntry, IpcHandlerFn};
use crate::hook::misc as hooks_misc;
use crate::hook::pending_api_calls;
use crate::steam::ipc_facades::{
    GetAppOwnershipTicketExtendedDataReq, GetAppOwnershipTicketExtendedDataResp,
    GetEncryptedAppTicketResp, GetSteamIDResp, RequestEncryptedAppTicketReq,
    RequestEncryptedAppTicketResp,
};
use crate::steam::structs::{CPipeClient, CUtlBuffer};
use crate::steam::structs::CSteamID;
use crate::steam::types::AppId_t;
use crate::utils::tickets::app_ticket::{self, AppTicketSource};
use crate::utils::tickets::eticket_client;

/// Fresh, nonce-bound etickets minted on-demand in
/// `RequestEncryptedAppTicket`, consumed by `GetEncryptedAppTicket` on
/// the same launch.
static G_FRESH_ETICKET: Lazy<Mutex<HashMap<AppId_t, Vec<u8>>>> =
    Lazy::new(|| Mutex::new(HashMap::new()));

// ── Handlers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

unsafe fn handler_post_get_steam_id(
    _pipe: *mut CPipeClient,
    _p_read: *mut CUtlBuffer,
    p_write: *mut CUtlBuffer,
) {
    let app_id = hooks_misc::resolve_app_id();
    let resp = GetSteamIDResp::from_cutl(p_write);
    if !resp.ok() { return; }

    // Spoof whenever a pool-account ticket exists for this app, not just
    // inside the Denuvo auth window. Denuvo reads its cached offline
    // license on second launch and calls GetSteamID BEFORE or AFTER the
    // auth window to verify it — if we only spoof inside the window the
    // real SteamID leaks out and mismatches the license -> 012.
    // GetSpoofSteamID returns 0 for apps with no credential-store ticket
    // (real owners, non-tracked apps), so the spoof is naturally scoped.
    let spoofed = app_ticket::get_spoof_steam_id(app_id);
    if spoofed == 0 { return; }

    let original = resp.return_value().m_unAll64Bits;
    LOG_IPC_DEBUG!(
        "IClientUser::GetSteamID: AppId={} Original=0x{:X}({}) -> Spoofed=0x{:X}({})",
        app_id, original, original, spoofed, spoofed,
    );
    resp.set_return_value(CSteamID::from_u64(spoofed));
}

unsafe fn handler_post_get_app_ownership_ticket_extended_data(
    pipe: *mut CPipeClient,
    p_read: *mut CUtlBuffer,
    p_write: *mut CUtlBuffer,
) {
    let req = GetAppOwnershipTicketExtendedDataReq::from_cutl(p_read);
    if !req.ok() { return; }

    let cb_max = req.cb_max_ticket();
    if cb_max < 0 { return; }

    let app_id_raw = req.un_app_id();
    let app_id = if app_id_raw == K_ONLINE_FIX_APPID {
        hooks_misc::resolve_app_id()
    } else {
        app_id_raw
    };

    let ticket_source = if bridge::denuvo_auth_is_authorized_pipe(pipe) {
        AppTicketSource::CredentialStoreOnly
    } else {
        // Outside the auth window: prefer credential-store ticket
        // (pool SteamID) over ForgeOnly (which uses app 7's ticket and
        // carries the real SteamID). When the 858 network spoof is also
        // active, both paths must agree on the same SteamID or Denuvo
        // cross-checks them and rejects.
        LOG_IPC_DEBUG!(
            "IClientUser::GetAppOwnershipTicketExtendedData: AppId={} not in authorization window, credential store preferred",
            app_id,
        );
        AppTicketSource::CredentialStoreThenForge
    };

    let ticket = match app_ticket::get_app_ownership_ticket(app_id, ticket_source) {
        Some(t) => t,
        None => return,
    };

    if ticket.data.len() > cb_max as usize {
        LOG_IPC_WARN!(
            "IClientUser::GetAppOwnershipTicketExtendedData: AppId={} ticket too large ({} bytes) for buffer ({} bytes)",
            app_id, ticket.data.len(), cb_max,
        );
        return;
    }

    let resp = GetAppOwnershipTicketExtendedDataResp::from_cutl(p_write, cb_max as usize);
    if !resp.ok() { return; }

    resp.set_return_value(ticket.total_size);
    if !resp.set_p_ticket(&ticket.data) { return; }
    resp.set_pi_app_id(ticket.app_id_offset);
    resp.set_pi_steam_id(ticket.steam_id_offset);
    resp.set_pi_signature(ticket.signature_offset);
    resp.set_pcb_signature(ticket.signature_size);

    LOG_IPC_DEBUG!(
        "IClientUser::GetAppOwnershipTicketExtendedData: AppId={} total={} appIdOff={} steamIdOff={} sigOff={} sigSize={}",
        app_id, ticket.total_size, ticket.app_id_offset,
        ticket.steam_id_offset, ticket.signature_offset, ticket.signature_size,
    );
}

unsafe fn handler_post_request_encrypted_app_ticket(
    _pipe: *mut CPipeClient,
    p_read: *mut CUtlBuffer,
    p_write: *mut CUtlBuffer,
) {
    let resp = RequestEncryptedAppTicketResp::from_cutl(p_write);
    if !resp.ok() { return; }

    let app_id = hooks_misc::resolve_app_id();

    {
        let req = RequestEncryptedAppTicketReq::from_cutl(p_read);
        let nonce = if req.ok() { req.p_data() } else { Vec::new() };

        // Whatever account the registry's current static ticket already
        // belongs to (0 if none) — lets the backend pin the mint to that
        // SAME account instead of risking a different pool pick.
        let existing_steam_id = app_ticket::extract_steam_id_from_ticket_bytes(
            &app_ticket::get_app_ownership_ticket_from_credential_store(app_id),
        );

        // Mint a fresh eticket whenever the credential store already has
        // a ticket for this app. The minted eticket is pinned to the
        // same pool account via existing_steam_id, which matches
        // GetSteamID's spoof (also sourced from the credential store via
        // CredentialStoreThenForge) — no error-54 risk.
        if existing_steam_id != 0 {
            if let Some(fresh) =
                eticket_client::fetch_fresh_eticket(app_id, &nonce, existing_steam_id)
            {
                G_FRESH_ETICKET.lock().unwrap().insert(app_id, fresh);
            }
        }
    }

    let have_fresh = G_FRESH_ETICKET.lock().unwrap().contains_key(&app_id);
    let ticket = app_ticket::get_encrypted_ticket_from_credential_store(app_id);
    if ticket.is_empty() && !have_fresh {
        LOG_IPC_DEBUG!("RequestEncryptedAppTicket: AppId={} - no cached eticket, skip", app_id);
        return;
    }

    let h_async_call = resp.return_value();
    pending_api_calls::record_encrypted_ticket(h_async_call, app_id);
    LOG_IPC_DEBUG!(
        "RequestEncryptedAppTicket: AppId={} hAsyncCall=0x{:X} - recorded (fresh={})",
        app_id, h_async_call, have_fresh,
    );
}

unsafe fn handler_post_get_encrypted_app_ticket(
    _pipe: *mut CPipeClient,
    _p_read: *mut CUtlBuffer,
    p_write: *mut CUtlBuffer,
) {
    let app_id = hooks_misc::resolve_app_id();

    // Prefer a fresh nonce-bound ticket minted in
    // RequestEncryptedAppTicket; fall back to the static credential-store
    // ticket (titles that don't need the on-demand path keep working
    // unchanged).
    let mut ticket = G_FRESH_ETICKET.lock().unwrap().get(&app_id).cloned();
    let from_fresh = ticket.is_some();
    if ticket.is_none() {
        let t = app_ticket::get_encrypted_ticket_from_credential_store(app_id);
        if !t.is_empty() { ticket = Some(t); }
    }
    let ticket = match ticket {
        None => {
            LOG_IPC_DEBUG!("GetEncryptedAppTicket: AppId={} - no cached eticket, skip", app_id);
            return;
        }
        Some(t) => t,
    };
    LOG_IPC_DEBUG!(
        "GetEncryptedAppTicket: AppId={} serving source={}",
        app_id, if from_fresh { "fresh" } else { "store" },
    );

    let ticket_size = ticket.len() as u32;
    let cur_capacity = (*p_write).m_Memory.m_nAllocationCount;
    let new_capacity = cur_capacity.wrapping_add(ticket_size);
    if !hooks_misc::ensure_buffer_capacity(p_write, new_capacity, true) {
        LOG_IPC_DEBUG!("GetEncryptedAppTicket: AppId={} - failed to ensure buffer size", app_id);
        return;
    }

    let resp = GetEncryptedAppTicketResp::from_cutl(p_write);
    if !resp.ok() { return; }
    resp.set_return_value(true);
    resp.set_pcb_ticket(ticket_size);
    if !resp.set_p_ticket(&ticket) { return; }
    LOG_IPC_DEBUG!("GetEncryptedAppTicket: AppId={} pcbTicket={}", app_id, ticket_size);
}

// ── Register ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

pub fn register() {
    let entries = [
        HandlerEntry {
            interface_name: "IClientUser",
            method_name: "GetSteamID",
            pre: None,
            post: Some(handler_post_get_steam_id as IpcHandlerFn),
        },
        HandlerEntry {
            interface_name: "IClientUser",
            method_name: "GetAppOwnershipTicketExtendedData",
            pre: None,
            post: Some(handler_post_get_app_ownership_ticket_extended_data as IpcHandlerFn),
        },
        HandlerEntry {
            interface_name: "IClientUser",
            method_name: "RequestEncryptedAppTicket",
            pre: None,
            post: Some(handler_post_request_encrypted_app_ticket as IpcHandlerFn),
        },
        HandlerEntry {
            interface_name: "IClientUser",
            method_name: "GetEncryptedAppTicket",
            pre: None,
            post: Some(handler_post_get_encrypted_app_ticket as IpcHandlerFn),
        },
    ];
    register_handlers(&entries);
}


===== FILE: src\hook\ipc_isteamutils.rs =====
//! `Hooks_IPC_ISteamUtils.cpp`. Post-handlers for two `IClientUtils`
//! methods: `GetAppID` (spoof the OnlineFix appid) and `GetAPICallResult`
//! (rewrite the EncryptedAppTicketResponse callback).

use crate::hook::ipc::{register_handlers, HandlerEntry, IpcHandlerFn};
use crate::hook::misc as hooks_misc;
use crate::hook::pending_api_calls;
use crate::steam::callback::EncryptedAppTicketResponse_t;
use crate::steam::enums::EResult;
use crate::steam::ipc_facades::{
    GetAPICallResultReq, GetAPICallResultResp, GetAppIDResp,
};
use crate::steam::structs::{CPipeClient, CUtlBuffer};

// ── WriteAPICallResult helper ───────────────────────────────────────

/// Write `callback` into the `GetAPICallResultResp.pCallback` field. The
/// C++ template constrains `T` to trivially copyable; Rust's `Copy`
/// bound is the analogue.
unsafe fn write_api_call_result<T: Copy>(
    p_write: *mut CUtlBuffer,
    callback_capacity: u32,
    callback: &T,
) -> bool {
    if (callback_capacity as usize) < std::mem::size_of::<T>() { return false; }
    let resp = GetAPICallResultResp::from_cutl(p_write, callback_capacity as usize);
    if !resp.ok() { return false; }
    let bytes = std::slice::from_raw_parts(
        callback as *const T as *const u8,
        std::mem::size_of::<T>(),
    );
    if !resp.set_p_callback(bytes) { return false; }
    resp.set_return_value(true);
    resp.set_pb_failed(false);
    true
}

// ── Handlers ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

unsafe fn handler_post_get_app_id(
    _pipe: *mut CPipeClient,
    _p_read: *mut CUtlBuffer,
    p_write: *mut CUtlBuffer,
) {
    // Once P2P is up, leave 480 so the socket matches the 480 session
    // cert.
    if hooks_misc::should_report_onlinefix_app_id() { return; }

    let real_app_id = hooks_misc::resolve_app_id();
    if real_app_id == 0 { return; }

    let resp = GetAppIDResp::from_cutl(p_write);
    if !resp.ok() { return; }

    let current = resp.return_value();
    if current == real_app_id { return; }
    resp.set_return_value(real_app_id);
    LOG_IPC_INFO!("GetAppID: spoof response {} -> {}", current, real_app_id);
}

unsafe fn handle_callback_encrypted_app_ticket_response(
    p_write: *mut CUtlBuffer,
    h_async_call: u64,
    cub_callback: u32,
) -> bool {
    let app_id = match pending_api_calls::take_encrypted_ticket(h_async_call) {
        None => return false,
        Some(a) => a,
    };

    let callback = EncryptedAppTicketResponse_t { m_eResult: EResult::OK };
    if !write_api_call_result(p_write, cub_callback, &callback) {
        pending_api_calls::record_encrypted_ticket(h_async_call, app_id);
        LOG_IPC_WARN!(
            "Failed to write EncryptedAppTicketResponse for AppId={} hAsyncCall=0x{:X}",
            app_id, h_async_call,
        );
        return false;
    }
    LOG_IPC_DEBUG!(
        "Set K_EResultOK for EncryptedAppTicketResponse callback, AppId={} hAsyncCall=0x{:X}",
        app_id, h_async_call,
    );
    true
}

unsafe fn handler_post_get_api_call_result(
    _pipe: *mut CPipeClient,
    p_read: *mut CUtlBuffer,
    p_write: *mut CUtlBuffer,
) {
    let req = GetAPICallResultReq::from_cutl(p_read);
    if !req.ok() { return; }

    let app_id = hooks_misc::resolve_app_id();
    LOG_IPC_DEBUG!(
        "GetAPICallResult: hSteamAPICall=0x{:X} cubCallback={} iCallbackExpected={} AppId={}",
        req.h_steam_api_call(), req.cub_callback(), req.i_callback_expected(), app_id,
    );

    let expected = req.i_callback_expected();
    if expected == EncryptedAppTicketResponse_t::K_ICALLBACK as u32 {
        handle_callback_encrypted_app_ticket_response(
            p_write, req.h_steam_api_call(), req.cub_callback(),
        );
    }
}

// ── Register ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

pub fn register() {
    let entries = [
        HandlerEntry {
            interface_name: "IClientUtils",
            method_name: "GetAppID",
            pre: None,
            post: Some(handler_post_get_app_id as IpcHandlerFn),
        },
        HandlerEntry {
            interface_name: "IClientUtils",
            method_name: "GetAPICallResult",
            pre: None,
            post: Some(handler_post_get_api_call_result as IpcHandlerFn),
        },
    ];
    register_handlers(&entries);
}

//! `Hooks_KeyValues.cpp`. Resolves `FindOrCreateKey` (for future KV
//! tree manipulation) and hooks `KeyValues::ReadAsBinary` as a
//! pass-through. The orchestrator does not call `install()` by default,
//! matching the commented-out line in `HookManager.cpp`.

use crate::steam::structs::KeyValues;
use crate::{hook_fn, install_hook_c, resolve_c, resolve_fn, uninstall_hook};

resolve_fn! {
    fn FindOrCreateKey(
        parent: *mut KeyValues,
        name: *const i8,
        create: bool,
        out: *mut *mut KeyValues,
    ) -> *mut KeyValues
}

hook_fn! {
    fn ReadAsBinary(
        root: *mut KeyValues,
        buf: *mut std::ffi::c_void,
        depth: i32,
        text_mode: bool,
        sym_table: *mut std::ffi::c_void,
    ) -> bool {
        o_ReadAsBinary(root, buf, depth, text_mode, sym_table)
    }

===== FILE: src\hook\macros.rs =====
//! Hook boilerplate macros. Ported from `HookMacros.h` and the
//! `CAPTURE_THIS_FUNC` / `ARM_*` family in `VehCommon.h`.
//!
//! Rust has no `__fastcall`; on x64 the Microsoft ABI is the default, so
//! `extern "system"` is used throughout, matching the C++ on this target.
//!
//! ## The `Slot` newtype
//!
//! The C++ `o##name` variable is written by Detours' `DetourAttach`
//! (which stores the trampoline address into it) and read by both the
//! hook body and Detours itself. Modelling it as a Rust `AtomicPtr`
//! would be UB in the strict sense: Detours writes through the raw
//! pointer, not through Rust's atomic API. A `Slot` wraps an
//! `UnsafeCell<*mut c_void>` so the FFI write and the Rust reads share
//! the same memory without pretending the access is atomic.

use std::cell::UnsafeCell;
use std::ffi::c_void;

/// A pointer-sized slot that Detours writes a trampoline into.
pub struct Slot(UnsafeCell<*mut c_void>);

// SAFETY: Detours guarantees writes only happen while every other thread
// is suspended (its commit path suspends the process). Reads happen
// either from the same init thread or, once installed, from any thread
// invoking the trampoline. The slot is process-global; no thread owns it.
unsafe impl Send for Slot {}
unsafe impl Sync for Slot {}

impl Slot {
    pub const fn new() -> Self { Self(UnsafeCell::new(std::ptr::null_mut())) }

    /// Raw pointer for Detours: the address of the slot itself, which is
    /// what `DetourAttach` writes the trampoline into.
    #[inline]
    pub fn as_ptr(&self) -> *mut *mut c_void { self.0.get() }

    /// # Safety
    /// Reads the raw pointer without synchronisation. Callers must
    /// ensure no concurrent Detours write is in flight.
    #[inline]
    pub unsafe fn load(&self) -> *mut c_void { *self.0.get() }

    /// # Safety
    /// Writes the raw pointer. Callers must ensure no concurrent reader
    /// relies on the old value.
    #[inline]
    pub unsafe fn store(&self, p: *mut c_void) { *self.0.get() = p; }

    /// # Safety
    /// Same as [`load`].
    #[inline]
    pub unsafe fn is_null(&self) -> bool { (*self.0.get()).is_null() }
}

impl Default for Slot {
    fn default() -> Self { Self::new() }
}

/// Define a hooked function.
///
/// Expands to a `Slot` holding the original fn pointer, a `o_<Name>`
/// helper that calls through the slot, and a `hk_<Name>` `extern "system"`
/// function the caller writes the body for.
#[macro_export]
macro_rules! hook_fn {
    (
        $(#[$meta:meta])*
        fn $name:ident($($arg:ident : $ty:ty),* $(,)?) -> $ret:ty $body:block
    ) => {
        ::paste::paste! {
            #[allow(non_upper_case_globals)]
            pub static [<O_ $name:snake:upper>]: $crate::hook::macros::Slot
                = $crate::hook::macros::Slot::new();

            #[allow(non_snake_case)]
            #[inline(always)]
            pub unsafe fn [<o_ $name>]($($arg : $ty),*) -> $ret {
                let p = [<O_ $name:snake:upper>].load();
                debug_assert!(
                    !p.is_null(),
                    concat!("hook ", stringify!($name), " invoked before install"),
                );
                let f: unsafe extern "system" fn($($ty),*) -> $ret
                    = ::core::mem::transmute(p);
                f($($arg),*)
            }

            $(#[$meta])*
            #[allow(non_snake_case)]
            pub unsafe extern "system" fn [<hk_ $name>]($($arg : $ty),*) -> $ret $body
        }
    };
}

/// Define a passthrough function that is resolved by pattern but not
/// hooked. Expands to a `Slot` plus an `o_<Name>` helper.
#[macro_export]
macro_rules! resolve_fn {
    (
        fn $name:ident($($arg:ident : $ty:ty),* $(,)?) -> $ret:ty
    ) => {
        ::paste::paste! {
            #[allow(non_upper_case_globals)]
            pub static [<O_ $name:snake:upper>]: $crate::hook::macros::Slot
                = $crate::hook::macros::Slot::new();

            #[allow(non_snake_case)]
            #[inline(always)]
            pub unsafe fn [<o_ $name>]($($arg : $ty),*) -> $ret {
                let p = [<O_ $name:snake:upper>].load();
                debug_assert!(
                    !p.is_null(),
                    concat!("resolve_fn ", stringify!($name), " invoked before resolve"),
                );
                let f: unsafe extern "system" fn($($ty),*) -> $ret
                    = ::core::mem::transmute(p);
                f($($arg),*)
            }
        }
    };
}

/// Declares a function whose `this` pointer is captured once via a
/// one-shot int3 (C++ `CAPTURE_THIS_FUNC`). Expands to two slots — one
/// for the resolved function address, one for the captured `this` — and
/// the same `o_<Name>` helper as `resolve_fn!`.
#[macro_export]
macro_rules! capture_this_fn {
    (
        fn $name:ident($($arg:ident : $ty:ty),* $(,)?) -> $ret:ty
    ) => {
        ::paste::paste! {
            #[allow(non_upper_case_globals)]
            pub static [<O_ $name:snake:upper>]: $crate::hook::macros::Slot
                = $crate::hook::macros::Slot::new();

            #[allow(non_upper_case_globals)]
            pub static [<CAPTURED_ $name:snake:upper>]: $crate::hook::macros::Slot
                = $crate::hook::macros::Slot::new();

            #[allow(non_snake_case)]
            #[inline(always)]
            pub unsafe fn [<o_ $name>]($($arg : $ty),*) -> $ret {
                let p = [<O_ $name:snake:upper>].load();
                debug_assert!(
                    !p.is_null(),
                    concat!("capture_this_fn ", stringify!($name), " invoked before arm"),
                );
                let f: unsafe extern "system" fn($($ty),*) -> $ret
                    = ::core::mem::transmute(p);
                f($($arg),*)
            }
        }
    };
}

/// Install a hook in the given module. Returns `true` when the hook is
/// (or already was) live, `false` when Detours refused. A missing
/// pattern is *not* a failure here: `pattern_loader` records it in the
/// missing list, and the C++ behaves the same way.
#[macro_export]
macro_rules! __install_hook_step {
    ($hmod:expr, $name:ident) => {{
        let target = $crate::utils::steam_metadata::pattern_loader::find_pattern(
            $hmod, stringify!($name),
        );
        if target.is_null() {
            true
        } else {
            ::paste::paste! {
                unsafe { [<O_ $name:snake:upper>].store(target); }
                let slot = [<O_ $name:snake:upper>].as_ptr();
                let detour: *mut ::core::ffi::c_void =
                    [<hk_ $name>] as *const () as usize as *mut ::core::ffi::c_void;
                // SAFETY: slot is a process-static `*mut *mut c_void`;
                // detour is our own `hk_` function, whose signature
                // matches the resolved target on x64. Caller is inside a
                // Detours transaction.
                unsafe { $crate::platform::detour::attach(slot, detour) }
            }
        }
    }};
}

#[macro_export]
#[doc(hidden)]
macro_rules! __install_hook_c {
    ($name:ident) => {{
        let hmod = $crate::platform::dynamic_library::ModuleHandle(
            $crate::dllmain::client_hmodule(),
        );
        $crate::__install_hook_step!(hmod, $name)
    }};
}

#[macro_export]
#[doc(hidden)]
macro_rules! __install_hook_u {
    ($name:ident) => {{
        let hmod = $crate::platform::dynamic_library::ModuleHandle(
            $crate::dllmain::ui_hmodule(),
        );
        $crate::__install_hook_step!(hmod, $name)
    }};
}

#[macro_export]
macro_rules! install_hook_c { ($name:ident) => { $crate::__install_hook_c!($name) }; }
#[macro_export]
macro_rules! install_hook_u { ($name:ident) => { $crate::__install_hook_u!($name) }; }

/// Uninstall a hook installed by `install_hook_c!` / `install_hook_u!`.
/// Clears the slot on success, matching the C++ `o##name = nullptr`.
#[macro_export]
macro_rules! uninstall_hook {
    ($name:ident) => {{
        ::paste::paste! {
            let p = unsafe { [<O_ $name:snake:upper>].load() };
            if p.is_null() {
                true
            } else {
                let slot = [<O_ $name:snake:upper>].as_ptr();
                let detour: *mut ::core::ffi::c_void =
                    [<hk_ $name>] as *const () as usize as *mut ::core::ffi::c_void;
                let ok = unsafe { $crate::platform::detour::detach(slot, detour) };
                if ok {
                    unsafe { [<O_ $name:snake:upper>].store(::core::ptr::null_mut()); }
                }
                ok
            }
        }
    }};
}

/// Resolve `name` in the given module without hooking. Stores the
/// address in the `O_<NAME>` slot declared by `resolve_fn!` or
/// `capture_this_fn!`.
#[macro_export]
#[doc(hidden)]
macro_rules! __resolve_step {
    ($hmod:expr, $name:ident) => {{
        let target = $crate::utils::steam_metadata::pattern_loader::find_pattern(
            $hmod, stringify!($name),
        );
        if !target.is_null() {
            ::paste::paste! {
                unsafe { [<O_ $name:snake:upper>].store(target); }
            }
        }
    }};
}

#[macro_export]
#[doc(hidden)]
macro_rules! __resolve_c {
    ($name:ident) => {{
        let hmod = $crate::platform::dynamic_library::ModuleHandle(
            $crate::dllmain::client_hmodule(),
        );
        $crate::__resolve_step!(hmod, $name)
    }};
}

#[macro_export]
#[doc(hidden)]
macro_rules! __resolve_u {
    ($name:ident) => {{
        let hmod = $crate::platform::dynamic_library::ModuleHandle(
            $crate::dllmain::ui_hmodule(),
        );
        $crate::__resolve_step!(hmod, $name)
    }};
}

#[macro_export]
macro_rules! resolve_c { ($name:ident) => { $crate::__resolve_c!($name) }; }
#[macro_export]
macro_rules! resolve_u { ($name:ident) => { $crate::__resolve_u!($name) }; }

/// Arm a one-shot int3 capture site that writes RCX (the implicit
/// `this` on x64) into the `CAPTURED_<NAME>` slot declared by
/// `capture_this_fn!`.
#[macro_export]
#[doc(hidden)]
macro_rules! __arm_capture_step {
    ($hmod:expr, $name:ident) => {{
        let target = $crate::utils::steam_metadata::pattern_loader::find_pattern(
            $hmod, stringify!($name),
        );
        if !target.is_null() {
            ::paste::paste! {
                unsafe { [<O_ $name:snake:upper>].store(target); }
                // SAFETY: target points at the first byte of a function
                // inside a loaded module; the module is mapped for the
                // lifetime of the process.
                let original = unsafe { *(target as *const u8) };
                $crate::hook::veh_common::arm($crate::hook::veh_common::Int3Site {
                    target: target as *mut u8,
                    original_byte: original,
                    persistent: false,
                    on_hit: $crate::hook::veh_common::capture_rcx_to,
                    callback_data: [<CAPTURED_ $name:snake:upper>].as_ptr()
                        as *mut ::core::ffi::c_void,
                    label: stringify!($name),
                });
            }
        }
    }};
}

/// `true` when both the captured `this` slot and the resolved function
/// slot are populated. Expands to a `&&` of two reads; the caller must
/// be in the module where `capture_this_fn!` declared the slots.
#[macro_export]
macro_rules! capture_ready {
    ($name:ident) => {
        ::paste::paste! {
            unsafe {
                ![<CAPTURED_ $name:snake:upper>].is_null()
                    && ![<O_ $name:snake:upper>].is_null()
            }
        }
    };
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use std::ffi::c_void;

    #[test]
    fn slot_starts_null() {
        let s = Slot::new();
        assert!(unsafe { s.is_null() });
    }

    #[test]
    fn slot_round_trip() {
        let s = Slot::new();
        let p = 0x1234usize as *mut c_void;
        unsafe {
            s.store(p);
            assert_eq!(s.load(), p);
            assert!(!s.is_null());
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn slot_as_ptr_addresses_the_storage() {
        let s = Slot::new();
        let p = 0x5678usize as *mut c_void;
        unsafe {
            s.store(p);
            let slot = s.as_ptr();
            assert_eq!(*slot, p);
        }
    }
}

// ── arm_int3_c! / arm_int3_u! ───────────────────────────────────────
// Register a persistent or one-shot int3 site whose callback is a
// custom function. Mirrors `ARM_INT3` in `VehCommon.h`. Unlike
// `arm_capture_*!`, this does not touch a Slot: the site has no
// "call the original" path, only an on-hit callback that may inspect
// and mutate the CPU context.

#[macro_export]
#[doc(hidden)]
macro_rules! __arm_int3_step {
    ($hmod:expr, $name:ident, $persistent:expr, $on_hit:path, $callback_data:expr) => {{
        let target = $crate::utils::steam_metadata::pattern_loader::find_pattern(
            $hmod, stringify!($name),
        );
        if !target.is_null() {
            // SAFETY: target points at the first byte of a function inside
            // a mapped module. The module is mapped for the process
            // lifetime, so reading that byte is safe.
            let original = unsafe { *(target as *const u8) };
            $crate::hook::veh_common::arm($crate::hook::veh_common::Int3Site {
                target: target as *mut u8,
                original_byte: original,
                persistent: $persistent,
                on_hit: $on_hit,
                callback_data: $callback_data,
                label: stringify!($name),
            });
        }
    }};
}

#[macro_export]
#[doc(hidden)]
macro_rules! __arm_int3_c {
    ($name:ident, $persistent:expr, $on_hit:path, $callback_data:expr) => {{
        let hmod = $crate::platform::dynamic_library::ModuleHandle(
            $crate::dllmain::client_hmodule(),
        );
        $crate::__arm_int3_step!(hmod, $name, $persistent, $on_hit, $callback_data)
    }};
}

#[macro_export]
#[doc(hidden)]
macro_rules! __arm_int3_u {
    ($name:ident, $persistent:expr, $on_hit:path, $callback_data:expr) => {{
        let hmod = $crate::platform::dynamic_library::ModuleHandle(
            $crate::dllmain::ui_hmodule(),
        );
        $crate::__arm_int3_step!(hmod, $name, $persistent, $on_hit, $callback_data)
    }};
}

#[macro_export]
macro_rules! arm_int3_c {
    ($name:ident, $persistent:expr, $on_hit:path, $callback_data:expr) => {
        $crate::__arm_int3_c!($name, $persistent, $on_hit, $callback_data)
    };
}

===== FILE: src\hook\manifest.rs =====
//! `Hooks_Manifest.cpp`. Records depot<->app<->gid mappings as Steam
//! builds depot configs (`BuildDepotDependency`) and pre-seeds the
//! manifest cache on per-manifest acquire (`YldLoadDepotManifest`).
//!
//! The `BuildDepotDependency` hook also guards against an appinfo
//! mid-refresh: Steam reports zero depots for an app during the window
//! where its appinfo is being swapped in, and acting on that transient
//! writes an empty depot config. Returning `false` makes Steam keep its
//! previous config so the next pass builds it properly.

use std::collections::{BTreeSet, HashMap};
use std::ffi::c_void;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU64, Ordering};
use std::time::Duration;

use once_cell::sync::Lazy;
use parking_lot::Mutex;

use crate::platform::{dialog, thread};
use crate::steam::structs::{CUtlVector, DepotEntry};
use crate::steam::types::AppId_t;
use crate::utils::config::lua_config;
use crate::utils::steam_metadata::manifest_cache;
use crate::{hook_fn, install_hook_c, uninstall_hook};

/// Per-fetch timeout for the on-demand pre-seed in
/// `YldLoadDepotManifest`.
const K_PRESEED_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS: u32 = 5000;

/// Quiet window before a missing-manifest popup is surfaced.
const K_MISS_NOTIFY_DEBOUNCE_MS: u64 = 3000;

/// Cap on the number of depots shown in the popup.
const K_MISS_NOTIFY_MAX_LINES: usize = 20;

// ── Module state ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

struct MissingState {
    /// Pending batch, depot->gid.
    missing: BTreeSet<(u32, u64)>,
    /// Already boxed this session.
    notified: BTreeSet<(u32, u64)>,
}

static G_MISSING_STATE: Lazy<Mutex<MissingState>> = Lazy::new(|| {
    Mutex::new(MissingState {
        missing: BTreeSet::new(),
        notified: BTreeSet::new(),
    })
});

/// Debounce generation counter.
static G_MISS_GEN: AtomicU64 = AtomicU64::new(0);

#[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug)]
struct DepotSeen {
    app_id: AppId_t,
    gid: u64,
}

/// depotId -> (appId, Steam's own manifest GID). Recorded before the
/// override pass, so this is what Steam believes rather than what we
/// told it.
static G_DEPOTS_SEEN: Lazy<Mutex<HashMap<u32, DepotSeen>>> =
    Lazy::new(|| Mutex::new(HashMap::new()));

// ── Internal helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────

fn depot_entry_debug(e: &DepotEntry) -> String {
    format!(
        "DepotId={} AppId={} Gid={} Size={} Dlc={} Lcs={} Carry={} Shared={}",
        e.DepotId,
        e.AppId,
        e.ManifestGid,
        e.ManifestSize,
        e.DlcAppId,
        e.LcsRequired as i32,
        e.bNotNewTarget as i32,
        e.SharedInstall as i32,
    )
}

unsafe fn record_depots(vec: *const CUtlVector<DepotEntry>) {
    if vec.is_null() {
        return;
    }
    let mut seen = G_DEPOTS_SEEN.lock();
    let size = (*vec).m_Size;
    let mem = (*vec).m_Memory.m_pMemory;
    for i in 0..size {
        let e = &*mem.add(i as usize);
        if e.DepotId == 0 || e.ManifestGid == 0 {
            continue;
        }
        seen.insert(e.DepotId, DepotSeen { app_id: e.AppId, gid: e.ManifestGid });
    }
}

/// Record a depot whose manifest is not archived yet (404) and, after a
/// short quiet window, show a single MessageBox listing everything
/// collected. The debounce (a generation counter) coalesces the burst
/// of a whole install — including the separate `BuildDepotDependency`
/// calls for a game's DLC apps — into one prompt. The box is shown on
/// the detached waiter, never on Steam's own thread.
fn report_missing(depot: u32, gid: u64) {
    {
        let mut g = G_MISSING_STATE.lock();
        // Once per depot per session: an active-but-stuck download
        // re-requests the code every ~30 s, but the user only needs to
        // be told once.
        if !g.notified.insert((depot, gid)) {
            return;
        }
        g.missing.insert((depot, gid));
    }
    let gen = G_MISS_GEN.fetch_add(1, Ordering::AcqRel) + 1;

    let _ = thread::start_detached(move || {
        std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(K_MISS_NOTIFY_DEBOUNCE_MS));
        // A newer miss arrived during the wait — let its waiter show the
        // box.
        if G_MISS_GEN.load(Ordering::Acquire) != gen {
            return 0;
        }

        let snapshot: Vec<(u32, u64)> = {
            let mut g = G_MISSING_STATE.lock();
            let s: Vec<(u32, u64)> = g.missing.iter().copied().collect();
            g.missing.clear();
            s
        };
        if snapshot.is_empty() {
            return 0;
        }

        let mut body = format!(
            "Missing {} manifest(s) from the cache - not archived yet.\n\
             They've been queued; try the download again in a little while.\n\n\
             depot;manifestid\n",
            snapshot.len(),
        );

        let mut shown = 0;
        for (depot, gid) in &snapshot {
            if shown >= K_MISS_NOTIFY_MAX_LINES {
                body.push_str(&format!("...and {} more", snapshot.len() - shown));
                break;
            }
            body.push_str(&format!("{};{}\n", depot, gid));
            shown += 1;
        }

        dialog::show_warning("OpenSteamTool - manifests not ready", &body);
        0
    });
}

// ── Hooks ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

hook_fn! {
    fn BuildDepotDependency(
        p_user_app_mgr: *mut c_void,
        app_id: AppId_t,
        p_user_config: *mut c_void,
        p_depot_info: *mut CUtlVector<DepotEntry>,
        p_shared_depot_info: *mut CUtlVector<DepotEntry>,
        p_steam_app: *mut c_void,
        p_build_id: *mut u32,
        p_beta_fallback: *mut bool,
    ) -> bool {
        let result = o_BuildDepotDependency(
            p_user_app_mgr,
            app_id,
            p_user_config,
            p_depot_info,
            p_shared_depot_info,
            p_steam_app,
            p_build_id,
            p_beta_fallback,
        );

        // Trace logging of the returned depot entries, when both lists
        // are present. Kept at TRACE so the common path is silent.
        if !p_depot_info.is_null() {
            let size = (*p_depot_info).m_Size;
            LOG_MANIFEST_TRACE!("pDepotInfo->nCount={}", size);
            if size > 0 {
                let mem = (*p_depot_info).m_Memory.m_pMemory;
                for i in 0..size {
                    LOG_MANIFEST_TRACE!("  [{}] {}", i, depot_entry_debug(&*mem.add(i as usize)));
                }
            }
        }
        if !p_shared_depot_info.is_null() {
            let size = (*p_shared_depot_info).m_Size;
            LOG_MANIFEST_TRACE!("pSharedDepotInfo->nCount={}", size);
            if size > 0 {
                let mem = (*p_shared_depot_info).m_Memory.m_pMemory;
                for i in 0..size {
                    LOG_MANIFEST_TRACE!(
                        "  shared[{}] {}",
                        i,
                        depot_entry_debug(&*mem.add(i as usize)),
                    );
                }
            }
        }

        if !result {
            return result;
        }

        // Steam reports zero depots for an app during the window where
        // its appinfo is being swapped in by a PICS refresh — the old
        // depot set is dropped before the new one lands. The caller
        // stores whatever comes back, so acting on the transient writes
        // an EMPTY depot config; the update job then reads that, logs
        // "0 active: 0 target", commits nothing, and still stamps the
        // app Fully Installed at the new BuildID — an install that
        // silently "completes" having downloaded nothing.
        //
        // Returning false makes the caller bail on its clean failure
        // path and keep the app's previous depot config.
        //
        // Only pDepotInfo is tested. pSharedDepotInfo holds depots
        // belonging to OTHER apps (sharedinstall / depotfromapp
        // redirects), so it says nothing about whether this app's own
        // config is sound.
        if app_id != 0
            && (p_depot_info.is_null() || unsafe { (*p_depot_info).m_Size } == 0)
            && lua_config::has_depot(app_id, false)
        {
            LOG_MANIFEST_WARN!(
                "BuildDepotDependency: app {} returned 0 depots (appinfo mid-refresh) — \
                 failing the call so Steam keeps its existing depot config instead of \
                 storing an empty one",
                app_id,
            );
            return false;
        }

        // Before the override pass, so what is cached is Steam's GID.
        unsafe {
            record_depots(p_depot_info);
            record_depots(p_shared_depot_info);
        }

        let overrides = lua_config::get_manifest_overrides();
        if !overrides.is_empty() && !p_depot_info.is_null() {
            let size = unsafe { (*p_depot_info).m_Size };
            if size > 0 {
                let mem = unsafe { (*p_depot_info).m_Memory.m_pMemory };
                for i in 0..size {
                    let e = unsafe { &mut *mem.add(i as usize) };
                    if let Some(ov) = overrides.get(&(e.DepotId as u64)) {
                        // If size=0 in the override, keep the original
                        // size (affects download display but not the
                        // actual download).
                        let new_size = if ov.size != 0 { ov.size } else { e.ManifestSize };
                        LOG_MANIFEST_INFO!(
                            "BuildDepotDependency: patching depot {} gid={}->{} size={}->{}",
                            e.DepotId,
                            e.ManifestGid,
                            ov.gid,
                            e.ManifestSize,
                            new_size,
                        );
                        e.ManifestGid  = ov.gid;
                        e.ManifestSize = new_size;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        result
    }
}

hook_fn! {
    fn YldLoadDepotManifest(
        a1: *mut c_void,
        a2: *mut c_void,
        app_id: i32,
        depot_id: u32,
        manifest_gid: u64,
        branch: *const i8,
    ) -> i64 {
        // Only depots OST unlocks and does not own (lua-added, incl.
        // workshop apps). A bounded blocking fetch: the original checks
        // disk on the very next line, so an archive hit converts into a
        // first-attempt success; a miss just returns and the original
        // takes its normal request-code path.
        if depot_id != 0 && manifest_gid != 0 && lua_config::has_depot(depot_id, false) {
            let branch_str = if branch.is_null() {
                ""
            } else {
                unsafe { std::ffi::CStr::from_ptr(branch) }.to_str().unwrap_or("")
            };
            LOG_MANIFEST_DEBUG!(
                "YldLoadDepotManifest: pre-seed app={} depot={} gid={} branch={}",
                app_id, depot_id, manifest_gid, branch_str,
            );
            let _ = manifest_cache::ensure_cached(
                app_id as u32,
                depot_id,
                manifest_gid,
                K_PRESEED_FETCH_TIMEOUT_MS,
                false,
            );
        }
        o_YldLoadDepotManifest(a1, a2, app_id, depot_id, manifest_gid, branch)
    }
}

// ── Public API ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/// Look up the app id and manifest GID last seen for a depot.
/// Populated from `BuildDepotDependency`, which is the only place a
/// depot's current GID passes through. Returns `None` if the depot has
/// not been seen.
pub fn lookup_depot(depot_id: u32) -> Option<(AppId_t, u64)> {
    let g = G_DEPOTS_SEEN.lock();
    g.get(&depot_id).map(|s| (s.app_id, s.gid))
}

/// Record a depot whose manifest is not archived yet (a definitive
/// 404) and, after a short quiet window, surface one MessageBox listing
/// everything collected. Safe to call from any thread. Called from the
/// real-download path so the prompt only appears when a download
/// actually needs a manifest that isn't ready — never during the
/// startup depot sweep.
pub fn report_missing_manifest(depot_id: u32, gid: u64) {
    report_missing(depot_id, gid);
}

pub fn install() -> bool {
    let ok1 = install_hook_c!(BuildDepotDependency);
    let ok2 = install_hook_c!(YldLoadDepotManifest);
    ok1 && ok2
}

pub fn uninstall() -> bool {
    let ok1 = uninstall_hook!(BuildDepotDependency);
    let ok2 = uninstall_hook!(YldLoadDepotManifest);
    ok1 && ok2
}

// ── Tests ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn lookup_missing_depot_returns_none() {
        assert!(lookup_depot(999_999_999).is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn record_and_lookup_round_trip() {
        // The public path exercises the map; a full raw-pointer round
        // trip goes through `record_depots` which needs a live
        // `CUtlVector`. Test via insertion through the same map.
        let depot = 4_242_424_242u32;
        assert!(lookup_depot(depot).is_none());
        {
            let mut g = G_DEPOTS_SEEN.lock();
            g.insert(depot, DepotSeen { app_id: 12_345, gid: 0xDEAD_BEEF });
        }
        assert_eq!(lookup_depot(depot), Some((12_345, 0xDEAD_BEEF)));
        // Clean up so other tests see a clean registry.
        {
            let mut g = G_DEPOTS_SEEN.lock();
            g.remove(&depot);
        }
    }
}

//! `Hooks_Misc.cpp`. OnlineFix detection and appid rewriting, plus the
//! `GetAppIDForCurrentPipe` and `GetAppDataFromAppInfo` captures that
//! the rest of the hook layer queries through [`resolve_app_id`].

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::ffi::{c_void, CStr};
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, AtomicU32, Ordering};

use once_cell::sync::Lazy;
use parking_lot::Mutex;

use crate::dllmain::K_ONLINE_FIX_APPID;
use crate::hook::veh_common::Int3Site;
use crate::platform::trap::Context;
use crate::steam::structs::{CAppData, CGameID, CUtlBuffer};
use crate::steam::types::AppId_t;
use crate::{
    arm_capture_c, arm_int3_c, capture_ready, capture_this_fn, hook_fn,
    install_hook_c, resolve_c, resolve_fn, uninstall_hook,
};

// ── Pattern-resolved helper ─────────────────────────────────────────

        p_cutl_buffer: *mut CUtlBuffer,
        new_capacity: u32,
    ) -> *mut c_void

// ── Captured-this functions ─────────────────────────────────────────

capture_this_fn! {
    fn GetAppIDForCurrentPipe(p_this: *mut c_void) -> AppId_t
}

capture_this_fn! {
    fn GetAppDataFromAppInfo(
        p_this: *mut c_void,
        app_id: AppId_t,
        key: *const i8,
        buf: *mut u8,
        buf_size: i32,
    ) -> i64
