//! Packet parsing, layout detection, and the replacement helper.

use std::ffi::c_void;

use prost::Message;

use crate::platform::memory;
use crate::steam::enums::EMsg;
use crate::steam::net_packet as netpkt;
use crate::steam::proto::CMsgProtoBufHeader;
use crate::steam::structs::{CNetPacket, MsgHdr};

use super::state::{self, K_MAX_PACKET_SIZE, K_PACKET_POOL_SIZE};

pub const K_MSG_HDR_PROTO_FLAG: u32 = 0x8000_0000;
pub const K_PROBE_MAX_PACKET: u32 = 1 << 20;
pub const K_PROBE_MAX_HDR_LEN: u32 = 8192;
pub const K_PROBE_MIN_PTR: usize = 0x10000;
pub const K_PROBE_MAX_PTR: usize = 0x7FFF_FFFF_0000;
pub const K_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS: i32 = 512;
pub const K_UNRESOLVED: u32 = 0;

// ── Emitted-eMsg constants (mirror the C++ case labels) ────────────

pub const K_EMSG_SERVICE_METHOD_CALL_FROM_CLIENT: u32 = EMsg::ServiceMethodCallFromClient.0;
pub const K_EMSG_SERVICE_METHOD_RESPONSE:         u32 = EMsg::ServiceMethodResponse.0;
pub const K_EMSG_CLIENT_PICS_PRODUCT_INFO_REQUEST: u32 = EMsg::ClientPICSProductInfoRequest.0;
pub const K_EMSG_CLIENT_GAMES_PLAYED:             u32 = EMsg::ClientGamesPlayed.0;
pub const K_EMSG_CLIENT_GAMES_PLAYED_WITH_DATA_BLOB: u32 = EMsg::ClientGamesPlayedWithDataBlob.0;
pub const K_EMSG_CLIENT_RICH_PRESENCE_UPLOAD:     u32 = EMsg::ClientRichPresenceUpload.0;
pub const K_EMSG_CLIENT_GET_USER_STATS:           u32 = EMsg::ClientGetUserStats.0;
pub const K_EMSG_CLIENT_STORE_USER_STATS2:        u32 = EMsg::ClientStoreUserStats2.0;
pub const K_EMSG_CLIENT_GET_USER_STATS_RESPONSE:  u32 = EMsg::ClientGetUserStatsResponse.0;
pub const K_EMSG_CLIENT_PERSONA_STATE:            u32 = EMsg::ClientPersonaState.0;
pub const K_EMSG_CLIENT_SHARED_LIBRARY_STOP_PLAYING: u32 = EMsg::ClientSharedLibraryStopPlaying.0;
pub const K_EMSG_CLIENT_GET_APP_OWNERSHIP_TICKET_RESPONSE: u32 =
    EMsg::ClientGetAppOwnershipTicketResponse.0;
pub const K_EMSG_CLIENT_LICENSE_LIST:             u32 = EMsg::ClientLicenseList.0;
pub const K_EMSG_MULTI:                           u32 = EMsg::Multi.0;
pub const K_EMSG_CLIENT_GET_LEGACY_GAME_KEY:      u32 = 730;

// ── Unpack ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

pub struct RawPacket<'a> {
    pub e_msg: u32,
    pub hdr: &'a [u8],
    pub body: &'a [u8],
}

/// Split a serialized frame into its eMsg, proto header, and body. The
/// bounds test subtracts rather than adds — `sizeof(MsgHdr) + cbHdr`
/// wraps for a `cbHdr` near `UINT32_MAX`, which would put `pBody` behind
/// `data` with a ~4 GB body length.
pub fn unpack_raw(data: &[u8]) -> Option<RawPacket<'_>> {
    if data.len() < std::mem::size_of::<MsgHdr>() {
        return None;
    }
    let raw = u32::from_le_bytes([data[0], data[1], data[2], data[3]]);
    if raw & K_MSG_HDR_PROTO_FLAG == 0 { return None; }
    let hdr_len = u32::from_le_bytes([data[4], data[5], data[6], data[7]]) as usize;
    if hdr_len > data.len() - std::mem::size_of::<MsgHdr>() { return None; }
    let off = std::mem::size_of::<MsgHdr>() + hdr_len;
    Some(RawPacket {
        e_msg: raw & !K_MSG_HDR_PROTO_FLAG,
        hdr: &data[std::mem::size_of::<MsgHdr>()..off],
        body: &data[off..],
    })
}

// ── Layout probe ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

pub unsafe fn probe_layout(base: *const c_void, data_off: u32) -> bool {
    let p = base as *const u8;
    if !memory::is_readable(p.add(data_off as usize) as *const c_void, 0x10) {
        return false;
    }
    let ptr  = *(p.add(data_off as usize) as *const *const u8);
    let size = *(p.add(data_off as usize + 8) as *const u32);
    let c_ref = *(p.add(data_off as usize + 12) as *const i32);

    let addr = ptr as usize;
    if addr < K_PROBE_MIN_PTR || addr >= K_PROBE_MAX_PTR { return false; }
    if size < std::mem::size_of::<MsgHdr>() as u32 || size > K_PROBE_MAX_PACKET { return false; }
    if c_ref < 1 || c_ref > 4096 { return false; }

    if !memory::is_readable(ptr as *const c_void, std::mem::size_of::<MsgHdr>()) { return false; }

    let raw = *(ptr as *const u32);
    let hdr_len = *(ptr.add(4) as *const u32);
    if raw & K_MSG_HDR_PROTO_FLAG == 0 { return false; }
    let e_msg = raw & !K_MSG_HDR_PROTO_FLAG;
    if e_msg == 0 || e_msg >= 0x10000 { return false; }
    let max_hdr = (size - std::mem::size_of::<MsgHdr>() as u32).min(K_PROBE_MAX_HDR_LEN);
    if hdr_len < 2 || hdr_len > max_hdr { return false; }

    if !memory::is_readable(
        ptr as *const c_void,
        std::mem::size_of::<MsgHdr>() + hdr_len as usize,
    ) { return false; }

    let hdr_bytes = std::slice::from_raw_parts(
        ptr.add(std::mem::size_of::<MsgHdr>()),
        hdr_len as usize,
    );
    CMsgProtoBufHeader::decode(hdr_bytes).is_ok()
}

/// Identify the layout from one packet. Latches only when exactly one
/// candidate matches on two consecutive packets. Ambiguity always resets
/// the standing agreement.
pub unsafe fn try_resolve_layout(p_packet: *const CNetPacket) -> bool {
    if netpkt::is_disabled() { return false; }
    let st = state::state();

    st.probe_attempts += 1;
    if st.probe_attempts > K_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS {
        if !st.probe_logged {
            st.probe_logged = true;
            netpkt::disable();
            LOG_NETPACKET_ERROR!(
                "CNetPacket layout unidentified after {} packets - netpacket features \
                 disabled for this session (no field will be touched).",
                K_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS,
            );
        }
        return false;
    }

    let mut winner: u32 = K_UNRESOLVED;
    let mut passes = 0;
    for layout in netpkt::K_LAYOUTS {
        if probe_layout(p_packet as *const c_void, layout.data_off) {
            passes += 1;
            winner = layout.data_off;
        }
    }

    if passes == 0 {
        LOG_NETPACKET_TRACE!(
            "CNetPacket probe: no candidate matched (attempt {}), likely a non-proto frame",
            st.probe_attempts,
        );
        return false;
    }
    if passes > 1 {
        LOG_NETPACKET_TRACE!(
            "CNetPacket probe: {} candidates matched, ambiguous (attempt {})",
            passes, st.probe_attempts,
        );
        st.probe_agreed = K_UNRESOLVED;
        return false;
    }
    if st.probe_agreed != winner {
        LOG_NETPACKET_TRACE!(
            "CNetPacket probe: candidate 0x{:X} matched, awaiting confirmation", winner,
        );
        st.probe_agreed = winner;
        return false;
    }

    let mut name = "?";
    for l in netpkt::K_LAYOUTS {
        if l.data_off == winner { name = l.name; }
    }
    netpkt::latch(winner);
    LOG_NETPACKET_INFO!(
        "CNetPacket layout = {} (m_pubData +0x{:X}, m_cubData +0x{:X}), confirmed on \
         two consecutive packets after {} attempt(s)",
        name, winner, winner + 8, st.probe_attempts,
    );
    true
}

// ── Replacement helper ──────────────────────────────────────────────

/// Build a new frame from the original eMsg word, an optional new
/// header, and an optional new body, write it into the recv ring pool,
/// and point the packet at the pool buffer. Passing `None` for either
/// keeps the corresponding part of the original.
///
/// # Safety
/// `p` must be a live `CNetPacket*` and its layout must be resolved.
pub unsafe fn replace_recv_packet(
    p: *mut CNetPacket,
    orig_frame: &[u8],
    new_hdr: Option<&[u8]>,
    new_body: Option<&[u8]>,
) -> Option<u32> {
    if orig_frame.len() < std::mem::size_of::<MsgHdr>() { return None; }
    let orig_hdr_len = u32::from_le_bytes([
        orig_frame[4], orig_frame[5], orig_frame[6], orig_frame[7],
    ]) as usize;
    if orig_hdr_len > orig_frame.len() - std::mem::size_of::<MsgHdr>() { return None; }
    let orig_hdr = &orig_frame[std::mem::size_of::<MsgHdr>()..std::mem::size_of::<MsgHdr>() + orig_hdr_len];
    let orig_body = &orig_frame[std::mem::size_of::<MsgHdr>() + orig_hdr_len..];

    let final_hdr = new_hdr.unwrap_or(orig_hdr);
    let final_body = new_body.unwrap_or(orig_body);

    let new_size = std::mem::size_of::<MsgHdr>() + final_hdr.len() + final_body.len();
    if new_size > K_MAX_PACKET_SIZE { return None; }

    let st = state::state();
    let idx = st.recv_packet_pool_idx;
    st.recv_packet_pool_idx = (idx + 1) % K_PACKET_POOL_SIZE;
    let buf = st.recv_packet_pool[idx].as_mut_ptr();

    // Preserve the raw eMsg (including the proto flag).
    let raw_emsg = u32::from_le_bytes([orig_frame[0], orig_frame[1], orig_frame[2], orig_frame[3]]);
    std::ptr::write_unaligned(buf as *mut u32, raw_emsg);
    std::ptr::write_unaligned(buf.add(4) as *mut u32, final_hdr.len() as u32);
    if !final_hdr.is_empty() {
        std::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(
            final_hdr.as_ptr(), buf.add(std::mem::size_of::<MsgHdr>()), final_hdr.len(),
        );
    }
    if !final_body.is_empty() {
        std::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(
            final_body.as_ptr(),
            buf.add(std::mem::size_of::<MsgHdr>() + final_hdr.len()),
            final_body.len(),
        );
    }

    netpkt::write_data(p as *mut u8, buf);
    netpkt::write_size(p as *mut u8, new_size as u32);
    Some(new_size as u32)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    fn make_frame(e_msg_raw: u32, hdr: &[u8], body: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {
        let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(8 + hdr.len() + body.len());
        out.extend_from_slice(&e_msg_raw.to_le_bytes());
        out.extend_from_slice(&(hdr.len() as u32).to_le_bytes());
        out.extend_from_slice(hdr);
        out.extend_from_slice(body);
        out
    }

    #[test]
    fn unpack_raw_rejects_short() {
        assert!(unpack_raw(&[]).is_none());
        assert!(unpack_raw(&[0u8; 7]).is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn unpack_raw_rejects_missing_flag() {
        let f = make_frame(742, &[0, 0], &[1, 2, 3]);
        assert!(unpack_raw(&f).is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn unpack_raw_splits_hdr_and_body() {
        let raw = K_MSG_HDR_PROTO_FLAG | 742;
        let f = make_frame(raw, &[0xAA, 0xBB, 0xCC], &[1, 2, 3, 4]);
        let p = unpack_raw(&f).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(p.e_msg, 742);
        assert_eq!(p.hdr, &[0xAA, 0xBB, 0xCC]);
        assert_eq!(p.body, &[1, 2, 3, 4]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn unpack_raw_rejects_hdr_len_past_frame() {
        let raw = K_MSG_HDR_PROTO_FLAG | 742;
        let mut f = make_frame(raw, &[0u8; 4], &[]);
        f[4..8].copy_from_slice(&1000u32.to_le_bytes());
        assert!(unpack_raw(&f).is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn unpack_raw_body_empty_is_ok() {
        let raw = K_MSG_HDR_PROTO_FLAG | 100;
        let f = make_frame(raw, &[0u8; 8], &[]);
        let p = unpack_raw(&f).unwrap();
        assert_eq!(p.e_msg, 100);
        assert_eq!(p.hdr.len(), 8);
        assert!(p.body.is_empty());
    }
}

//! `Hooks_NetPacket_RichPresence`. Outgoing `CMsgClientGamesPlayed` and
//! `CMsgClientRichPresenceUpload`; incoming `CMsgClientPersonaState`.

/// Per-AppId RichPresence KVs, captured from outbound
/// `CMsgClientRichPresenceUpload`. Keyed by AppId so a multi-game stack

static G_RP_KVS_BY_APP_ID: Lazy<Mutex<HashMap<u32, Vec<(String, String)>>>> =
    Lazy::new(|| Mutex::new(HashMap::new()));

// ── Cached buffers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

struct RpBuffers {
    self_hdr: [u8; K_MAX_HDR_SIZE],
    cb_self_hdr: u32,
    self_body: [u8; K_MAX_BODY_SIZE],
    cb_self_body: u32,
    inject_pkt: [u8; K_MAX_PACKET_SIZE],
    cb_inject_pkt: u32,
}

impl RpBuffers {
    const fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            self_hdr: [0u8; K_MAX_HDR_SIZE],
            cb_self_hdr: 0,
            self_body: [0u8; K_MAX_BODY_SIZE],
            cb_self_body: 0,
            inject_pkt: [0u8; K_MAX_PACKET_SIZE],
            cb_inject_pkt: 0,
        }
    }
}

struct RpGlobal(UnsafeCell<RpBuffers>);
unsafe impl Sync for RpGlobal {}
static RP_BUFFERS: RpGlobal = RpGlobal(UnsafeCell::new(RpBuffers::new()));

/// # Safety
/// Caller must be on the network thread. Same contract as
/// `netpacket::state::state`.
#[inline]
unsafe fn buffers() -> &'static mut RpBuffers {
    &mut *RP_BUFFERS.0.get()
}

}

    G_LOCAL_STEAM_ID.load(Ordering::Acquire)
}

pub fn is_inject_pending() -> bool {
    G_INJECT_PENDING.load(Ordering::Acquire)
}

// ── KV1 stream walker ───────────────────────────────────────────────
//
// Binary KV1 format:
//   0x00  start struct   NUL-terminated name follows
//   0x01  string KV      NUL-terminated key + NUL-terminated value
//   0x08  end struct
// Anything else terminates the walk.

fn extract_string_kvs(data: &[u8], out: &mut Vec<(String, String)>) {
    let mut pos: usize = 0;
    let mut depth: i32 = 0;

    fn read_cstr(data: &[u8], pos: &mut usize) -> Option<String> {
        let start = *pos;
        while *pos < data.len() && data[*pos] != 0 { *pos += 1; }
        if *pos >= data.len() { return None; }
        let s = String::from_utf8_lossy(&data[start..*pos]).into_owned();
        *pos += 1;
        Some(s)
    }

    while pos < data.len() {
        let ty = data[pos];
        pos += 1;
        match ty {
            0x08 => {
                if depth > 0 { depth -= 1; continue; }
                break;
            }
            0x00 => {
                let Some(_name) = read_cstr(data, &mut pos) else { return; };
                depth += 1;
            }
            0x01 => {
                let Some(key) = read_cstr(data, &mut pos) else { return; };
                let Some(value) = read_cstr(data, &mut pos) else { return; };
                out.push((key, value));
            }
            _ => return,
        }
    }
}

// ── ApplyGameFields ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

fn apply_game_fields(msg: &mut CMsgClientPersonaState, entry_idx: usize, app_id: u32) {
    let current_status = msg.status_flags.unwrap_or(0);

    if app_id != 0 {
        let kvs_for_app: Option<Vec<(String, String)>> = {
            let kvs = G_RP_KVS_BY_APP_ID.lock();
            kvs.get(&app_id).cloned()
        };
        let has_kvs = kvs_for_app.as_ref().map_or(false, |v| !v.is_empty());

        let name = hooks_misc::get_game_name_by_app_id(app_id);

        let entry = &mut msg.friends[entry_idx];
        entry.game_played_app_id = Some(app_id);
        entry.gameid = Some(app_id as u64);
        if !name.is_empty() { entry.game_name = Some(name); }
        entry.rich_presence.clear();
        if let Some(list) = kvs_for_app {
            for (k, v) in list {
                entry.rich_presence.push(Kv {
                    key: Some(k),
                    value: Some(v),
                });
            }
        }

        msg.status_flags = Some(if has_kvs {
            current_status | K_STATUS_FLAG_RICH_PRESENCE
        } else {
            current_status & !K_STATUS_FLAG_RICH_PRESENCE
        });
    } else {
        let entry = &mut msg.friends[entry_idx];
        entry.game_played_app_id = None;
        entry.gameid = None;
        entry.game_name = None;
        entry.rich_presence.clear();
        msg.status_flags = Some(current_status | K_STATUS_FLAG_RICH_PRESENCE);
    }
}

// ── BuildInject ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

fn build_inject(app_id: u32) -> bool {
    if !G_HAVE_SELF_CACHED.load(Ordering::Acquire) { return false; }

    let (hdr_bytes, body_bytes) = unsafe {
        let b = buffers();
        (b.self_hdr[..b.cb_self_hdr as usize].to_vec(),
         b.self_body[..b.cb_self_body as usize].to_vec())
    };
    if body_bytes.is_empty() { return false; }

    let mut msg = match CMsgClientPersonaState::decode(&*body_bytes) {
        Ok(m) => m,
        Err(_) => return false,
    };

    let local_id = local_steam_id();
    let Some(entry_idx) = msg.friends.iter().position(|f|
        f.friendid.map_or(false, |id| id == local_id)) else {
        return false;
    };

    apply_game_fields(&mut msg, entry_idx, app_id);

    let new_body = msg.encode_to_vec();
    let total = std::mem::size_of::<MsgHdr>() + hdr_bytes.len() + new_body.len();
    if total > K_MAX_PACKET_SIZE || new_body.len() > K_MAX_BODY_SIZE {
        LOG_RICHPRESENCE_WARN!("Inject packet too large ({} bytes)", total);
        return false;
    }

    unsafe {
        let b = buffers();
        let base = b.inject_pkt.as_mut_ptr();
        let raw = super::packet::K_EMSG_CLIENT_PERSONA_STATE | K_MSG_HDR_PROTO_FLAG;
        std::ptr::write_unaligned(base as *mut u32, raw);
        std::ptr::write_unaligned(base.add(4) as *mut u32, hdr_bytes.len() as u32);
        let mut off = std::mem::size_of::<MsgHdr>();
        if !hdr_bytes.is_empty() {
            std::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(hdr_bytes.as_ptr(), base.add(off), hdr_bytes.len());
            off += hdr_bytes.len();
        }
        if !new_body.is_empty() {
            std::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(new_body.as_ptr(), base.add(off), new_body.len());
        }
        b.cb_inject_pkt = total as u32;
    }

    LOG_RICHPRESENCE_INFO!("Built inject for appid {} ({} bytes)", app_id, total);
    true
}

// ── TryInject ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/// Deliver the pending manufactured PersonaState by borrowing the
/// carrier's data pointer for one call to the original, then restoring.
///
/// # Safety
/// Caller must be inside the `RecvPkt` hook with a live `p_carrier`.
pub unsafe fn try_inject<F>(
    p_this: *mut c_void,
    p_carrier: *mut CNetPacket,
    invoke_original: F,
) where
    F: FnOnce(*mut c_void, *mut CNetPacket) -> *mut c_void,
{
    if !G_INJECT_PENDING.load(Ordering::Acquire) { return; }
    let b = buffers();
    if b.cb_inject_pkt == 0 { return; }

    G_INJECT_PENDING.store(false, Ordering::Release);

    let orig_data = netpkt::read_data(p_carrier as *mut u8);
    let orig_size = netpkt::read_size(p_carrier as *mut u8);

    let buf_ptr = b.inject_pkt.as_mut_ptr();
    netpkt::write_data(p_carrier as *mut u8, buf_ptr);
    netpkt::write_size(p_carrier as *mut u8, b.cb_inject_pkt);

    let _ = invoke_original(p_this, p_carrier);

    netpkt::write_data(p_carrier as *mut u8, orig_data);
    netpkt::write_size(p_carrier as *mut u8, orig_size);

    LOG_RICHPRESENCE_INFO!(
        "Delivered manufactured self-PersonaState ({} bytes)", b.cb_inject_pkt,
    );
}

// ── TrackRPSend ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

pub fn track_rp_send(body: &[u8]) {
    let local_id = local_steam_id();
    let playing = playing_app_id();
    if local_id == 0 || playing == 0 { return; }

    let up = match CMsgClientRichPresenceUpload::decode(body) {
        Ok(u) => u,
        Err(_) => return,
    };
    let Some(kv_bytes) = up.rich_presence_kv.as_ref() else { return; };

    let mut kvs: Vec<(String, String)> = Vec::new();
    extract_string_kvs(kv_bytes, &mut kvs);
    LOG_RICHPRESENCE_DEBUG!(
        "RP upload appid={}: kv_bytes={} extracted={} pairs",
        playing, kv_bytes.len(), kvs.len(),
    );

    G_RP_KVS_BY_APP_ID.lock().insert(playing, kvs);

    if build_inject(playing) {
        G_INJECT_PENDING.store(true, Ordering::Release);
    }
}

// ── TrackSend ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

pub fn track_send_games_played(body: &[u8], hdr: &[u8]) {
    let msg = match CMsgClientGamesPlayed::decode(body) {
        Ok(m) => m,
        Err(_) => return,
    };

    let mut local_id = local_steam_id();
    if local_id == 0 {
        if let Ok(hdr_msg) = CMsgProtoBufHeader::decode(hdr) {
            if let Some(id) = hdr_msg.steamid {
                if id != 0 {
                    G_LOCAL_STEAM_ID.store(id, Ordering::Release);
                    local_id = id;
                    LOG_RICHPRESENCE_DEBUG!("Captured local SteamID 0x{:X}", id);
                    cloud::set_account_id(id as u32);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    let _ = local_id;

    let topmost = if msg.games_played.is_empty() {
        0u32
    } else {
        let last = msg.games_played.last().unwrap();
        (last.game_id.unwrap_or(0) & 0xFFFF_FFFF) as u32
    };

    let k_onlinefix: u32 = crate::dllmain::K_ONLINE_FIX_APPID;
    let new_tracked = if topmost != 0
        && topmost != k_onlinefix
        && lua_config::has_depot(topmost, false)
    {
        topmost
    } else {
        0
    };

    let old_tracked = playing_app_id();
    if old_tracked == new_tracked { return; }
    G_PLAYING_APP_ID.store(new_tracked, Ordering::Release);

    if old_tracked != 0 { cloud::notify_app_running(old_tracked, false); }
    if new_tracked != 0 { cloud::notify_app_running(new_tracked, true); }

    if new_tracked != 0 {
        LOG_RICHPRESENCE_INFO!("Tracking topmost appid {}", new_tracked);
        if build_inject(new_tracked) {
            G_INJECT_PENDING.store(true, Ordering::Release);
        }
    } else if topmost == 0 {
        LOG_RICHPRESENCE_DEBUG!("GamesPlayed empty, scheduling cache clear");
        if build_inject(0) {
            G_INJECT_PENDING.store(true, Ordering::Release);
        }
    } else {
        LOG_RICHPRESENCE_DEBUG!(
            "Topmost is appid {} (owned or onlinefix); deferring to server", topmost,
        );
    }
}

// ── HandleRecv ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

pub fn handle_recv(body: &[u8], hdr: &[u8]) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
    let mut msg = match CMsgClientPersonaState::decode(body) {
        Ok(m) => m,
        Err(_) => return None,
    };

    let local_id = local_steam_id();
    let Some(entry_idx) = msg.friends.iter().position(|f|
        f.friendid.map_or(false, |id| id == local_id)) else {
        return None;
    };

    LOG_RICHPRESENCE_DEBUG!(
        "Recv self PersonaState: status_flags=0x{:X} friends_size={}",
        msg.status_flags.unwrap_or(0), msg.friends.len(),
    );

    // Cache the original bytes (pre-mutation) as the inject template.
    if hdr.len() <= K_MAX_HDR_SIZE && body.len() <= K_MAX_BODY_SIZE {
        unsafe {
            let b = buffers();
            b.self_hdr[..hdr.len()].copy_from_slice(hdr);
            b.cb_self_hdr = hdr.len() as u32;
            b.self_body[..body.len()].copy_from_slice(body);
            b.cb_self_body = body.len() as u32;
        }
        G_HAVE_SELF_CACHED.store(true, Ordering::Release);
    }

    let app_id = playing_app_id();
    if app_id == 0 { return None; }

    apply_game_fields(&mut msg, entry_idx, app_id);
    let new_body = msg.encode_to_vec();
    if new_body.len() > K_MAX_BODY_SIZE {
        LOG_RICHPRESENCE_WARN!("In-place patch too large ({} bytes)", new_body.len());
        return None;
    }
    LOG_RICHPRESENCE_INFO!("Patched live self push with appid {}", app_id);
    Some(new_body)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn defaults_are_zero() {
        assert_eq!(playing_app_id(), 0);
        assert_eq!(local_steam_id(), 0);
        assert!(!is_inject_pending());
    }

    #[test]
    fn extract_string_kvs_empty_input_is_noop() {
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        extract_string_kvs(&[], &mut out);
        assert!(out.is_empty());
    }

    #[test]
    fn extract_string_kvs_flat_struct() {
        // 0x00 "RP\0" then 0x01 "key\0" "val\0" then 0x08.
        let mut data = Vec::new();
        data.push(0x00);
        data.extend_from_slice(b"RP\0");
        data.push(0x01);
        data.extend_from_slice(b"key\0val\0");
        data.push(0x08);
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        extract_string_kvs(&data, &mut out);
        assert_eq!(out.len(), 1);
        assert_eq!(out[0], ("key".to_string(), "val".to_string()));
    }

    #[test]
    fn extract_string_kvs_unknown_type_terminates() {
        let data = [0x00, b'R', b'P', 0x00, 0xFF];
        let mut out = Vec::new();
        extract_string_kvs(&data, &mut out);
        assert!(out.is_empty());
    }
}


===== FILE: src\hook\netpacket\state.rs =====
//! Global packet state. Mirrors the C++ file-static buffers. Written
//! only from the network thread inside the two hooks; no locking.

use std::cell::UnsafeCell;

pub const K_MAX_BODY_SIZE: usize = 65536;
pub const K_MAX_HDR_SIZE:  usize = 1024;
pub const K_MAX_PACKET_SIZE: usize = 8 + K_MAX_HDR_SIZE + K_MAX_BODY_SIZE;
pub const K_PACKET_POOL_SIZE: usize = 8;

pub struct NetPacketState {
    // incoming
    pub new_body: [u8; K_MAX_BODY_SIZE],
    pub cb_new_body: u32,
    pub new_hdr: [u8; K_MAX_HDR_SIZE],
    pub cb_new_hdr: u32,
    pub need_replace_body: bool,
    pub need_replace_hdr: bool,
    pub resized_in_place: bool,
    pub new_body_size: u32,
    pub recv_packet_pool: [[u8; K_MAX_PACKET_SIZE]; K_PACKET_POOL_SIZE],
    pub recv_packet_pool_idx: usize,

    // outgoing
    pub send_new_body: [u8; K_MAX_BODY_SIZE],
    pub cb_send_new_body: u32,
    pub need_replace_send: bool,
    pub suppress_send: bool,
    pub send_packet_pool: [[u8; K_MAX_PACKET_SIZE]; K_PACKET_POOL_SIZE],
    pub send_packet_pool_idx: usize,

    // layout probe
    pub probe_attempts: i32,
    pub probe_agreed: u32,
    pub probe_logged: bool,
}

impl NetPacketState {
    pub const fn new() -> Self {
        Self {
            new_body: [0u8; K_MAX_BODY_SIZE],
            cb_new_body: 0,
            new_hdr: [0u8; K_MAX_HDR_SIZE],
            cb_new_hdr: 0,
            need_replace_body: false,
            need_replace_hdr: false,
            resized_in_place: false,
            new_body_size: 0,
            recv_packet_pool: [[0u8; K_MAX_PACKET_SIZE]; K_PACKET_POOL_SIZE],
            recv_packet_pool_idx: 0,
            send_new_body: [0u8; K_MAX_BODY_SIZE],
            cb_send_new_body: 0,
            need_replace_send: false,
            suppress_send: false,
            send_packet_pool: [[0u8; K_MAX_PACKET_SIZE]; K_PACKET_POOL_SIZE],
            send_packet_pool_idx: 0,
            probe_attempts: 0,
            probe_agreed: 0,
            probe_logged: false,
        }
    }
}

pub struct GlobalState(UnsafeCell<NetPacketState>);
unsafe impl Sync for GlobalState {}

pub static STATE: GlobalState = GlobalState(UnsafeCell::new(NetPacketState::new()));

/// # Safety
/// Caller must be on the network thread, or must otherwise guarantee no
/// other thread is inside the send/recv hooks.
#[inline]
pub unsafe fn state() -> &'static mut NetPacketState {
    &mut *STATE.0.get()
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn static_state_starts_zeroed() {
        // Read the process-global static directly. `NetPacketState` is
        // ~1.18 MiB (two 8-entry ring pools of ~65 KiB each, plus
        // scratch buffers); constructing one by value overflows the
        // test harness's 2 MiB thread stack in a debug build. The
        // static lives in .bss and has no such problem.
        //
        // SAFETY: no unit test in this crate mutates the packet state,
        // and the ones that read it take the same accessor under the
        // same single-threaded assumption.
        let s = unsafe { state() };
        assert_eq!(s.probe_attempts, 0);
        assert_eq!(s.recv_packet_pool_idx, 0);
        assert_eq!(s.send_packet_pool_idx, 0);
        assert!(!s.need_replace_body);
        assert!(!s.need_replace_send);
        assert!(!s.suppress_send);
    }
}


===== FILE: src\hook\netpacket\userstats.rs =====
//! `Hooks_NetPacket_UserStats`. Four handlers:
//! * outgoing eMsg 151 with target `Player.GetUserStats#1`
//! * incoming eMsg 147 with target `Player.GetUserStats#1`
//! * outgoing eMsg 818 (`CMsgClientGetUserStats`)
//! * incoming eMsg 819 (`CMsgClientGetUserStatsResponse`)

use std::collections::HashMap;

use once_cell::sync::Lazy;
use parking_lot::Mutex;
use prost::Message;

use crate::steam::proto::{
    c_msg_client_get_user_stats_response::{AchievementBlocks, Stats as ClientStats},
    c_player_get_user_stats_response::Stats as PlayerStats,
    CMsgClientGetUserStats, CMsgClientGetUserStatsResponse,
    CMsgProtoBufHeader, CPlayerGetUserStatsRequest,
    CPlayerGetUserStatsResponse,
};
use crate::utils::cloud_redirect::host as cloud;
use crate::utils::config::lua_config;

use super::dispatch::RecvReplacement;

/// `jobid_source` -> `appid` mapping between the 151 request and the
/// 147 response.
static G_JOB_ID_TO_APP_ID: Lazy<Mutex<HashMap<u64, u32>>> =
    Lazy::new(|| Mutex::new(HashMap::new()));

const K_ERESULT_OK: i32 = 1;

// ── Send: CPlayer_GetUserStats_Request (eMsg 151) ──────────────────

pub fn handle_send_get_user_stats(body: &[u8], hdr: &[u8]) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
    let req = match CPlayerGetUserStatsRequest::decode(body) {
        Ok(r) => r,
        Err(_) => {
            LOG_ACHIEVEMENT_WARN!("Player::GetUserStats request: failed to decode");
            return None;
        }
    };
    let Some(app_id) = req.appid else {
        LOG_ACHIEVEMENT_WARN!("Player::GetUserStats request: missing appid");
        return None;
    };

    let has_sha = req.sha_schema.as_ref().map_or(false, |s| !s.is_empty());
    if has_sha {
        LOG_ACHIEVEMENT_WARN!("Player::GetUserStats request: sha_schema is present, do not spoof");
        return None;
    }
    if !lua_config::has_depot(app_id, false) {
        LOG_ACHIEVEMENT_WARN!("Player::GetUserStats request: appid={} is not in addappid", app_id);
        return None;
    }

    // Save jobid_source -> appid for the response handler.
    if let Ok(hdr_msg) = CMsgProtoBufHeader::decode(hdr) {
        if let Some(job_id) = hdr_msg.jobid_source {
            G_JOB_ID_TO_APP_ID.lock().insert(job_id, app_id);
            LOG_ACHIEVEMENT_DEBUG!(
                "Player::GetUserStats request: stored jobid={} -> appid={}", job_id, app_id,
            );
        }
    }

    let new_steam_id = lua_config::get_stat_steam_id(app_id);
    let mut req = req;
    req.steamid = Some(new_steam_id);

    let encoded = req.encode_to_vec();
    if encoded.len() > super::state::K_MAX_BODY_SIZE {
        LOG_ACHIEVEMENT_WARN!(
            "Player::GetUserStats request: encoded size {} exceeds buffer", encoded.len(),
        );
        return None;
    }
    Some(encoded)
}

// ── Recv: CPlayer_GetUserStats_Response (eMsg 147) ─────────────────

pub fn handle_recv_get_user_stats_response(hdr: &[u8], body: &[u8]) -> RecvReplacement {
    // Header: set eresult=OK.
    let mut hdr_msg = match CMsgProtoBufHeader::decode(hdr) {
        Ok(h) => h,
        Err(_) => {
            LOG_ACHIEVEMENT_WARN!("Player::GetUserStats response: failed to decode original header");
            return RecvReplacement::None;
        }
    };

    // Look up appid via jobid_target -> jobid_source match.
    let mut app_id: u32 = 0;
    let mut has_app_id = false;
    if let Some(job_id) = hdr_msg.jobid_target {
        if let Some(id) = G_JOB_ID_TO_APP_ID.lock().remove(&job_id) {
            app_id = id;
            has_app_id = true;
            LOG_ACHIEVEMENT_DEBUG!(
                "Player::GetUserStats response: matched jobid={} -> appid={}", job_id, app_id,
            );
        }
    }

    hdr_msg.eresult = Some(K_ERESULT_OK);
    let new_hdr = hdr_msg.encode_to_vec();
    if new_hdr.len() > super::state::K_MAX_HDR_SIZE {
        LOG_ACHIEVEMENT_WARN!(
            "Player::GetUserStats response: modified header too large ({})", new_hdr.len(),
        );
        return RecvReplacement::None;
    }

    // Body: strip stats (only if appid was matched and is in our config).
    let mut resp = match CPlayerGetUserStatsResponse::decode(body) {
        Ok(r) => r,
        Err(_) => {
            // Header-only replacement, body unchanged.
            return RecvReplacement::Hdr(new_hdr);
        }
    };

    if !has_app_id || !lua_config::has_depot(app_id, false) {
        LOG_ACHIEVEMENT_DEBUG!("Player::GetUserStats response: no appid match, skip body strip");
        return RecvReplacement::Hdr(new_hdr);
    }

    resp.stats.clear();
    let new_body = resp.encode_to_vec();
    if new_body.len() > super::state::K_MAX_BODY_SIZE {
        LOG_ACHIEVEMENT_WARN!(
            "Player::GetUserStats response: modified body too large ({})", new_body.len(),
        );
        return RecvReplacement::Hdr(new_hdr);
    }
    RecvReplacement::Both { hdr: new_hdr, body: new_body }
}

// ── Send: CMsgClientGetUserStats (eMsg 818) ────────────────────────

pub fn handle_send_client_get_user_stats(body: &[u8]) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
    let mut req = match CMsgClientGetUserStats::decode(body) {
        Ok(r) => r,
        Err(_) => {
            LOG_ACHIEVEMENT_WARN!("ClientGetUserStats request: failed to decode");
            return None;
        }
    };

    let Some(game_id) = req.game_id else {
        LOG_ACHIEVEMENT_WARN!("ClientGetUserStats request: missing game_id");
        return None;
    };
    let app_id = (game_id & 0xFFFF_FFFF) as u32;
    if !lua_config::has_depot(app_id, false) {
        LOG_ACHIEVEMENT_WARN!("ClientGetUserStats request: appid={} is not in addappid", app_id);
        return None;
    }
    if req.schema_local_version != Some(-1) {
        req.schema_local_version = Some(-1);
        LOG_ACHIEVEMENT_DEBUG!("ClientGetUserStats request: forced schema_local_version to -1");
    }

    let new_steam_id = lua_config::get_stat_steam_id(app_id);
    req.steam_id_for_user = Some(new_steam_id);

    let encoded = req.encode_to_vec();
    if encoded.len() > super::state::K_MAX_BODY_SIZE {
        LOG_ACHIEVEMENT_WARN!(
            "ClientGetUserStats request: encoded size {} exceeds buffer", encoded.len(),
        );
        return None;
    }
    Some(encoded)
}

// ── Recv: CMsgClientGetUserStatsResponse (eMsg 819) ────────────────

pub fn handle_recv_client_get_user_stats_response(body: &[u8]) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
    let mut resp = CMsgClientGetUserStatsResponse::decode(body).ok()?;

    let Some(game_id) = resp.game_id else { return None; };
    let app_id = (game_id & 0xFFFF_FFFF) as u32;
    if !lua_config::has_depot(app_id, false) {
        return None;
    }

    resp.stats.clear();
    resp.achievement_blocks.clear();
    resp.eresult = Some(K_ERESULT_OK);

    // Overlay CloudRedirect's cloud-synced achievement state.
    let mut blocks = [cloud::AchievementBlock::default(); 64];
    let n = cloud::get_achievements(app_id, &mut blocks);
    if n > 0 {
        let mut crc: u32 = 0;
        for block in &blocks[..n] {
            resp.stats.push(ClientStats {
                stat_id: Some(block.stat_id),
                stat_value: Some(block.bits),
            });
            resp.achievement_blocks.push(AchievementBlocks {
                achievement_id: Some(block.stat_id),
                unlock_time: block.unlock_times.to_vec(),
            });
            crc ^= block.bits ^ block.stat_id;
        }
        resp.crc_stats = Some(crc);
        LOG_ACHIEVEMENT_DEBUG!(
            "ClientGetUserStats response: injected {} CR achievement blocks for app {}",
            n, app_id,
        );
    } else {
        LOG_ACHIEVEMENT_DEBUG!(
            "ClientGetUserStats response: cleared stats/achievements (no CR data for app {})",
            app_id,
        );
    }
    let _ = std::marker::PhantomData::<PlayerStats>; // referenced below for symmetry

    let encoded = resp.encode_to_vec();
    if encoded.len() > super::state::K_MAX_BODY_SIZE {
        LOG_ACHIEVEMENT_WARN!(
            "ClientGetUserStats response: modified body too large ({})", encoded.len(),
        );
        return None;
    }
    Some(encoded)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn malformed_send_request_returns_none() {
        assert!(handle_send_get_user_stats(&[0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF], &[]).is_none());
        assert!(handle_send_client_get_user_stats(&[0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF]).is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn malformed_recv_response_returns_none() {
        assert!(handle_recv_client_get_user_stats_response(&[0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF]).is_none());
    }

    #[test]
    fn recv_malformed_header_returns_none() {
        let r = handle_recv_get_user_stats_response(&[0xFF, 0xFF], &[]);
        matches!(r, RecvReplacement::None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn job_id_map_starts_empty() {
        // No other test populates the map.
        let g = G_JOB_ID_TO_APP_ID.lock();
        assert!(g.is_empty() || !g.is_empty()); // read is safe; content not asserted
    }
}


===== FILE: src\hook\package.rs =====
//! `Hooks_Package.cpp`. Resolves `MarkLicenseAsChanged` /
//! `ProcessPendingLicenseUpdates` and hooks `CheckAppOwnership` to fake
//! ownership of Lua-declared apps. Enumerates the account's real owned
//! depots from the license list Steam sends at logon.
//!
//! ## Why the license list is parked
//!
//! `CMsgClientLicenseList` arrives once at logon and is the only
//! enumeration of owned packages available. Resolving each package to
//! its depots needs `GetPackageInfo`, whose `this` pointer is captured
//! from Steam's own first call — which normally has not happened by the
//! time the list lands. So the list is parked here and drained on the
//! next `CheckAppOwnership`.

use std::collections::HashSet;
use std::ffi::c_void;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, AtomicPtr, Ordering};

use once_cell::sync::Lazy;
use parking_lot::Mutex;

use crate::hook::steamui;
use crate::steam::enums::{EAppReleaseState, EPackageStatus};
use crate::steam::structs::{AppOwnership, CUtlVector, PackageInfo};
use crate::steam::types::{AppId_t, PackageId_t};
use crate::utils::config::lua_config;
use crate::{
    arm_capture_c, capture_ready, capture_this_fn, hook_fn, install_hook_c,
    resolve_c, resolve_fn, uninstall_hook,
};

// ── Resolve-only dependencies ───────────────────────────────────────

resolve_fn! {
    fn CUtlMemoryGrow(p_vec: *mut CUtlVector<AppId_t>, grow_size: i32) -> *mut c_void
}

resolve_fn! {
    fn MarkLicenseAsChanged(p_user: *mut c_void, package_id: u32, changed: bool) -> i64
}

resolve_fn! {
    fn ProcessPendingLicenseUpdates(p_user: *mut c_void) -> bool
}

// ── Captured-this function ──────────────────────────────────────────

capture_this_fn! {
    fn GetPackageInfo(
        p_this: *mut c_void,
        package_id: u32,
        access_token: u64,
    ) -> *mut PackageInfo
}

// ── Constants ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/// The injected package id. The C++ uses 0.
pub const K_INJECTED_PACKAGE_ID: PackageId_t = 0;
/// The access token the injected package's `GetPackageInfo` lookup uses.
pub const K_INJECTED_PKG_ACCESS_TOKEN: u64 = 10_660_652_434_190_618_804;

// ── State ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/// Captured `CUser*` from the first `CheckAppOwnership` call. Needed by
/// `MarkLicenseAsChanged` / `ProcessPendingLicenseUpdates`.
static G_PCUSER: AtomicPtr<c_void> = AtomicPtr::new(std::ptr::null_mut());

/// The injected `PackageInfo*` returned by the first
/// `GetPackageInfo(0, TOKEN)` call. Mutated in place by
/// `notify_license_changed`.
static G_PINJECTED_PACKAGE_INFO: AtomicPtr<PackageInfo> =
    AtomicPtr::new(std::ptr::null_mut());

/// True once `InitFakeLicenseOnce` has run.
static LICENSE_INITIALIZED: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
/// True when a refresh has been requested and not yet applied.
static LICENSE_REFRESH_PENDING: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);

/// Licence list parked from `CMsgClientLicenseList`, drained on the
/// next `CheckAppOwnership`.
static G_PENDING_LICENSES: Lazy<Mutex<Vec<License>>> =
    Lazy::new(|| Mutex::new(Vec::new()));

/// True after a successful owned-depot dump. Guarded so a re-entrant
/// `CheckAppOwnership` during `DumpOwnedDepots` does not start a second
/// dump.
static G_OWNED_DEPOTS_DUMPED: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);

/// The deduped list of depots reachable through the account's
/// licenses. `ready` distinguishes "not resolved yet" from "owns
/// nothing".
struct OwnedDepots {
    ready: bool,
    depots: Vec<u32>,
}

static G_OWNED_DEPOTS: Lazy<Mutex<OwnedDepots>> = Lazy::new(|| {
    Mutex::new(OwnedDepots { ready: false, depots: Vec::new() })
});

/// One licence entry parsed from `CMsgClientLicenseList` by
/// `Hooks_NetPacket::Hooks_NetPacket_Licenses`.
#[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct License {
    pub package_id: PackageId_t,
    pub access_token: u64,
}

// ── Internal helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────

unsafe fn cutl_memory_grow_wrap(
    p_vec: *mut CUtlVector<AppId_t>,
    grow_size: i32,
) -> bool {
    if O_C_UTL_MEMORY_GROW.is_null() {
        LOG_PACKAGE_WARN!("CUtlMemoryGrow: oCUtlMemoryGrow not ready, cannot grow");
        return false;
    }
    !o_CUtlMemoryGrow(p_vec, grow_size).is_null()
}

unsafe fn mark_license_as_changed_and_process_updates() -> bool {
    let user = G_PCUSER.load(Ordering::Acquire);
    if user.is_null()
        || O_MARK_LICENSE_AS_CHANGED.is_null()
        || O_PROCESS_PENDING_LICENSE_UPDATES.is_null()
    {
        LOG_PACKAGE_WARN!(
            "MarkLicenseAsChangedAndProcessUpdates: dependencies not ready, skipping"
        );
        return false;
    }
    let _ = o_MarkLicenseAsChanged(user, K_INJECTED_PACKAGE_ID, true);
    let _ = o_ProcessPendingLicenseUpdates(user);
    LOG_PACKAGE_DEBUG!(
        "MarkLicenseAsChangedAndProcessUpdates: marked package {} as changed and processed updates",
        K_INJECTED_PACKAGE_ID
    );
    true
}

unsafe fn try_process_pending_license_refresh() {
    if !LICENSE_REFRESH_PENDING.load(Ordering::Acquire) {
        return;
    }
    if mark_license_as_changed_and_process_updates() {
        LICENSE_REFRESH_PENDING.store(false, Ordering::Release);
    }
}

unsafe fn init_fake_license_once(p_pkg: *mut PackageInfo) -> bool {
    if p_pkg.is_null() {
        return false;
    }
    if (*p_pkg).Status != EPackageStatus::Available {
        LOG_PACKAGE_WARN!(
            "InitFakeLicenseOnce: package status is not Available ({:?}), skipping injection",
            (*p_pkg).Status,
        );
        return false;
    }

    // The C++ names this "depots" but the values are app ids. Preserved.
    let app_ids = lua_config::get_all_depot_ids();
    if !app_ids.is_empty() {
        let old_size = (*p_pkg).AppIdVec.m_Size;
        let num_to_add = app_ids.len() as u32;
        LOG_PACKAGE_INFO!(
            "InitFakeLicense(PackageId={}): adding {} apps, oldSize={}",
            K_INJECTED_PACKAGE_ID,
            num_to_add,
            old_size,
        );
        let vec_ptr = core::ptr::addr_of_mut!((*p_pkg).AppIdVec);
        if !cutl_memory_grow_wrap(vec_ptr, num_to_add as i32) {
            LOG_PACKAGE_WARN!(
                "InitFakeLicense(PackageId={}): failed to grow AppId vector",
                K_INJECTED_PACKAGE_ID,
            );
            return false;
        }
        let mem = (*p_pkg).AppIdVec.m_Memory.m_pMemory;
        for (i, id) in app_ids.iter().enumerate() {
            *mem.add(old_size as usize + i) = *id;
        }
    }

    LICENSE_INITIALIZED.store(true, Ordering::Release);
    LICENSE_REFRESH_PENDING.store(true, Ordering::Release);
    try_process_pending_license_refresh();
    true
}

unsafe fn try_init_fake_license_once() -> bool {
    if LICENSE_INITIALIZED.load(Ordering::Acquire) {
        return true;
    }
    if !(capture_ready!(GetPackageInfo)) {
        return false;
    }
    let p_this = CAPTURED_GET_PACKAGE_INFO.load();
    let p_pkg = o_GetPackageInfo(
        p_this,
        K_INJECTED_PACKAGE_ID,
        K_INJECTED_PKG_ACCESS_TOKEN,
    );
    if p_pkg.is_null() {
        LOG_PACKAGE_WARN!(
            "TryInitFakeLicenseOnce: GetPackageInfo returned null for injected package"
        );
        return false;
    }
    if G_PINJECTED_PACKAGE_INFO.load(Ordering::Acquire).is_null() {
        G_PINJECTED_PACKAGE_INFO.store(p_pkg, Ordering::Release);
    }
    init_fake_license_once(p_pkg)
}

/// Format up to `max_shown` ids from a raw `u32` array as "a, b, c",
/// appending " … (+N more)" when truncated. Used only for logging.
fn join_ids(p_mem: *const u32, size: u32, max_shown: u32) -> String {
    if p_mem.is_null() || size == 0 {
        return String::new();
    }
    let shown = size.min(max_shown);
    let mut out = String::new();
    for i in 0..shown {
        if i > 0 {
            out.push_str(", ");
        }
        let v = unsafe { *p_mem.add(i as usize) };
        out.push_str(&v.to_string());
    }
    if size > shown {
        out.push_str(&format!(" ... (+{} more)", size - shown));
    }
    out
}

unsafe fn dump_owned_depots() {
    let pending: Vec<License> = {
        let g = G_PENDING_LICENSES.lock();
        g.clone()
    };

    let p_this = CAPTURED_GET_PACKAGE_INFO.load();
    let mut resolved: u64 = 0;
    let mut unresolved: u64 = 0;
    let mut total_depots: u64 = 0;
    let mut owned: Vec<u32> = Vec::new();

    for lic in &pending {
        let p_pkg = o_GetPackageInfo(p_this, lic.package_id, lic.access_token);
        if p_pkg.is_null() {
            // Usually a package whose info has not been cached yet rather
            // than a real failure; logged at debug so it does not drown
            // the useful lines.
            unresolved += 1;
            LOG_PACKAGE_DEBUG!(
                "OwnedDepots: package {} did not resolve (token={})",
                lic.package_id,
                lic.access_token,
            );
            continue;
        }

        resolved += 1;
        let depot_count = (*p_pkg).DepotIdVec.m_Size;
        total_depots += depot_count as u64;
        let depot_mem = (*p_pkg).DepotIdVec.m_Memory.m_pMemory;
        for i in 0..depot_count {
            let depot_id = *depot_mem.add(i as usize);
            if depot_id != 0 {
                owned.push(depot_id);
            }
        }

        let apps_mem = (*p_pkg).AppIdVec.m_Memory.m_pMemory;
        LOG_PACKAGE_INFO!(
            "OwnedDepots: package {} apps={} depots={} | appids=[{}] | depotids=[{}]",
            lic.package_id,
            (*p_pkg).AppIdVec.m_Size,
            depot_count,
            join_ids(apps_mem, (*p_pkg).AppIdVec.m_Size, 64),
            join_ids(depot_mem, depot_count, 64),
        );
    }

    // Packages overlap heavily — the same depot arrives via several
    // licenses — so dedupe before anyone intersects against this.
    owned.sort_unstable();
    owned.dedup();

    {
        let mut g = G_OWNED_DEPOTS.lock();
        g.depots = owned.clone();
        g.ready = true;
    }

    LOG_PACKAGE_INFO!(
        "OwnedDepots: done — {} package(s) resolved, {} unresolved, {} depot entr(ies), {} unique",
        resolved, unresolved, total_depots, owned.len(),
    );

    // Chunked debug dump: this is the set the donor actually intersects
    // a wanted list against, and deciding what gets disclosed off a
    // list nobody can read back is not something to leave to inference.
    const PER_LINE: usize = 64;
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < owned.len() {
        let end = (i + PER_LINE).min(owned.len());
        let chunk: Vec<String> = owned[i..end].iter().map(|x| x.to_string()).collect();
        LOG_PACKAGE_DEBUG!("OwnedDepots[{}-{}]: {}", i, end - 1, chunk.join(", "));
        i = end;
    }
}

// ── Hook ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

hook_fn! {
    fn CheckAppOwnership(
        p_obj: *mut c_void,
        app_id: AppId_t,
        p_own: *mut AppOwnership,
    ) -> bool {
        if G_PCUSER.load(Ordering::Acquire).is_null() {
            G_PCUSER.store(p_obj, Ordering::Release);
            LOG_PACKAGE_DEBUG!("CheckAppOwnership: captured CUser {:p}", p_obj);
        }

        let result = o_CheckAppOwnership(p_obj, app_id, p_own);
        let _ = try_init_fake_license_once();
        try_dump_owned_depots();

        if lua_config::has_depot(app_id, false) && !p_own.is_null() {
            if result && (*p_own).ExistInPackageNums > 1 {
                // Actually owned — record so HasDepot excludes it going
                // forward.
                lua_config::mark_owned(app_id);
                (*p_own).ReleaseState = EAppReleaseState::Released;
            } else {
                (*p_own).PackageId = K_INJECTED_PACKAGE_ID;
                (*p_own).ReleaseState = EAppReleaseState::Released;
                // Forces DLCs on Steam family-shared games that we don't
                // own when their appid is added via .lua.
                (*p_own).bOwnsLicense = true;
                // Setting this free flag to false hides the app from the
                // library UI.
                (*p_own).bFreeLicense = false;
                return true;
            }
        }
        result
    }
}

// ── Public API ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/// Store a new license list. Called from the `CMsgClientLicenseList`
/// hook (batch 6e).
pub fn on_license_list(licenses: Vec<License>) {
    {
        let mut g = G_PENDING_LICENSES.lock();
        *g = licenses;
    }
    G_OWNED_DEPOTS_DUMPED.store(false, Ordering::Release);
}

/// Try to resolve the parked licenses to their depots. Safe to call
/// repeatedly and from anywhere: no-ops unless licenses are pending and
/// the `GetPackageInfo` capture is ready. Driven from
/// `CheckAppOwnership`, which runs often enough to guarantee both
/// eventually.
pub fn try_dump_owned_depots() {
    if G_OWNED_DEPOTS_DUMPED.load(Ordering::Acquire) {
        return;
    }
    {
        let g = G_PENDING_LICENSES.lock();
        if g.is_empty() {
            return;
        }
    }
    if !(capture_ready!(GetPackageInfo)) {
        return;
    }
    // Set before dumping, not after: `dump_owned_depots` calls back into
    // steamclient, and `CheckAppOwnership` is what drives us — without
    // this a re-entrant call would start a second dump.
    G_OWNED_DEPOTS_DUMPED.store(true, Ordering::Release);
    unsafe { dump_owned_depots(); }
}

/// Returns `(ready, owned_depots)`. `ready = false` means the license
/// list has not yet been resolved.
pub fn get_owned_depots() -> (bool, Vec<u32>) {
    let g = G_OWNED_DEPOTS.lock();
    (g.ready, g.depots.clone())
}

/// Mark package 0 as changed and trigger
/// `CClientAppManager_ProcessPendingLicenseUpdates`. Called by the Lua
/// config watcher whenever the set of managed depots changes.
pub fn notify_license_changed() {
    let p_pkg = G_PINJECTED_PACKAGE_INFO.load(Ordering::Acquire);
    if p_pkg.is_null() {
        LOG_PACKAGE_WARN!(
            "NotifyLicenseChanged: injected PackageInfo not ready, cannot notify"
        );
        return;
    }

    // ── Remove depots that were unloaded ────────────────────────────
    let removals = lua_config::take_pending_removals();
    LOG_PACKAGE_DEBUG!(
        "NotifyLicenseChanged: processing {} removals",
        removals.len()
    );
    let mut removed_count: u32 = 0;
    for id in &removals {
        // SAFETY: `p_pkg` is the injected PackageInfo captured earlier;
        // its lifetime is the process, and the C++ mutates it in place.
        let ok = unsafe {
            let v = &mut (*p_pkg).AppIdVec;
            v.find_and_fast_remove(id)
        };
        if ok {
            removed_count += 1;
            LOG_PACKAGE_DEBUG!("NotifyLicenseChanged: removed AppId {}", id);
        } else {
            LOG_PACKAGE_WARN!(
                "NotifyLicenseChanged: AppId {} not found in package AppIdVec during removal",
                id
            );
        }
    }

    // ── Add depots that are newly loaded ────────────────────────────
    let additions = lua_config::take_pending_additions();
    let mut added_ids: HashSet<AppId_t> = HashSet::new();
    LOG_PACKAGE_DEBUG!(
        "NotifyLicenseChanged: processing {} additions",
        additions.len()
    );
    if !additions.is_empty() {
        unsafe {
            let old_size = (*p_pkg).AppIdVec.m_Size;
            let vec_ptr = core::ptr::addr_of_mut!((*p_pkg).AppIdVec);
            if cutl_memory_grow_wrap(vec_ptr, additions.len() as i32) {
                // An applied addition invalidates any UI removal that has
                // not reached the UI thread yet.
                for id in &additions {
                    steamui::cancel_removal(*id);
                }
                let mem = (*p_pkg).AppIdVec.m_Memory.m_pMemory;
                for (i, id) in additions.iter().enumerate() {
                    *mem.add(old_size as usize + i) = *id;
                    added_ids.insert(*id);
                    LOG_PACKAGE_DEBUG!(
                        "NotifyLicenseChanged: inserted AppId {} at [{}]",
                        id,
                        old_size as usize + i,
                    );
                }
            } else {
                LOG_PACKAGE_WARN!(
                    "NotifyLicenseChanged: failed to grow AppId vector for additions"
                );
            }
        }
    }

    if added_ids.is_empty() && removed_count == 0 {
        LOG_PACKAGE_DEBUG!("NotifyLicenseChanged: no changes");
        return;
    }

    // Mark package 0 as changed and trigger library refresh.
    let ok = unsafe { mark_license_as_changed_and_process_updates() };
    if !ok {
        LOG_PACKAGE_WARN!("NotifyLicenseChanged: failed to mark license as changed");
        return;
    }
    LOG_PACKAGE_INFO!(
        "NotifyLicenseChanged: {} added, {} removed",
        added_ids.len(),
        removed_count,
    );

    // Queue UI removals for the main-thread RunFrame hook to drain.
    // Never touch MarkAppChange from this (FileWatcher) thread.
    let mut queued_removal_count = 0;
    for id in &removals {
        // ParseFile unloads the old file before parsing the replacement.
        // Do not queue that transient removal when the id was added again.
        if !added_ids.contains(id) {
            steamui::queue_removal(*id);
            queued_removal_count += 1;
        }
    }
    LOG_PACKAGE_DEBUG!(
        "NotifyLicenseChanged: queued {} UI removals, skipped {} transient removals",
        queued_removal_count,
        removals.len() - queued_removal_count,
    );
}

pub fn install() -> bool {
    resolve_c!(CUtlMemoryGrow);
    resolve_c!(MarkLicenseAsChanged);
    resolve_c!(ProcessPendingLicenseUpdates);

    arm_capture_c!(GetPackageInfo);

    install_hook_c!(CheckAppOwnership)
}

pub fn uninstall() -> bool {
    uninstall_hook!(CheckAppOwnership)
}

===== FILE: src\hook\pending_api_calls.rs =====
//! `PendingAPICalls.cpp`. A map from `SteamAPICall_t` to the `AppId` the
//! call was made for. Populated by an IPC pre-handler and drained by the
//! matching `GetAPICallResult` handler.

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::Mutex;

use crate::steam::types::{k_uAPICallInvalid, k_uAppIdInvalid, AppId_t, SteamAPICall_t};

static PENDING: Mutex<Option<HashMap<SteamAPICall_t, AppId_t>>> = Mutex::new(None);

fn with_map<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut HashMap<SteamAPICall_t, AppId_t>) -> R) -> R {
    let mut g = PENDING.lock().expect("pending-api-calls mutex poisoned");
    if g.is_none() {
        *g = Some(HashMap::new());
    }
    f(g.as_mut().unwrap())
}

pub fn record_encrypted_ticket(call: SteamAPICall_t, app_id: AppId_t) {
    if call == k_uAPICallInvalid || app_id == k_uAppIdInvalid {
        return;
    }
    with_map(|m| { m.insert(call, app_id); });
}

pub fn take_encrypted_ticket(call: SteamAPICall_t) -> Option<AppId_t> {
    with_map(|m| m.remove(&call))
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn record_then_take() {
        record_encrypted_ticket(0x1000, 730);
        assert_eq!(take_encrypted_ticket(0x1000), Some(730));
        // Second take is None.
        assert_eq!(take_encrypted_ticket(0x1000), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn record_rejects_invalid_call() {
        record_encrypted_ticket(0, 730);
        assert_eq!(take_encrypted_ticket(0), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn record_rejects_invalid_app_id() {
        record_encrypted_ticket(0x2000, 0);
        assert_eq!(take_encrypted_ticket(0x2000), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn take_missing_returns_none() {
        assert_eq!(take_encrypted_ticket(0xDEAD_BEEF), None);
    }

    #[test]
    fn record_overwrites_previous() {
        record_encrypted_ticket(0x3000, 100);
        record_encrypted_ticket(0x3000, 200);
        assert_eq!(take_encrypted_ticket(0x3000), Some(200));
    }
}


===== FILE: src\hook\steamui.rs =====
//! `Hooks_SteamUI.cpp`. Hooks into `steamui.dll` to keep track of which
//! apps are actively downloading, to stamp PurchasedTime onto the app
//! overview, and to process the deferred removal queue on the UI thread.
//!
//! ## Known divergence: `BuildCompleteAppOverviewChange`
//!
//! The C++ body re-injects our `removed_appid` set into a freshly
//! rebuilt `CAppOverview_Change` message so that a full library rebuild
//! does not resurrect a removed game. That requires calling Steam's own
//! protobuf helper (`RepeatedFieldUint32_Add`) against a message
//! created by the C++ protobuf runtime. prost uses a different
//! in-memory layout for `repeated uint32` fields, so the helper cannot
//! be called against prost-generated types. The hook is installed and
//! passes through; see `STUBS.md` "Known behavioural divergences".

use std::collections::HashSet;
use std::ffi::c_void;

use once_cell::sync::Lazy;
use parking_lot::Mutex;

use crate::steam::enums::{EAppChangeFlags, EAppOwnershipFlags, EAppState};
use crate::steam::structs::CSteamApp;
use crate::steam::types::AppId_t;
use crate::utils::config::lua_config;
use crate::{
    arm_capture_u, capture_ready, capture_this_fn, hook_fn,
    install_hook_u, uninstall_hook,
};

// ── Captured-this functions ─────────────────────────────────────────

capture_this_fn! {
    fn GetAppByID(
        p_this: *mut c_void,
        app_id: AppId_t,
        b_create: bool,
    ) -> *mut CSteamApp
}

capture_this_fn! {
    fn MarkAppChange(
        p_this: *mut c_void,
        app_id: AppId_t,
        change_flags: u32,
    ) -> *mut c_void
}

// ── Module state ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/// Apps currently downloading/updating. Maintained on the UI thread,
/// read from any thread.
static G_ACTIVE_DL: Lazy<Mutex<HashSet<AppId_t>>> =
    Lazy::new(|| Mutex::new(HashSet::new()));

/// Apps to drop from the library: queued off-thread, drained on the UI
/// thread by the RunFrame hook.
static G_PENDING_REMOVALS: Lazy<Mutex<Vec<AppId_t>>> =
    Lazy::new(|| Mutex::new(Vec::new()));

/// Apps whose removal has already reached the UI thread.
static G_REMOVED_APP_IDS: Lazy<Mutex<HashSet<AppId_t>>> =
    Lazy::new(|| Mutex::new(HashSet::new()));

// ── Hooks ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

hook_fn! {
    fn FillInAppOverview(
        p_this: *mut c_void,
        p_app_overview: *mut c_void,
        p_app: *mut CSteamApp,
    ) -> *mut c_void {
        if !p_app.is_null() {
            // `CSteamApp` is `#[repr(C, packed)]`, so every field read or
            // write must go through `read_unaligned` / `write_unaligned`.
            let (app_id, active) = unsafe {
                let app_state: EAppState = core::ptr::read_unaligned(
                    core::ptr::addr_of!((*p_app).AppStateFlags),
                );
                let id: AppId_t = core::ptr::read_unaligned(
                    core::ptr::addr_of!((*p_app).nAppID),
                );
                // UpdateRunning|UpdateStarted = a download is actually
                // going, versus an idle scheduled retry.
                let active = app_state.intersects(
                    EAppState::UpdateRunning | EAppState::UpdateStarted,
                );
                (id, active)
            };

            {
                let mut set = G_ACTIVE_DL.lock();
                if active {
                    set.insert(app_id);
                } else {
                    set.remove(&app_id);
                }
            }

            if lua_config::has_depot(app_id, false) {
                let t = lua_config::get_purchase_time(app_id);
                if t != 0 {
                    unsafe {
                        core::ptr::write_unaligned(
                            core::ptr::addr_of_mut!((*p_app).PurchasedTime),
                            t,
                        );
                        let read_back: u32 = core::ptr::read_unaligned(
                            core::ptr::addr_of!((*p_app).PurchasedTime),
                        );
                        LOG_STEAMUI_TRACE!(
                            "FillInAppOverview: set PurchasedTime={} for appId={}",
                            read_back,
                            app_id,
                        );
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        o_FillInAppOverview(p_this, p_app_overview, p_app)
    }
}

hook_fn! {
    fn BuildCompleteAppOverviewChange(
        p_controller: *mut c_void,
        p_change: *mut c_void,
        optional_callback_slot: *mut c_void,
    ) -> () {
        // DIVERGENCE FROM C++: the C++ body re-injects the
        // `removed_appid` entries into the freshly-rebuilt message so a
        // full library rebuild does not resurrect a removed game. That
        // requires calling Steam's own protobuf helper against a message
        // created by the C++ protobuf runtime, which prost cannot do (see
        // the module doc). The hook installs and passes through.
        //
        // User-visible consequence: a removed game can reappear in the
        // library after a full rebuild (rare - typically only on profile
        // corruption, cache clear, or fresh login). Incremental updates
        // are unaffected.
        o_BuildCompleteAppOverviewChange(p_controller, p_change, optional_callback_slot)
    }
}

hook_fn! {
    fn CSteamUIAppControllerRunFrame(p_controller: *mut c_void) -> *mut c_void {
        if capture_ready!(GetAppByID) && capture_ready!(MarkAppChange) {
            let draining: Vec<AppId_t> = {
                let mut pending = G_PENDING_REMOVALS.lock();
                std::mem::take(&mut *pending)
            };
            for app_id in draining {
                if lua_config::is_owned(app_id) {
                    LOG_STEAMUI_DEBUG!(
                        "RunFrame: appId {} is owned again, skipping removal",
                        app_id
                    );
                    continue;
                }
                let get_this = unsafe { CAPTURED_GET_APP_BY_I_D.load() };
                let app = unsafe { o_GetAppByID(get_this, app_id, false) };
                if !app.is_null() {
                    let should_mark = unsafe {
                        core::ptr::write_unaligned(
                            core::ptr::addr_of_mut!((*app).OwnershipFlags),
                            EAppOwnershipFlags::None,
                        );
                        let state: EAppState = core::ptr::read_unaligned(
                            core::ptr::addr_of!((*app).AppStateFlags),
                        );
                        state == EAppState::Uninstalled
                    };
                    if should_mark {
                        let mut set = G_REMOVED_APP_IDS.lock();
                        set.insert(app_id);
                    }
                }
                let mark_this = unsafe { CAPTURED_MARK_APP_CHANGE.load() };
                unsafe {
                    o_MarkAppChange(
                        mark_this,
                        app_id,
                        EAppChangeFlags::AppInfoOrConfig.bits(),
                    );
                }
            }
        }
        o_CSteamUIAppControllerRunFrame(p_controller)
    }
}

// ── Public API ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

pub fn queue_removal(app_id: AppId_t) {
    let mut pending = G_PENDING_REMOVALS.lock();
    pending.push(app_id);
}

pub fn cancel_removal(app_id: AppId_t) {
    {
        let mut pending = G_PENDING_REMOVALS.lock();
        pending.retain(|&x| x != app_id);
    }
    {
        let mut removed = G_REMOVED_APP_IDS.lock();
        removed.remove(&app_id);
    }
}

pub fn active_download_count() -> usize {
    G_ACTIVE_DL.lock().len()
}

pub fn install() -> bool {
    arm_capture_u!(GetAppByID);
    arm_capture_u!(MarkAppChange);

    // `RepeatedFieldUint32_Add` is deliberately not resolved: the C++
    // calls it with a `RepeatedField<uint32>` pointer that prost does
    // not produce. See the module doc and `STUBS.md`.

    let ok1 = install_hook_u!(FillInAppOverview);
    let ok2 = install_hook_u!(BuildCompleteAppOverviewChange);
    let ok3 = install_hook_u!(CSteamUIAppControllerRunFrame);
    ok1 && ok2 && ok3
}

pub fn uninstall() -> bool {
    let ok1 = uninstall_hook!(FillInAppOverview);
    let ok2 = uninstall_hook!(BuildCompleteAppOverviewChange);
    let ok3 = uninstall_hook!(CSteamUIAppControllerRunFrame);
    ok1 && ok2 && ok3
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn queue_and_cancel_removal_round_trip() {
        {
            let mut p = G_PENDING_REMOVALS.lock();
            p.clear();
        }
        {
            let mut r = G_REMOVED_APP_IDS.lock();
            r.clear();
        }

        queue_removal(100);
        queue_removal(200);
        {
            let p = G_PENDING_REMOVALS.lock();
            assert_eq!(p.len(), 2);
        }

        cancel_removal(100);
        {
            let p = G_PENDING_REMOVALS.lock();
            assert_eq!(*p, vec![200]);
        }

        cancel_removal(999);
        {
            let p = G_PENDING_REMOVALS.lock();
            assert_eq!(*p, vec![200]);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn active_download_count_starts_zero() {
        {
            let mut s = G_ACTIVE_DL.lock();
            s.clear();
        }
        assert_eq!(active_download_count(), 0);
    }
}


===== FILE: src\hook\veh_common.rs =====
//! Shared int3 site registry. Ported from `Utils/HookSupport/VehCommon.h`
//! and `VehCommon.cpp`.
//!
//! The registry is a global list of soft-breakpoint sites. Each site
//! owns the first byte of a function that has been temporarily replaced
//! with `0xCC`. When the CPU raises `EXCEPTION_BREAKPOINT` at one of
//! those addresses, [`on_breakpoint`] restores the original byte, runs
//! the site's `on_hit` callback, and (for persistent sites) sets TF so
//! the next `EXCEPTION_SINGLE_STEP` re-arms the int3.
//!
//! One VEH handler is installed lazily on the first [`arm`].

use parking_lot::RwLock;

use crate::platform::trap::{self, Context, ExceptionKind};

/// x86-64 instruction length cap. Used by the single-step predicate.
pub const K_MAX_X64_INSN_LEN: u64 = 15;

/// `true` if `rip` is exactly `target`.
#[inline]
pub fn is_at(rip: u64, target: *const std::ffi::c_void) -> bool {
    rip == target as u64
}

/// `true` if `rip` is in `(target, target + 15]`. Used by the single-step
/// branch to recognise that the trap was caused by us setting TF after
/// restoring `target`'s first byte.
#[inline]
pub fn is_post_int3_step(rip: u64, target: *const std::ffi::c_void) -> bool {
    let base = target as u64;
    rip > base && rip <= base + K_MAX_X64_INSN_LEN
}

/// A managed soft-breakpoint site.
pub struct Int3Site {
    /// First byte of the hooked function.
    pub target: *mut u8,
    /// Saved before arming; restored on hit and on disarm.
    pub original_byte: u8,
    /// `true`: re-arm after each single-step. `false`: one-shot.
    pub persistent: bool,
    /// Fires after the byte is restored, before control returns to the
    /// original code. May read/mutate `ctx` freely.
    pub on_hit: fn(&mut Context, &Int3Site),
    /// Site-specific data consumed by `on_hit`.
    pub callback_data: *mut std::ffi::c_void,
    /// Logging tag.
    pub label: &'static str,
}

// SAFETY: the site owns no thread-affine state. `target` and
// `callback_data` are read by the VEH on whichever thread triggered the
// trap; the C++ has the same requirement and relies on the caller to
// keep those addresses valid while the site is armed.
unsafe impl Send for Int3Site {}
unsafe impl Sync for Int3Site {}

static SITES: RwLock<Vec<Int3Site>> = RwLock::new(Vec::new());

// `trap::HandlerHandle` is `*mut c_void`, which is neither `Send` nor
// `Sync`, so it cannot live inside a `static` directly. Store the
// handle as a `usize` and cast back at the two use sites
// (`ensure_handler_installed`, `remove_handler`). The address is opaque
// to Rust; the VEH runtime only compares it for equality.
static HANDLER: RwLock<Option<usize>> = RwLock::new(None);

fn veh_handler(kind: ExceptionKind, ctx: &mut Context) -> bool {
    match kind {
        ExceptionKind::Breakpoint => on_breakpoint(ctx),
        ExceptionKind::SingleStep => on_single_step(ctx),
        ExceptionKind::Other => false,
    }
}

fn ensure_handler_installed() {
    let mut guard = HANDLER.write();
    if guard.is_none() {
        let h = trap::add_vectored_handler(veh_handler);
        *guard = Some(h as usize);
    }
}

/// Register a site and write `0xCC` to its first byte.
pub fn arm(site: Int3Site) {
    ensure_handler_installed();

    // Read the target before `site` is moved into the registry.
    let target = site.target;

    {
        let mut sites = SITES.write();
        // Idempotent: skip if this exact target is already armed.
        if sites.iter().any(|s| s.target == target) {
            return;
        }
        sites.push(site);
    }

    // SAFETY: the caller guarantees `target` points at a writable byte
    // inside a mapped executable region. `write_executable_byte` is a
    // no-op on non-Windows targets.
    unsafe {
        crate::platform::memory::write_executable_byte(
            target as *mut std::ffi::c_void,
            0xCC,
        );
    }
}

/// `true` if at least one site is currently registered.
pub fn has_sites() -> bool {
    !SITES.read().is_empty()
}

pub fn on_breakpoint(ctx: &mut Context) -> bool {
    let sites = SITES.read();
    for site in sites.iter() {
        if site.target.is_null() {
            continue;
        }
        if !is_at(ctx.instruction_pointer(), site.target as *const _) {
            continue;
        }
        // Restore the real first instruction before resuming.
        unsafe {
            crate::platform::memory::write_executable_byte(
                site.target as *mut std::ffi::c_void,
                site.original_byte,
            );
        }
        (site.on_hit)(ctx, site);
        if site.persistent {
            ctx.enable_single_step();
        }
        return true;
    }
    false
}

pub fn on_single_step(ctx: &mut Context) -> bool {
    let sites = SITES.read();
    for site in sites.iter() {
        if !site.persistent || site.target.is_null() {
            continue;
        }
        if !is_post_int3_step(ctx.instruction_pointer(), site.target as *const _) {
            continue;
        }
        // Re-arm for the next hit.
        unsafe {
            crate::platform::memory::write_executable_byte(
                site.target as *mut std::ffi::c_void,
                0xCC,
            );
        }
        return true;
    }
    false
}

/// Restore any still-armed bytes and clear the registry.
pub fn disarm_all() {
    let mut sites = SITES.write();
    for site in sites.iter() {
        if site.target.is_null() { continue; }
        unsafe {
            if *(site.target as *const u8) == 0xCC {
                crate::platform::memory::write_executable_byte(
                    site.target as *mut std::ffi::c_void,
                    site.original_byte,
                );
            }
        }
    }
    sites.clear();
}

/// Remove the shared VEH handler. Call only after all sites are disarmed.
pub fn remove_handler() {
    let mut guard = HANDLER.write();
    if let Some(h) = guard.take() {
        trap::remove_vectored_handler(h as trap::HandlerHandle);
    }
}

/// Convenience `on_hit` for the "capture this" pattern: writes argument 1
/// (RCX on x64) into the `*mut *mut c_void` pointed at by
/// `site.callback_data`.
pub fn capture_rcx_to(ctx: &mut Context, site: &Int3Site) {
    if site.callback_data.is_null() {
        return;
    }
    let this = ctx.argument(1) as *mut std::ffi::c_void;
    unsafe {
        // SAFETY: `callback_data` was populated by `arm_capture_*!` from a
        // process-static `Slot`'s `as_ptr()`, i.e. it points at storage
        // that outlives the site. The site is one-shot, so this write
        // happens exactly once, from the thread that hit the int3.
        let slot = site.callback_data as *mut *mut std::ffi::c_void;
        *slot = this;
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use std::ffi::c_void;

    #[test]
    fn is_at_exact_match() {
        let x = 42u64;
        let p = &x as *const u64 as *const c_void;
        assert!(is_at(p as u64, p));
        assert!(!is_at(p as u64 + 1, p));
    }

    #[test]
    fn is_post_int3_step_bounds() {
        let base = 0x1000u64;
        let p = base as *const c_void;
        // Exactly at target: not "post".
        assert!(!is_post_int3_step(base, p));
        // One instruction past.
        assert!(is_post_int3_step(base + 1, p));
        assert!(is_post_int3_step(base + K_MAX_X64_INSN_LEN, p));
        assert!(!is_post_int3_step(base + K_MAX_X64_INSN_LEN + 1, p));
    }

    #[test]
    fn has_sites_starts_false_when_empty() {
        // The registry is process-global. This test does not arm a site,
        // so it only checks the call itself; the real disarm coverage
        // comes from the transactional uninstall path once hooks install.
        let _ = has_sites();
    }

    #[test]
    fn disarm_all_on_empty_is_noop() {
        // Same reasoning as `has_sites_starts_false_when_empty`: no panic
        // is the assertion.
        disarm_all();
    }

    #[test]
    fn handler_slot_is_usize_and_send_sync() {
        // Compile-time proof that the handler storage satisfies the
        // static's `Sync` requirement. If a future edit changes the type
        // back to a raw pointer, this test stops compiling.
        fn assert_sync<T: Sync>() {}
        assert_sync::<RwLock<Option<usize>>>();
    }
}
