        assert_eq!(EResult::OfflineAppCacheInvalid as i32, 130);
        assert_eq!(size_of::<EResult>(), 4);
    }

    #[test]
    fn e_msg_alias_values() {
        // The two aliased values from the C++ header.
        assert_eq!(EMsg::BaseGeneral, EMsg::GenericReply);
        assert_eq!(EMsg::BaseShell, EMsg::AssignSysID);
        assert_eq!(EMsg::BaseGM, EMsg::Heartbeat);
        // Spot-check specific values used by the codebase.
        assert_eq!(EMsg::Multi.0, 1);
        assert_eq!(EMsg::ServiceMethodResponse.0, 147);
        assert_eq!(EMsg::ServiceMethodCallFromClient.0, 151);
        assert_eq!(EMsg::ClientGetLegacyGameKey.0, 730);
        assert_eq!(EMsg::ClientGamesPlayed.0, 742);
        assert_eq!(EMsg::ClientPersonaState.0, 766);
        assert_eq!(EMsg::ClientLicenseList.0, 780);
        assert_eq!(EMsg::ClientGetLegacyGameKeyResponse.0, 785);
        assert_eq!(EMsg::ClientGetUserStats.0, 818);
        assert_eq!(EMsg::ClientGetUserStatsResponse.0, 819);
        assert_eq!(EMsg::ClientGetAppOwnershipTicketResponse.0, 858);
        assert_eq!(EMsg::ClientGamesPlayedWithDataBlob.0, 5410);
        assert_eq!(EMsg::ClientRichPresenceUpload.0, 7501);
        assert_eq!(EMsg::ClientPICSProductInfoRequest.0, 8903);
        assert_eq!(EMsg::ClientSharedLibraryStopPlaying.0, 9406);
    }

    #[test]
    fn ownership_flags_combine() {
        let f = EAppOwnershipFlags::OwnsLicense | EAppOwnershipFlags::FreeLicense;
        assert_eq!(f.bits(), 0x0003);
        assert!(f.contains(EAppOwnershipFlags::OwnsLicense));
        assert!(!f.contains(EAppOwnershipFlags::RetailLicense));
    }

    #[test]
    fn app_state_combine() {
        let s = EAppState::UpdateRunning | EAppState::UpdateStarted;
        assert_eq!(s.bits(), 0x0500);
        assert!(s.contains(EAppState::UpdateRunning));
    }

    #[test]
    fn websocket_opcode_layout() {
        assert_eq!(EWebSocketOpCode::Binary as u8, 0x02);
        assert_eq!(size_of::<EWebSocketOpCode>(), 1);
    }

    #[test]
    fn account_type_and_universe_layout() {
        assert_eq!(EAccountType::Individual as i32, 1);
        assert_eq!(EAccountType::Max as i32, 11);
        assert_eq!(EUniverse::Public as i32, 1);
        assert_eq!(EUniverse::Max as i32, 5);
    }

    #[test]
    fn key_values_type_layout() {
        assert_eq!(EKeyValuesType::String as u32, 1);
        assert_eq!(EKeyValuesType::UInt64 as u32, 7);
        assert_eq!(size_of::<EKeyValuesType>(), 4);
    }
}


===== FILE: src\steam\ipc_facades.rs =====
//! Byte-layout facades mirroring `IPCMessages.gen.h`.
//!
//! C++ source: generated from `Steam/IPCMessages.steamd`. The C++ file
//! provides one class per IPC method, each wrapping a `CUtlBuffer*` and
//! exposing typed accessors for the request or response body. This is a
//! hand-maintained port of that generated file — the `.steamd` remains
//! the source of truth, and any change to the schema must be reflected
//! here in lockstep.
//!
//! ## Layouts
//!
//! Request:   `[u8 command] [u8 ifaceID] [u32 hSteamUser] [u32 funcHash] [body...] [u32 fencepost]`
//! Response:  `[u8 result]  [body...]`
//! Handshake: `[u8 command] [u32 version] [u32 pid] [u32 tid]`
//!
//! Per-method facades read/write fields at fixed offsets in `body`,
//! matching the offsets the C++ generator emits. Envelope slicing and
//! bounds checking are `BufView`'s job.

#![allow(non_snake_case)]
#![allow(non_camel_case_types)]
#![allow(dead_code)]

use crate::steam::ipc_messages::{EIPCCommand, EIPCInterface};
use crate::steam::structs::CUtlBuffer;
use crate::steam::structs::CSteamID;
use crate::steam::types::SteamAPICall_t;

// ── Buffer view ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/// A view over the valid prefix of a `CUtlBuffer`, or over a caller-owned
/// byte range. Reads and writes are unaligned, matching the C++
/// `detail::Read` / `detail::Write` helpers.
#[derive(Copy, Clone)]
pub struct BufView {
    base: *mut u8,
    len: usize,
}

impl BufView {
    pub const fn null() -> Self {
        Self { base: std::ptr::null_mut(), len: 0 }
    }

    pub fn from_raw(base: *mut u8, len: usize) -> Self {
        Self { base, len }
    }

    /// Build a view over a `CUtlBuffer`'s valid prefix. Matches the C++
    /// `detail::BufferBytes`: a null buffer or a negative `m_Put` yields
    /// an empty view.
    ///
    /// # Safety
    /// `buf`, if non-null, must point to a live `CUtlBuffer`.
    pub unsafe fn from_cutl(buf: *mut CUtlBuffer) -> Self {
        if buf.is_null() { return Self::null(); }
        let b = &*buf;
        if b.m_Memory.m_pMemory.is_null() || b.m_Put < 0 { return Self::null(); }
        Self { base: b.m_Memory.m_pMemory, len: b.m_Put as usize }
    }

    pub fn is_null(&self) -> bool { self.base.is_null() }
    pub fn is_empty(&self) -> bool { self.base.is_null() || self.len == 0 }
    pub fn len(&self) -> usize { self.len }

    pub fn fits(&self, size: usize) -> bool {
        !self.base.is_null() && self.len >= size
    }

    pub fn slice(&self, offset: usize, size: usize) -> BufView {
        if self.base.is_null() || offset > self.len || size > self.len - offset {
            return BufView::null();
        }
        BufView { base: unsafe { self.base.add(offset) }, len: size }
    }

    /// # Safety
    /// `offset + size_of::<T>() <= self.len`.
    pub unsafe fn read<T: Copy>(&self, offset: usize) -> T {
        debug_assert!(!self.base.is_null());
        debug_assert!(offset <= self.len && std::mem::size_of::<T>() <= self.len - offset);
        std::ptr::read_unaligned(self.base.add(offset) as *const T)
    }

    pub unsafe fn read_u8  (&self, o: usize) -> u8  { self.read(o) }
    pub unsafe fn read_u32 (&self, o: usize) -> u32 { self.read(o) }
    pub unsafe fn read_i32 (&self, o: usize) -> i32 { self.read(o) }
    pub unsafe fn read_u64 (&self, o: usize) -> u64 { self.read(o) }
    pub unsafe fn read_bool(&self, o: usize) -> bool { self.read::<u8>(o) != 0 }

    /// # Safety
    /// Same as `read`. Returns `false` if the range is out of bounds.
    pub unsafe fn write<T: Copy>(&self, offset: usize, v: T) -> bool {
        if self.base.is_null() { return false; }
        if offset > self.len || std::mem::size_of::<T>() > self.len - offset { return false; }
        std::ptr::write_unaligned(self.base.add(offset) as *mut T, v);
        true
    }

    pub unsafe fn write_u8  (&self, o: usize, v: u8 ) -> bool { self.write(o, v) }
    pub unsafe fn write_u32 (&self, o: usize, v: u32) -> bool { self.write(o, v) }
    pub unsafe fn write_i32 (&self, o: usize, v: i32) -> bool { self.write(o, v) }
    pub unsafe fn write_u64 (&self, o: usize, v: u64) -> bool { self.write(o, v) }
    pub unsafe fn write_bool(&self, o: usize, v: bool) -> bool { self.write::<u8>(o, v as u8) }

    /// Copy `src` into `[offset, offset+capacity)`, zero-filling any
    /// remainder. Mirrors `detail::CopyBytes`.
    ///
    /// # Safety
    /// The view must be non-null; the range must be in-bounds for write.
    pub unsafe fn copy_bytes(&self, offset: usize, capacity: usize, src: &[u8]) -> bool {
        if self.base.is_null() { return false; }
        if offset > self.len || capacity > self.len - offset { return false; }
        let dst = self.base.add(offset);
        let n = capacity.min(src.len());
        if n > 0 { std::ptr::copy_nonoverlapping(src.as_ptr(), dst, n); }
        if n < capacity { std::ptr::write_bytes(dst.add(n), 0u8, capacity - n); }
        true
    }
}

// ── Envelopes ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────

/// A request buffer. Layout: `[u8 command][body...]`.
#[derive(Copy, Clone)]
pub struct IPCRequest { bytes: BufView }

impl IPCRequest {
    /// # Safety
    /// `buf` must point at a live `CUtlBuffer`.
    pub unsafe fn from_cutl(buf: *mut CUtlBuffer) -> Self {
        Self { bytes: BufView::from_cutl(buf) }
    }
    pub fn from_view(bytes: BufView) -> Self { Self { bytes } }
    pub fn ok(&self) -> bool { self.bytes.fits(1) }
    pub fn command_raw(&self) -> u8 {
        if !self.ok() { return 0; }
        unsafe { self.bytes.read_u8(0) }
    }
    pub fn body(&self) -> BufView {
        if self.bytes.len() < 1 { BufView::null() }
        else { self.bytes.slice(1, self.bytes.len() - 1) }
    }
}

/// Body of an `InterfaceCall` request, starting after the `IPCRequest`
/// command byte. Layout: `[u8 ifaceID] [u32 hSteamUser] [u32 funcHash] [body...] [u32 fencepost]`.
#[derive(Copy, Clone)]
pub struct IPCInterfaceCall { bytes: BufView }

impl IPCInterfaceCall {
    pub fn from_body(bytes: BufView) -> Self { Self { bytes } }
    /// Requires at least the 9-byte header plus the 4-byte fencepost.
    pub fn ok(&self) -> bool { self.bytes.fits(13) }
    pub fn interface_id_raw(&self) -> u8 { unsafe { self.bytes.read_u8(0) } }
    pub fn h_steam_user(&self) -> u32 { unsafe { self.bytes.read_u32(1) } }
    pub fn func_hash(&self) -> u32 { unsafe { self.bytes.read_u32(5) } }
    pub fn fencepost(&self) -> u32 {
        if self.bytes.len() < 4 { return 0; }
        unsafe { self.bytes.read_u32(self.bytes.len() - 4) }
    }
    pub fn body(&self) -> BufView {
        if self.bytes.len() < 13 { return BufView::null(); }
        self.bytes.slice(9, self.bytes.len() - 13)
    }
}

/// Handshake request body. Layout: `[u32 version] [u32 pid] [u32 tid]`.
#[derive(Copy, Clone)]
pub struct IPCHandshakeReq { bytes: BufView }

impl IPCHandshakeReq {
    pub fn from_body(bytes: BufView) -> Self { Self { bytes } }
    pub fn ok(&self) -> bool { self.bytes.fits(12) }
    pub fn version(&self) -> u32 { unsafe { self.bytes.read_u32(0) } }
    pub fn pid(&self) -> u32 { unsafe { self.bytes.read_u32(4) } }
    pub fn tid(&self) -> u32 { unsafe { self.bytes.read_u32(8) } }
}

/// A response buffer. Layout: `[u8 result][body...]`.
#[derive(Copy, Clone)]
pub struct IPCResponse { bytes: BufView }

impl IPCResponse {
    /// # Safety
    /// `buf` must point at a live `CUtlBuffer`.
    pub unsafe fn from_cutl(buf: *mut CUtlBuffer) -> Self {
        Self { bytes: BufView::from_cutl(buf) }
    }
    pub fn from_view(bytes: BufView) -> Self { Self { bytes } }
    pub fn ok(&self) -> bool { self.bytes.fits(1) }
    pub fn result_raw(&self) -> u8 {
        if !self.ok() { return 0; }
        unsafe { self.bytes.read_u8(0) }
    }
    pub fn body(&self) -> BufView {
        if self.bytes.len() < 1 { BufView::null() }
        else { self.bytes.slice(1, self.bytes.len() - 1) }
    }
}

// ── IClientUser ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

const K_ICLIENT_USER: u8 = EIPCInterface::IClientUser as u8;

/// `IClientUser::GetSteamID() -> CSteamID`.
pub struct GetSteamIDReq { r: IPCRequest }
impl GetSteamIDReq {
    pub unsafe fn from_cutl(buf: *mut CUtlBuffer) -> Self { Self { r: IPCRequest::from_cutl(buf) } }
    pub fn from_view(v: BufView) -> Self { Self { r: IPCRequest::from_view(v) } }
    fn call(&self) -> IPCInterfaceCall { IPCInterfaceCall::from_body(self.r.body()) }
    pub fn ok(&self) -> bool {
        let c = self.call();
        self.r.ok() && self.r.command_raw() == EIPCCommand::InterfaceCall as u8
            && c.ok() && c.interface_id_raw() == K_ICLIENT_USER
    }
}
pub struct GetSteamIDResp { r: IPCResponse }
impl GetSteamIDResp {
    pub unsafe fn from_cutl(buf: *mut CUtlBuffer) -> Self { Self { r: IPCResponse::from_cutl(buf) } }
    pub fn from_view(v: BufView) -> Self { Self { r: IPCResponse::from_view(v) } }
    pub fn ok(&self) -> bool { self.r.ok() && self.r.body().fits(8) }
    pub fn return_value(&self) -> CSteamID {
        CSteamID::from_u64(unsafe { self.r.body().read_u64(0) })
    }
    pub fn set_return_value(&self, v: CSteamID) -> bool {
        unsafe { self.r.body().write_u64(0, v.m_unAll64Bits) }
    }
}

/// `IClientUser::GetAppOwnershipTicketExtendedData(unAppID, cbMaxTicket, ...)`.
pub struct GetAppOwnershipTicketExtendedDataReq { r: IPCRequest }
impl GetAppOwnershipTicketExtendedDataReq {
    pub unsafe fn from_cutl(buf: *mut CUtlBuffer) -> Self { Self { r: IPCRequest::from_cutl(buf) } }
    pub fn from_view(v: BufView) -> Self { Self { r: IPCRequest::from_view(v) } }
    fn call(&self) -> IPCInterfaceCall { IPCInterfaceCall::from_body(self.r.body()) }
    fn body(&self) -> BufView { self.call().body() }
    pub fn ok(&self) -> bool {
        let c = self.call();
        self.r.ok() && self.r.command_raw() == EIPCCommand::InterfaceCall as u8
            && c.ok() && c.interface_id_raw() == K_ICLIENT_USER && c.body().fits(8)
    }
    pub fn un_app_id(&self) -> u32 { unsafe { self.body().read_u32(0) } }
    pub fn cb_max_ticket(&self) -> i32 { unsafe { self.body().read_i32(4) } }
}
pub struct GetAppOwnershipTicketExtendedDataResp {
    r: IPCResponse,
    cb_max_ticket: usize,
}
impl GetAppOwnershipTicketExtendedDataResp {
    pub unsafe fn from_cutl(buf: *mut CUtlBuffer, cb_max_ticket: usize) -> Self {
        Self { r: IPCResponse::from_cutl(buf), cb_max_ticket }
    }
    pub fn from_view(v: BufView, cb_max_ticket: usize) -> Self {
        Self { r: IPCResponse::from_view(v), cb_max_ticket }
    }
    pub fn ok(&self) -> bool {
        // returnValue(4) + pTicket(cbMax) + 4*4 = 20 + cbMax
        self.r.ok() && self.r.body().fits(20 + self.cb_max_ticket)
    }
    pub fn return_value(&self) -> u32 { unsafe { self.r.body().read_u32(0) } }
    pub fn set_return_value(&self, v: u32) -> bool { unsafe { self.r.body().write_u32(0, v) } }
    pub fn set_p_ticket(&self, value: &[u8]) -> bool {
        unsafe { self.r.body().copy_bytes(4, self.cb_max_ticket, value) }
    }
    pub fn set_pi_app_id(&self, v: u32) -> bool {
        unsafe { self.r.body().write_u32(4 + self.cb_max_ticket, v) }
    }
    pub fn set_pi_steam_id(&self, v: u32) -> bool {
        unsafe { self.r.body().write_u32(8 + self.cb_max_ticket, v) }
    }
    pub fn set_pi_signature(&self, v: u32) -> bool {
        unsafe { self.r.body().write_u32(12 + self.cb_max_ticket, v) }
    }
    pub fn set_pcb_signature(&self, v: u32) -> bool {
        unsafe { self.r.body().write_u32(16 + self.cb_max_ticket, v) }
    }
}

/// `IClientUser::RequestEncryptedAppTicket(cbData, pData[cbData]) -> SteamAPICall_t`.
pub struct RequestEncryptedAppTicketReq { r: IPCRequest }
impl RequestEncryptedAppTicketReq {
    pub unsafe fn from_cutl(buf: *mut CUtlBuffer) -> Self { Self { r: IPCRequest::from_cutl(buf) } }
    pub fn from_view(v: BufView) -> Self { Self { r: IPCRequest::from_view(v) } }
    fn call(&self) -> IPCInterfaceCall { IPCInterfaceCall::from_body(self.r.body()) }
    fn body(&self) -> BufView { self.call().body() }
    pub fn ok(&self) -> bool {
        let c = self.call();
        if !(self.r.ok() && self.r.command_raw() == EIPCCommand::InterfaceCall as u8
             && c.ok() && c.interface_id_raw() == K_ICLIENT_USER && c.body().fits(4)) {
            return false;
        }
        let cb = unsafe { self.body().read_i32(0) };
        if cb < 0 { return false; }
        c.body().fits(4 + cb as usize)
    }
    pub fn p_data(&self) -> Vec<u8> {
        let cb = unsafe { self.body().read_i32(0) } as usize;
        let b = self.body().slice(4, cb);
        if b.is_null() { return Vec::new(); }
        unsafe { std::slice::from_raw_parts(b.base, b.len).to_vec() }
    }
}
pub struct RequestEncryptedAppTicketResp { r: IPCResponse }
impl RequestEncryptedAppTicketResp {
    pub unsafe fn from_cutl(buf: *mut CUtlBuffer) -> Self { Self { r: IPCResponse::from_cutl(buf) } }
    pub fn from_view(v: BufView) -> Self { Self { r: IPCResponse::from_view(v) } }
    pub fn ok(&self) -> bool { self.r.ok() && self.r.body().fits(8) }
    pub fn return_value(&self) -> SteamAPICall_t { unsafe { self.r.body().read_u64(0) } }
}

/// `IClientUser::GetEncryptedAppTicket(cbMaxTicket, pcbTicket, pTicket[pcbTicket])`.
pub struct GetEncryptedAppTicketReq { r: IPCRequest }
impl GetEncryptedAppTicketReq {
    pub unsafe fn from_cutl(buf: *mut CUtlBuffer) -> Self { Self { r: IPCRequest::from_cutl(buf) } }
    pub fn from_view(v: BufView) -> Self { Self { r: IPCRequest::from_view(v) } }
    fn call(&self) -> IPCInterfaceCall { IPCInterfaceCall::from_body(self.r.body()) }
    pub fn ok(&self) -> bool {
        let c = self.call();
        self.r.ok() && self.r.command_raw() == EIPCCommand::InterfaceCall as u8
            && c.ok() && c.interface_id_raw() == K_ICLIENT_USER && c.body().fits(4)
    }
    pub fn cb_max_ticket(&self) -> u32 { unsafe { self.call().body().read_u32(0) } }
}
pub struct GetEncryptedAppTicketResp { r: IPCResponse }
impl GetEncryptedAppTicketResp {
    pub unsafe fn from_cutl(buf: *mut CUtlBuffer) -> Self { Self { r: IPCResponse::from_cutl(buf) } }
    pub fn from_view(v: BufView) -> Self { Self { r: IPCResponse::from_view(v) } }
    pub fn ok(&self) -> bool { self.r.ok() && self.r.body().fits(5) }
    pub fn return_value(&self) -> bool { unsafe { self.r.body().read_bool(0) } }
    pub fn set_return_value(&self, v: bool) -> bool { unsafe { self.r.body().write_bool(0, v) } }
    pub fn set_pcb_ticket(&self, v: u32) -> bool { unsafe { self.r.body().write_u32(1, v) } }
    pub fn set_p_ticket(&self, value: &[u8]) -> bool {
        let pcb = unsafe { self.r.body().read_u32(1) };
        unsafe { self.r.body().copy_bytes(5, pcb as usize, value) }
    }
}

/// `IClientUtils::GetAPICallResult(hSteamAPICall, cubCallback, iCallbackExpected, pCallback, pbFailed)`.
pub struct GetAPICallResultReq { r: IPCRequest }
impl GetAPICallResultReq {
    pub unsafe fn from_cutl(buf: *mut CUtlBuffer) -> Self { Self { r: IPCRequest::from_cutl(buf) } }
    pub fn from_view(v: BufView) -> Self { Self { r: IPCRequest::from_view(v) } }
    fn call(&self) -> IPCInterfaceCall { IPCInterfaceCall::from_body(self.r.body()) }
    fn body(&self) -> BufView { self.call().body() }
    pub fn ok(&self) -> bool {
        let c = self.call();
        self.r.ok() && self.r.command_raw() == EIPCCommand::InterfaceCall as u8
            && c.ok() && c.interface_id_raw() == K_ICLIENT_UTILS && c.body().fits(16)
    }
    pub fn h_steam_api_call(&self) -> u64 { unsafe { self.body().read_u64(0) } }
    pub fn cub_callback(&self) -> u32 { unsafe { self.body().read_u32(8) } }
    pub fn i_callback_expected(&self) -> u32 { unsafe { self.body().read_u32(12) } }
}
pub struct GetAPICallResultResp { r: IPCResponse, cub_callback: usize }
impl GetAPICallResultResp {
    pub unsafe fn from_cutl(buf: *mut CUtlBuffer, cub_callback: usize) -> Self {
        Self { r: IPCResponse::from_cutl(buf), cub_callback }
    }
    pub fn from_view(v: BufView, cub_callback: usize) -> Self {
        Self { r: IPCResponse::from_view(v), cub_callback }
    }
    pub fn ok(&self) -> bool {
        self.r.ok() && self.r.body().fits(2 + self.cub_callback)
    }
    pub fn return_value(&self) -> bool { unsafe { self.r.body().read_bool(0) } }
    pub fn set_return_value(&self, v: bool) -> bool { unsafe { self.r.body().write_bool(0, v) } }
    pub fn set_p_callback(&self, value: &[u8]) -> bool {
        unsafe { self.r.body().copy_bytes(1, self.cub_callback, value) }
    }
    pub fn set_pb_failed(&self, v: bool) -> bool {
        unsafe { self.r.body().write_bool(1 + self.cub_callback, v) }
    }
}

// ── Tests ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn buf_view_null_is_empty() {
        let v = BufView::null();
        assert!(v.is_null());
        assert!(v.is_empty());
        assert!(!v.fits(1));
    }

    #[test]
    fn buf_view_read_write_u32() {
        let mut data = [0u8; 32];
        let v = BufView::from_raw(data.as_mut_ptr(), 16);
        unsafe {
            assert!(v.write_u32(0, 0xDEAD_BEEF));
            assert_eq!(v.read_u32(0), 0xDEAD_BEEF);
            assert!(v.write_u32(12, 0x1234_5678));
            assert_eq!(v.read_u32(12), 0x1234_5678);
            // Cannot write 4 bytes starting at offset 13 (13+4 > 16).
            assert!(!v.write_u32(13, 0));
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn buf_view_slice_and_copy_bytes() {
        let mut data = [0u8; 32];
        let v = BufView::from_raw(data.as_mut_ptr(), 32);
        let sub = v.slice(4, 8);
        assert_eq!(sub.len(), 8);
        unsafe {
            assert!(sub.copy_bytes(0, 4, &[0xAA, 0xBB, 0xCC, 0xDD]));
        }
        assert_eq!(data[4], 0xAA);
        assert_eq!(data[7], 0xDD);
        // Zero-fill the remainder when src is shorter than capacity.
        unsafe {
            assert!(sub.copy_bytes(4, 4, &[0x11]));
        }
        assert_eq!(data[8], 0x11);
        assert_eq!(data[9], 0);
        assert_eq!(data[11], 0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn buf_view_slice_out_of_bounds_is_null() {
        let mut data = [0u8; 8];
        let v = BufView::from_raw(data.as_mut_ptr(), 8);
        assert!(v.slice(6, 4).is_null());
        assert!(v.slice(10, 0).is_null());
    }

    #[test]
    fn ipc_request_command_raw() {
        let mut data = [EIPCCommand::InterfaceCall as u8, 0, 0, 0];
        let v = BufView::from_raw(data.as_mut_ptr(), 4);
        let req = IPCRequest::from_view(v);
        assert!(req.ok());
        assert_eq!(req.command_raw(), EIPCCommand::InterfaceCall as u8);
    }

    #[test]
    fn ipc_request_short_buffer_not_ok() {
        let req = IPCRequest::from_view(BufView::null());
        assert!(!req.ok());
    }

    #[test]
    fn ipc_interface_call_body_offsets() {
        // Body: 9-byte header + 8-byte payload + 4-byte fencepost = 21 bytes.
        let mut data = vec![0u8; 21];
        data[0] = 1; // iface = IClientUser
        data[1..5].copy_from_slice(&0x11223344u32.to_le_bytes());
        data[5..9].copy_from_slice(&0xAABBCCDDu32.to_le_bytes());
        for i in 9..17 { data[i] = i as u8; }
        data[17..21].copy_from_slice(&0xCAFEBABEu32.to_le_bytes());

        let v = BufView::from_raw(data.as_mut_ptr(), 21);
        let call = IPCInterfaceCall::from_body(v);
        assert!(call.ok());
        assert_eq!(call.interface_id_raw(), 1);
        assert_eq!(call.h_steam_user(), 0x11223344);
        assert_eq!(call.func_hash(), 0xAABBCCDD);
        assert_eq!(call.fencepost(), 0xCAFEBABE);
        let b = call.body();
        assert_eq!(b.len(), 8);
        unsafe {
            assert_eq!(b.read_u8(0), 9);
            assert_eq!(b.read_u8(7), 16);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn ipc_interface_call_too_short() {
        let mut data = [0u8; 12];
        let call = IPCInterfaceCall::from_body(BufView::from_raw(data.as_mut_ptr(), 12));
        assert!(!call.ok());
    }

    #[test]
    fn ipchandshake_req_layout() {
        let mut data = [0u8; 12];
        data[0..4].copy_from_slice(&7u32.to_le_bytes());
        data[4..8].copy_from_slice(&1234u32.to_le_bytes());
        data[8..12].copy_from_slice(&5678u32.to_le_bytes());
        let hs = IPCHandshakeReq::from_body(BufView::from_raw(data.as_mut_ptr(), 12));
        assert!(hs.ok());
        assert_eq!(hs.version(), 7);
        assert_eq!(hs.pid(), 1234);
        assert_eq!(hs.tid(), 5678);
    }

    #[test]
    fn get_app_id_resp_round_trip() {
        let mut data = [0u8; 8];
        // data[0] is the result byte (unused here).
        let v = BufView::from_raw(data.as_mut_ptr(), 8);
        let resp = GetAppIDResp::from_view(v);
        assert!(resp.ok());
        assert!(resp.set_return_value(730));
        assert_eq!(resp.return_value(), 730);
        // returnValue lives at body offset 0 = buffer offset 1.
        assert_eq!(data[1..5], 730u32.to_le_bytes());
    }

    #[test]
    fn get_steam_id_resp_round_trip() {
        let mut data = [0u8; 12];
        let v = BufView::from_raw(data.as_mut_ptr(), 12);
        let resp = GetSteamIDResp::from_view(v);
        assert!(resp.ok());
        let id = CSteamID::from_u64(0x1100_0010_0000_0001);
        assert!(resp.set_return_value(id));
        assert_eq!(resp.return_value().m_unAll64Bits, 0x1100_0010_0000_0001);
    }

    #[test]
    fn get_api_call_result_resp_padding() {
        let cub_callback = 154usize;
        let total = 1 + 1 + cub_callback + 1;
        let mut data = vec![0u8; total];
        let v = BufView::from_raw(data.as_mut_ptr(), total);
        let resp = GetAPICallResultResp::from_view(v, cub_callback);
        assert!(resp.ok());
        assert!(resp.set_p_callback(&[1, 2, 3]));
        // Callback bytes at body offset 1 = buffer offset 2.
        assert_eq!(data[2], 1);
        assert_eq!(data[3], 2);
        assert_eq!(data[4], 3);
        // Padded with zeros.
        assert_eq!(data[2 + cub_callback - 1], 0);
        assert!(resp.set_pb_failed(true));
        assert_eq!(data[2 + cub_callback], 1);
        // Toggling returnValue at body offset 0 = buffer offset 1.
        assert!(resp.set_return_value(true));
        assert_eq!(data[1], 1);
    }

    #[test]
    fn get_app_ownership_ticket_extended_data_resp_layout() {
        let cb_max = 16usize;
        let total = 1 + 4 + cb_max + 16;
        let mut data = vec![0u8; total];
        let v = BufView::from_raw(data.as_mut_ptr(), total);
        let resp = GetAppOwnershipTicketExtendedDataResp::from_view(v, cb_max);
        assert!(resp.ok());
        assert!(resp.set_return_value(0xDEAD_BEEF));
        assert!(resp.set_p_ticket(&[0xAA; 4]));
        assert!(resp.set_pi_app_id(0x1111_1111));
        assert!(resp.set_pi_steam_id(0x2222_2222));
        assert!(resp.set_pi_signature(0x3333_3333));
        assert!(resp.set_pcb_signature(0x4444_4444));
        // returnValue at body offset 0 = buffer offset 1.
        assert_eq!(&data[1..5], &0xDEAD_BEEFu32.to_le_bytes());
        // pTicket at body offset 4 = buffer offset 5.
        assert_eq!(&data[5..9], &[0xAA; 4]);
        // piAppId at buffer offset 1 + 4 + cb_max.
        assert_eq!(&data[1 + 4 + cb_max .. 1 + 8 + cb_max], &0x1111_1111u32.to_le_bytes());
    }
}


===== FILE: src\steam\ipc_messages.rs =====
//! Steam IPC wire schema. Source: `Steam/IPCMessages.steamd`
//!
//! The C++ side generates facade classes from the .steamd file. This is
//! a hand-written Rust equivalent covering the enums, transport
//! envelopes, and the handshake. Per-method bodies are defined as
//! byte-slice views that parse on demand, matching how the C++ uses
//! them (via `CUtlBuffer*` at a current position).

#![allow(non_camel_case_types)]
#![allow(non_upper_case_globals)]

use super::types::*;

#[repr(u8)]
#[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub enum EIPCCommand {
    InterfaceCall  = 1,
    FlushCallbacks = 2,
    Destroy        = 5,
    Heartbeat      = 6,
    Handshake      = 9,
}

#[repr(u8)]
#[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub enum EIPCResult {
    OK     = 0x0B,
    Failed = 0x0C,
}

#[repr(u8)]
#[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub enum EIPCInterface {
    IClientUser                        = 1,
    IClientGameServer                  = 2,
    IClientFriends                     = 3,
    IClientUtils                       = 4,
    IClientBilling                     = 5,
    IClientMatchmaking                 = 6,
    IClientApps                        = 8,
    IClientUserStats                   = 11,
    IClientNetworking                  = 12,
    IClientRemoteStorage               = 13,
    IClientDepotBuilder                = 16,
    IClientAppManager                  = 17,
    IClientConfigStore                 = 18,
    IClientGameCoordinator             = 19,
    IClientGameServerStats             = 20,
    IClientGameStats                   = 21,
    IClientHTTP                        = 22,
    IClientScreenshots                 = 23,
    IClientAudio                       = 24,
    IClientUnifiedMessages             = 25,
    IClientStreamLauncher              = 26,
    IClientParentalSettings            = 27,
    IClientNetworkDeviceManager        = 29,
    IClientMusic                       = 30,
    IClientRemoteClientManager         = 31,
    IClientUGC                         = 32,
    IClientStreamClient                = 33,
    IClientProductBuilder              = 34,
    IClientShortcuts                   = 35,
    IClientGameNotifications           = 37,
    IClientVideo                       = 38,
    IClientInventory                   = 39,
    IClientVR                          = 40,
    IClientControllerSerialized        = 41,
    IClientAppDisableUpdate            = 42,
    IClientSharedConnection            = 44,
    IClientShader                      = 45,
    IClientNetworkingSocketsSerialized = 46,
    IClientCompat                      = 48,
    IClientParties                     = 49,
    IClientNetworkingUtilsSerialized   = 50,
    IClientRemotePlay                  = 52,
    IClientGameServerPacketHandler     = 53,
    IClientSystemManager               = 54,
    IClientSystemPerfManager           = 57,
    IClientSystemDockManager           = 58,
    IClientSystemAudioManager          = 59,
    IClientSystemDisplayManager        = 60,
    IClientTimeline                    = 61,
}

// The wire format is packed, with no alignment between fields.

#[repr(C, packed)]
#[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct IPCRequestHeader {
    pub command: EIPCCommand,
}

#[repr(C, packed)]
#[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct IPCInterfaceCallHeader {
    pub interface_id: EIPCInterface,
    pub h_steam_user: u32,
    pub func_hash: u32,
}

#[repr(C, packed)]
#[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct IPCResponseHeader {
    pub result: EIPCResult,
}

#[repr(C, packed)]
#[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct IPCHandshakeReq {
    pub version: u32,
    pub pid: u32,
    pub tid: u32,
}

// ─── Byte-slice facade ──────────────────────────────────────────────
//
// The C++ code reads these off a `CUtlBuffer` at a moving position. In
// Rust we take a `&[u8]` view and parse on demand. Callers that need
// streaming reads (rare) can advance an offset manually.

#[derive(Copy, Clone)]
pub struct IPCRequest<'a> {
    buf: &'a [u8],
    valid: bool,
    command_raw: u8,
}

impl<'a> IPCRequest<'a> {
    pub fn new(buf: &'a [u8]) -> Self {
        if buf.is_empty() {
            return Self { buf, valid: false, command_raw: 0 };
        }
        let raw = buf[0];
        let valid = matches!(raw, 1 | 2 | 5 | 6 | 9);
        Self { buf, valid, command_raw: raw }
    }

    pub fn ok(&self) -> bool { self.valid }
    pub fn command_raw(&self) -> u8 { self.command_raw }
    pub fn command(&self) -> Option<EIPCCommand> {
        match self.command_raw {
            1 => Some(EIPCCommand::InterfaceCall),
            2 => Some(EIPCCommand::FlushCallbacks),
            5 => Some(EIPCCommand::Destroy),
            6 => Some(EIPCCommand::Heartbeat),
            9 => Some(EIPCCommand::Handshake),
            _ => None,
        }
    }

    /// Bytes after the 1-byte command header.
    pub fn body(&self) -> &'a [u8] {
        if self.buf.len() > 1 { &self.buf[1..] } else { &[] }
    }
}

#[derive(Copy, Clone)]
pub struct IPCInterfaceCall<'a> {
    body: &'a [u8],
    valid: bool,
    interface_id_raw: u8,
    h_steam_user: u32,
    func_hash: u32,
}

impl<'a> IPCInterfaceCall<'a> {
    /// Header is 1 + 4 + 4 = 9 bytes packed.
    pub fn new(body: &'a [u8]) -> Self {
        if body.len() < 9 {
            return Self { body, valid: false, interface_id_raw: 0, h_steam_user: 0, func_hash: 0 };
        }
        let interface_id_raw = body[0];
        let h_steam_user = u32::from_le_bytes([body[1], body[2], body[3], body[4]]);
        let func_hash = u32::from_le_bytes([body[5], body[6], body[7], body[8]]);
        Self { body, valid: true, interface_id_raw, h_steam_user, func_hash }
    }

    pub fn ok(&self) -> bool { self.valid }
    pub fn interface_id(&self) -> EIPCInterface {
        // Safety: constructed from a u8; callers only compare, and any
        // byte value is representable as an EIPCInterface discriminant
        // for the purposes of equality checks.
        unsafe { core::mem::transmute(self.interface_id_raw) }
    }
    pub fn interface_id_raw(&self) -> u8 { self.interface_id_raw }
    pub fn h_steam_user(&self) -> u32 { self.h_steam_user }
    pub fn func_hash(&self) -> u32 { self.func_hash }

    /// Bytes after the 9-byte interface-call header.
    pub fn body_after_header(&self) -> &'a [u8] {
        &self.body[9..]
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use core::mem::size_of;

    #[test]
    fn enum_layouts() {
        assert_eq!(EIPCCommand::InterfaceCall as u8, 1);
        assert_eq!(EIPCCommand::Handshake as u8, 9);
        assert_eq!(EIPCResult::OK as u8, 0x0B);
        assert_eq!(EIPCResult::Failed as u8, 0x0C);
        assert_eq!(EIPCInterface::IClientUser as u8, 1);
        assert_eq!(EIPCInterface::IClientUtils as u8, 4);
        assert_eq!(EIPCInterface::IClientNetworkingSocketsSerialized as u8, 46);
        assert_eq!(EIPCInterface::IClientTimeline as u8, 61);
        assert_eq!(size_of::<EIPCCommand>(), 1);
        assert_eq!(size_of::<EIPCResult>(), 1);
        assert_eq!(size_of::<EIPCInterface>(), 1);
    }

    #[test]
    fn packed_header_sizes() {
        assert_eq!(size_of::<IPCRequestHeader>(), 1);
        assert_eq!(size_of::<IPCInterfaceCallHeader>(), 9);
        assert_eq!(size_of::<IPCResponseHeader>(), 1);
        assert_eq!(size_of::<IPCHandshakeReq>(), 12);
    }

    #[test]
    fn ipc_request_parse_interface_call() {
        let buf = [1u8, 0, 0, 0, 0]; // InterfaceCall, 4 bytes of body
        let r = IPCRequest::new(&buf);
        assert!(r.ok());
        assert_eq!(r.command(), Some(EIPCCommand::InterfaceCall));
        assert_eq!(r.body().len(), 4);
    }

    #[test]
    fn ipc_request_parse_handshake() {
        let buf = [9u8, 1, 0, 0, 0, 2, 0, 0, 0, 3, 0, 0, 0];
        let r = IPCRequest::new(&buf);
        assert!(r.ok());
        assert_eq!(r.command(), Some(EIPCCommand::Handshake));
        let hs: IPCHandshakeReq = unsafe {
            core::ptr::read_unaligned(r.body().as_ptr() as *const IPCHandshakeReq)
        };
        // Packed struct fields must be read via read_unaligned, not field
        // access (which would create a misaligned reference).
        unsafe {
            let v = core::ptr::read_unaligned(core::ptr::addr_of!(hs.version));
            let p = core::ptr::read_unaligned(core::ptr::addr_of!(hs.pid));
            let t = core::ptr::read_unaligned(core::ptr::addr_of!(hs.tid));
            assert_eq!(v, 1);
            assert_eq!(p, 2);
            assert_eq!(t, 3);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn ipc_request_rejects_empty() {
        let r = IPCRequest::new(&[]);
        assert!(!r.ok());
    }

    #[test]
    fn ipc_interface_call_parse() {
        // header: interface=1 (IClientUser), hSteamUser=0x42, funcHash=0xDEADBEEF
        let body = [
            1u8,
            0x42, 0, 0, 0,
            0xEF, 0xBE, 0xAD, 0xDE,
            0xAA, 0xBB, // trailing payload bytes
        ];
        let c = IPCInterfaceCall::new(&body);
        assert!(c.ok());
        assert_eq!(c.interface_id_raw(), 1);
        assert_eq!(c.h_steam_user(), 0x42);
        assert_eq!(c.func_hash(), 0xDEADBEEF);
        assert_eq!(c.body_after_header(), &[0xAA, 0xBB]);
    }

    #[test]
    fn ipc_interface_call_short_body_fails() {
        let body = [1u8, 0, 0];
        let c = IPCInterfaceCall::new(&body);
        assert!(!c.ok());
    }
}

===== FILE: src\steam\net_packet.rs =====
//! Runtime detection of `CNetPacket`'s `m_pubData` / `m_cubData` offsets.
//! Source: `Steam/NetPacket.h`
//!
//! The two candidates differ by 8 (the beta client inserted two uint32
//! version stamps after `m_hConnection`). Everything else is unchanged.
//!
//! ## API shape
//!
//! The C++ header returns `uint8*&` / `uint32&` - references to the fields
//! inside the live packet. Every call site in the codebase uses these as a
//! plain load/store pair:
//!
//! ```text
//!   uint8* orig = NetPkt::Data(p);
//!   NetPkt::Data(p) = replacement;
//!   ... call the original ...
//!   NetPkt::Data(p) = orig;
//! ```
//!
//! Rust has no safe way to hand out a `&mut *mut u8` at an arbitrary
//! byte offset inside a `#[repr(...)]`-opaque object without inviting
//! misaligned-reference UB. Instead we expose the four operations the
//! call sites actually need - [`read_data`], [`write_data`], [`read_size`],
//! [`write_size`] - each of which uses `read_unaligned` / `write_unaligned`
//! and therefore accepts packets at any alignment.
//!
//! When the layout is unresolved or disabled, all four route through a
//! single scratch slot. Reads see a null pointer / zero; writes are
//! discarded. That mirrors the "trash" fallback in the C++ version, so a
//! call added above the gate corrupts a dead global instead of a live
//! Steam object.

use core::sync::atomic::{AtomicU32, Ordering};

#[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Layout {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub data_off: u32,
}

pub const K_LAYOUTS: &[Layout] = &[
    Layout { name: "stable", data_off: 0x08 },
    Layout { name: "beta",   data_off: 0x10 },
];

pub const K_UNRESOLVED: u32 = 0;
pub const K_DISABLED: u32 = 0xFFFF_FFFF;

static G_DATA_OFF: AtomicU32 = AtomicU32::new(K_UNRESOLVED);

#[inline]
pub fn state() -> u32 { G_DATA_OFF.load(Ordering::Relaxed) }

#[inline]
pub fn is_resolved() -> bool {
    let v = state();
    v != K_UNRESOLVED && v != K_DISABLED
}

#[inline]
pub fn is_disabled() -> bool { state() == K_DISABLED }

#[inline]
pub fn latch(data_off: u32) { G_DATA_OFF.store(data_off, Ordering::Relaxed); }

#[inline]
pub fn disable() { G_DATA_OFF.store(K_DISABLED, Ordering::Relaxed); }

/// Scratch slot returned when the layout is unresolved. A plain static,
/// not thread-local: Steam threads predate our injection, and races on a
/// discard sink are harmless by construction.
pub mod detail {
    pub static mut TRASH_DATA: *mut u8 = core::ptr::null_mut();
    pub static mut TRASH_SIZE: u32 = 0;
}

/// Read the `m_pubData` pointer out of the packet.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// `p` must point to at least `off + 8` bytes of readable memory, or the
/// layout must be unresolved/disabled (in which case a scratch slot is
/// returned and `p` is not touched).
#[inline]
pub unsafe fn read_data(p: *mut u8) -> *mut u8 {
    let off = state();
    if p.is_null() || off == K_UNRESOLVED || off == K_DISABLED {
        return detail::TRASH_DATA;
    }
    core::ptr::read_unaligned(p.add(off as usize) as *const *mut u8)
}

/// Write the `m_pubData` pointer inside the packet.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// Same requirements as [`read_data`].
#[inline]
pub unsafe fn write_data(p: *mut u8, value: *mut u8) {
    let off = state();
    if p.is_null() || off == K_UNRESOLVED || off == K_DISABLED {
        detail::TRASH_DATA = value;
        return;
    }
    core::ptr::write_unaligned(p.add(off as usize) as *mut *mut u8, value);
}

/// Read the `m_cubData` u32 out of the packet.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// Same requirements as [`read_data`], with the range extended by 12 bytes
/// (the u32 plus the cRef that follows).
#[inline]
pub unsafe fn read_size(p: *mut u8) -> u32 {
    let off = state();
    if p.is_null() || off == K_UNRESOLVED || off == K_DISABLED {
        return detail::TRASH_SIZE;
    }
    core::ptr::read_unaligned(p.add(off as usize + 8) as *const u32)
}

/// Write the `m_cubData` u32 inside the packet.
///
/// # Safety
///
/// Same requirements as [`read_size`].
#[inline]
pub unsafe fn write_size(p: *mut u8, value: u32) {
    let off = state();
    if p.is_null() || off == K_UNRESOLVED || off == K_DISABLED {
        detail::TRASH_SIZE = value;
        return;
    }
    core::ptr::write_unaligned(p.add(off as usize + 8) as *mut u32, value);
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use std::sync::Mutex;

    static TEST_LOCK: Mutex<()> = Mutex::new(());

    fn reset() {
        G_DATA_OFF.store(K_UNRESOLVED, Ordering::Relaxed);
        unsafe {
            detail::TRASH_DATA = core::ptr::null_mut();
            detail::TRASH_SIZE = 0;
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn latch_then_resolved() {
        let _g = TEST_LOCK.lock().unwrap();
        reset();
        assert!(!is_resolved());
        assert!(!is_disabled());
        latch(0x08);
        assert!(is_resolved());
        assert!(!is_disabled());
        assert_eq!(state(), 0x08);
    }

    #[test]
    fn disable_is_terminal() {
        let _g = TEST_LOCK.lock().unwrap();
        reset();
        latch(0x10);
        disable();
        assert!(is_disabled());
        assert!(!is_resolved());
        assert_eq!(state(), K_DISABLED);
    }

    #[test]
    fn read_write_when_unresolved_uses_trash() {
        let _g = TEST_LOCK.lock().unwrap();
        reset();
        // A byte-aligned buffer - deliberately not 8-aligned - so any
        // attempt to form an aligned reference would be caught.
        let mut packet = [0u8; 0x40];
        unsafe {
            write_data(packet.as_mut_ptr(), 0x1234 as *mut u8);
            write_size(packet.as_mut_ptr(), 0x5678);
            assert_eq!(read_data(packet.as_mut_ptr()) as usize, 0x1234);
            assert_eq!(read_size(packet.as_mut_ptr()), 0x5678);
            // packet bytes must be untouched
            assert!(packet.iter().all(|&b| b == 0));
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn read_write_at_stable_offset() {
        let _g = TEST_LOCK.lock().unwrap();
        reset();
        latch(0x08);
        // Byte-aligned buffer. `write_unaligned` / `read_unaligned` must
        // handle this without UB.
        let mut buf = [0u8; 0x20];
        let mut target: u8 = 0xAB;
        unsafe {
            let p = buf.as_mut_ptr();
            write_data(p, &mut target as *mut u8);
            write_size(p, 42);
            assert_eq!(read_data(p) as *mut u8, &mut target as *mut u8);
            assert_eq!(read_size(p), 42);
            // Confirm the bytes actually landed where expected.
            let stored = core::ptr::read_unaligned(p.add(0x08) as *const *mut u8);
            assert_eq!(stored as *mut u8, &mut target as *mut u8);
            let stored_size = core::ptr::read_unaligned(p.add(0x10) as *const u32);
            assert_eq!(stored_size, 42);
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn read_write_at_beta_offset() {
        let _g = TEST_LOCK.lock().unwrap();
        reset();
        latch(0x10);
        let mut buf = [0u8; 0x30];
        let mut target: u8 = 0xCD;
        unsafe {
            let p = buf.as_mut_ptr();
            write_data(p, &mut target as *mut u8);
            write_size(p, 99);
            assert_eq!(read_data(p) as *mut u8, &mut target as *mut u8);
            assert_eq!(read_size(p), 99);
            let stored = core::ptr::read_unaligned(p.add(0x10) as *const *mut u8);
            assert_eq!(stored as *mut u8, &mut target as *mut u8);
            let stored_size = core::ptr::read_unaligned(p.add(0x18) as *const u32);
            assert_eq!(stored_size, 99);
        }
    }
}


===== FILE: src\steam\proto.rs =====
//! Generated protobuf types for Steam messages.
//!
//! Source of truth: `proto/steam_messages.proto`. The build script runs
//! `prost-build` and drops the generated Rust module into `OUT_DIR`;
//! this file includes it.
//!
//! Field numbers and wire types are preserved exactly from the
//! `.proto`. The prost runtime uses a different in-memory
//! representation from the C++ protobuf runtime, so any code path that
//! needs to pass a message through a C++ protobuf helper (e.g.
//! `RepeatedField<uint32>::Add`) cannot be ported directly. See
//! `STUBS.md` "Known behavioural divergences".
//!
//! ## Naming
//!
//! prost converts the proto message and field names to Rust
//! conventions. Message names like `CMsgProtoBufHeader` stay as-is;
//! field names like `jobid_source` stay in snake_case; enum variants
//! are prefixed with the enum name and PascalCased. `optional` fields
//! become `Option<T>`; `repeated` fields become `Vec<T>`.

#![allow(non_snake_case)]
#![allow(non_camel_case_types)]
#![allow(clippy::all)]

include!(concat!(env!("OUT_DIR"), "/steam_messages.rs"));


===== FILE: src\steam\structs.rs =====
//! In-memory structures mirrored from steamclient internals.
//! Source: `Steam/Structs.h`
//!
//! Layout-critical. All `#[repr(C)]` or `#[repr(C, packed)]` to match the
//! C++ `#pragma pack` regions. Bitfield containers are modelled as plain
//! integers with explicit mask/shift accessors because Rust has no
//! bitfields.

#![allow(non_camel_case_types)]
#![allow(non_upper_case_globals)]

use core::ffi::c_void;
use super::types::*;
use super::enums::*;

// ─── CUtlMemory<T> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct CUtlMemory<T> {
    pub m_pMemory: *mut T,
    pub m_nAllocationCount: u32,
    pub m_nGrowSize: u32,
}

// ─── CUtlVector<T> ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct CUtlVector<T> {
    pub m_Memory: CUtlMemory<T>,
    pub m_Size: u32,
}

impl<T: Copy + PartialEq> CUtlVector<T> {
    /// Swap-with-last removal, then shrink. Order is not preserved.
    /// Matches the C++ method exactly, including the no-op if `elem >= m_Size`.
    pub unsafe fn fast_remove(&mut self, elem: u32) {
        if elem < self.m_Size {
            if elem != self.m_Size - 1 {
                let src = self.m_Memory.m_pMemory.add((self.m_Size - 1) as usize);
                let dst = self.m_Memory.m_pMemory.add(elem as usize);
                *dst = *src;
            }
            self.m_Size -= 1;
        }
    }

    pub unsafe fn find_and_fast_remove(&mut self, src: &T) -> bool {
        for i in 0..self.m_Size {
            if *self.m_Memory.m_pMemory.add(i as usize) == *src {
                self.fast_remove(i);
                return true;
            }
        }
        false
    }
}

// ─── CUtlBuffer ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//
// The C++ version carries two member-function pointers used to grow the
// buffer. We model them as free-function pointers of the same size (8
// bytes on x64). The C++ code never calls them via our port; only the
// layout matters. If call sites eventually need to invoke them we can
// switch to a `this`-aware calling convention.

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Copy, Clone)]
pub struct CUtlBuffer {
    pub m_Memory: CUtlMemory<u8>,
    pub m_Get: i32,
    pub m_Put: i32,
    pub m_nOffset: i32,
    pub m_flags: i32,
    pub m_GetOverflowFunc: Option<unsafe extern "C" fn(i32) -> bool>,
    pub m_PutOverflowFunc: Option<unsafe extern "C" fn(i32) -> bool>,
}

impl CUtlBuffer {
    pub fn base(&self) -> *mut u8 { self.m_Memory.m_pMemory }
    pub fn tell_put(&self) -> i32 { self.m_Put }
    pub fn tell_get(&self) -> i32 { self.m_Get }
    pub fn size(&self) -> u32 { self.m_Memory.m_nAllocationCount }
    pub fn capacity(&self) -> u32 { self.m_Memory.m_nAllocationCount }
}

// ─── PackageInfo ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Copy, Clone)]
pub struct PackageInfo {
    pub PackageId: AppId_t,
    pub ChangeNumber: i32,
    pub PICS_token: u64,
    pub BillingType: BillingType,
    pub LicenseType: ELicenseType,
    pub Status: EPackageStatus,
    pub SHA_1_Hash: [u8; 20],
    pub pPackageInfoNodeBegin: *mut c_void,
    pub pExtendNodeBegin: *mut c_void,
    pub AppIdVec: CUtlVector<AppId_t>,
    pub DepotIdVec: CUtlVector<AppId_t>,
}

// ─── AppOwnership ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Copy, Clone)]
pub struct AppOwnership {

// ─── KeyValues ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//
// static_assert(sizeof(KeyValues) == 0x20) in C++.

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Copy, Clone)]
pub union KeyValuesValue {
    pub m_pSub: *mut KeyValues,
    pub m_sValue: *mut i8,
    pub m_wsValue: *mut u16,
    pub m_iValue: i32,
    pub m_flValue: f32,
    pub m_pValue: *mut c_void,
    pub m_ullValue: u64,
    pub m_llValue: i64,
    pub m_Color: [u8; 8],
}

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Copy, Clone)]
pub struct KeyValues {
    pub value: KeyValuesValue,
    pub m_pChain: *mut KeyValues,
    /// Packed bitfield container:
    ///   bits  0..24 (25)  m_iKeyName
    ///   bits 25..28 ( 4)  m_iDataType
    ///   bit      29 ( 1)  m_bHasEscapeSequences
    ///   bit      30 ( 1)  m_bEvaluateConditionals
    ///   bit      31 ( 1)  m_bAllocatedValue
    pub m_iPackedKeyAndType: u32,
    pub m_unFlags: u32,
    pub m_pPeer: *mut KeyValues,
}

impl KeyValues {
    pub const fn key_name(&self) -> u32 { self.m_iPackedKeyAndType & 0x01FF_FFFF }
    pub const fn data_type(&self) -> u32 { (self.m_iPackedKeyAndType >> 25) & 0x0F }
    pub const fn has_escape_sequences(&self) -> bool { (self.m_iPackedKeyAndType >> 29) & 1 != 0 }
    pub const fn evaluate_conditionals(&self) -> bool { (self.m_iPackedKeyAndType >> 30) & 1 != 0 }
    pub const fn allocated_value(&self) -> bool { (self.m_iPackedKeyAndType >> 31) & 1 != 0 }
}

const _: () = assert!(core::mem::size_of::<KeyValues>() == 0x20);

// ─── IKeyValuesSystem ───────────────────────────────────────────────
//
// Vtable-based C++ interface. We model the vtable explicitly and expose
// safe wrappers for the two methods the codebase uses.

#[repr(C)]
pub struct IKeyValuesSystemVtable {
    pub register_sizeof_keyvalues: unsafe extern "C" fn(this: *mut IKeyValuesSystem, size: i32),
    pub get_symbol_for_string: unsafe extern "C" fn(this: *mut IKeyValuesSystem, name: *const i8, create: bool) -> i32,
    pub get_string_for_symbol: unsafe extern "C" fn(this: *mut IKeyValuesSystem, symbol: i32) -> *const i8,
}

#[repr(C)]
pub struct IKeyValuesSystem {
    pub vtable: *const IKeyValuesSystemVtable,
}

impl IKeyValuesSystem {
    pub unsafe fn get_symbol(&self, name: *const i8) -> i32 {
        ((*self.vtable).get_symbol_for_string)(self as *const _ as *mut _, name, false)
    }
    pub unsafe fn get_or_create_symbol(&self, name: *const i8) -> i32 {
        ((*self.vtable).get_symbol_for_string)(self as *const _ as *mut _, name, true)
    }
    pub unsafe fn get_key_name(&self, symbol: i32) -> *const i8 {
        ((*self.vtable).get_string_for_symbol)(self as *const _ as *mut _, symbol)
    }
}

pub type KeyValuesSystemSteam_t = unsafe extern "C" fn() -> *mut IKeyValuesSystem;

// ─── CGameID ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//
// Union of a u64 and a struct with bitfields:
//   m_nAppID : 24   bits 0..23
//   m_nType  :  8   bits 24..31
//   m_nModID : 32   bits 32..63
// MSVC x64 packs bitfields from the least-significant bit up.

#[repr(transparent)]
#[derive(Copy, Clone, Default, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub struct CGameID {
    pub m_ulGameID: u64,
}

impl CGameID {
    pub const APP_ID_MASK: u64 = 0x00FF_FFFF;
    pub const TYPE_SHIFT: u32 = 24;

    pub fn app_id(&self, check_type: bool) -> AppId_t {
        if check_type && !self.is_steam_app() { return 0; }
        (self.m_ulGameID & Self::APP_ID_MASK) as AppId_t
    }
    pub fn set_app_id(&mut self, app_id: AppId_t) {
        self.m_ulGameID = (self.m_ulGameID & !Self::APP_ID_MASK)
            | ((app_id as u64) & Self::APP_ID_MASK);
    }
    pub fn is_steam_app(&self) -> bool {
        ((self.m_ulGameID >> Self::TYPE_SHIFT) & 0xFF) == 0
    }
}

const _: () = assert!(core::mem::size_of::<CGameID>() == 8);

// ─── CSteamID ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
//
// Union of a u64 and a struct with bitfields:
//   m_unAccountID        : 32   bits  0..31
//   m_unAccountInstance  : 20   bits 32..51
//   m_EAccountType       :  4   bits 52..55
//   m_EUniverse          :  8   bits 56..63

#[repr(transparent)]
#[derive(Copy, Clone, Default, PartialEq, Eq, Hash)]
pub struct CSteamID {
    pub m_unAll64Bits: u64,
}

pub const k_unSteamAccountIDMask: u32 = 0xFFFF_FFFF;
pub const k_unSteamAccountInstanceMask: u32 = 0x000F_FFFF;
pub const k_unSteamUserDefaultInstance: u32 = 1;

impl CSteamID {
    pub fn new() -> Self { Self::default() }
    pub fn from_u64(id: u64) -> Self { Self { m_unAll64Bits: id } }
    pub fn convert_to_u64(&self) -> u64 { self.m_unAll64Bits }

    pub fn set_from_u64(&mut self, id: u64) { self.m_unAll64Bits = id; }

    pub fn set(&mut self, account_id: u32, universe: EUniverse, account_type: EAccountType) {
        let instance: u64 = if matches!(account_type, EAccountType::Clan | EAccountType::GameServer) {
            0
        } else {
            k_unSteamUserDefaultInstance as u64
        };
        let mut v = 0u64;
        v |= account_id as u64;
        v |= (instance & 0x000F_FFFF) << 32;
        v |= ((account_type as u64) & 0x0F) << 52;
        v |= ((universe as u64) & 0xFF) << 56;
        self.m_unAll64Bits = v;
    }

    pub fn account_id(&self) -> AccountID_t {
        (self.m_unAll64Bits & 0xFFFF_FFFF) as AccountID_t
    }
    pub fn set_account_id(&mut self, id: AccountID_t) {
        self.m_unAll64Bits = (self.m_unAll64Bits & !0xFFFF_FFFF) | (id as u64);
    }
    pub fn account_instance(&self) -> u32 {
        ((self.m_unAll64Bits >> 32) & 0x000F_FFFF) as u32
    }
    pub fn account_type_raw(&self) -> u8 {
        ((self.m_unAll64Bits >> 52) & 0x0F) as u8
    }
    pub fn universe_raw(&self) -> u8 {
        ((self.m_unAll64Bits >> 56) & 0xFF) as u8
    }
}

impl core::fmt::Debug for CSteamID {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut core::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> core::fmt::Result {
        write!(f, "CSteamID({})", self.m_unAll64Bits)
    }
}

impl core::fmt::Display for CSteamID {
    fn fmt(&self, f: &mut core::fmt::Formatter<'_>) -> core::fmt::Result {
        write!(f, "{}", self.m_unAll64Bits)
    }
}

const _: () = assert!(core::mem::size_of::<CSteamID>() == 8);

}

impl CAppData {
    pub fn has_empty_app_info_sha(&self) -> bool {
        self.sha1Hash.iter().all(|&b| b == 0)
    }
    pub fn is_unresolved_app_info(&self) -> bool {
        self.has_empty_app_info_sha() && !self.bSkipFlag
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use core::mem::size_of;

    #[test]
    fn depot_entry_layout() {
        assert_eq!(size_of::<DepotEntry>(), 0x20);
    }

    #[test]
    fn keyvalues_layout() {
        assert_eq!(size_of::<KeyValues>(), 0x20);
    }

    #[test]
    fn cgameid_roundtrip() {
        let mut g = CGameID::default();
        g.set_app_id(730);
        assert_eq!(g.app_id(false), 730);
        assert!(g.is_steam_app());
        g.m_ulGameID |= 1 << CGameID::TYPE_SHIFT; // set type = 1 (GameMod)
        assert!(!g.is_steam_app());
        assert_eq!(g.app_id(true), 0);
        assert_eq!(g.app_id(false), 730);
    }

    #[test]
    fn csteamid_set_and_extract() {
        let mut s = CSteamID::new();
        s.set(0x1234_5678, EUniverse::Public, EAccountType::Individual);
        assert_eq!(s.account_id(), 0x1234_5678);
        assert_eq!(s.account_instance(), k_unSteamUserDefaultInstance);
        assert_eq!(s.account_type_raw(), EAccountType::Individual as u8);
        assert_eq!(s.universe_raw(), EUniverse::Public as u8);

        let mut c = CSteamID::new();
        c.set(999, EUniverse::Public, EAccountType::Clan);
        assert_eq!(c.account_instance(), 0); // Clan -> no instance
    }

        #[test]
    fn csteamid_round_trip_through_u64() {
        let mut s = CSteamID::new();
        s.set(0xDEAD_BEEF, EUniverse::Public, EAccountType::Individual);
        let raw = s.convert_to_u64();
        let s2 = CSteamID::from_u64(raw);
        assert_eq!(s2.account_id(), 0xDEAD_BEEF);
    }

    #[test]
    fn keyvalues_bitfield_accessors() {
        let mut kv: KeyValues = unsafe { core::mem::zeroed() };
        kv.m_iPackedKeyAndType = 0;
        // Bits 0..24: key name
        kv.m_iPackedKeyAndType |= 0x1_2345;
        assert_eq!(kv.key_name(), 0x1_2345);
        // Bits 25..28: data type
        kv.m_iPackedKeyAndType |= 7 << 25;
        assert_eq!(kv.data_type(), 7);
        // Bit 29: escape sequences
        kv.m_iPackedKeyAndType |= 1 << 29;
        assert!(kv.has_escape_sequences());
        // Bit 30: evaluate conditionals
        kv.m_iPackedKeyAndType |= 1 << 30;
        assert!(kv.evaluate_conditionals());
        // Bit 31: allocated value
        kv.m_iPackedKeyAndType |= 1u32 << 31;
        assert!(kv.allocated_value());
    }

    #[test]
    fn extended_msg_hdr_is_packed() {
        // 4 + 1 + 2 + 8 + 8 + 1 + 8 + 4 = 36 bytes when packed.
        assert_eq!(size_of::<ExtendedMsgHdr>(), 36);
    }

    #[test]
    fn cpipclient_size_from_padding() {
        // Sum: 8 + 8 + 4 + 12 + 4 + 4 + 8 + 80 + 4 + 188 + 8 + 1 + 31 = 360.
        assert_eq!(size_of::<CPipeClient>(), 360);
    }

    #[test]
    fn capp_data_empty_sha_check() {
        let d: CAppData = unsafe { core::mem::zeroed() };
        assert!(d.has_empty_app_info_sha());
        assert!(d.is_unresolved_app_info());

        let mut d2 = d;
        d2.sha1Hash[0] = 1;
        assert!(!d2.has_empty_app_info_sha());
        assert!(!d2.is_unresolved_app_info());
    }

    #[test]
    fn cutlvector_fast_remove_logic() {
        // Heap-allocate a small array, wire it into a CUtlVector, and
        // exercise fast_remove against the raw pointer.
        let mut storage: [u32; 4] = [10, 20, 30, 40];
        let mut v = CUtlVector::<u32> {
            m_Memory: CUtlMemory {
                m_pMemory: storage.as_mut_ptr(),
                m_nAllocationCount: 4,
                m_nGrowSize: 0,
            },
            m_Size: 4,
        };
        unsafe {
            assert!(v.find_and_fast_remove(&30));
            assert_eq!(v.m_Size, 3);
            // 30 was at index 2; fast_remove swapped in the last element (40).
            assert_eq!(*v.m_Memory.m_pMemory.add(0), 10);
            assert_eq!(*v.m_Memory.m_pMemory.add(1), 20);
            assert_eq!(*v.m_Memory.m_pMemory.add(2), 40);
        }
    }
}

//! Primitive typedefs and ID handles used throughout steamclient internals.
//!
//! Source: `Steam/Types.h`
//!
//! Layout and values are preserved exactly, including the wrapped values for
//! `k_uPackageIdWallet` and `k_uPackageIdMicroTxn` (C++ assigns `-2` and `-3`
//! to a `uint32_t`, which wraps to `0xFFFFFFFE` and `0xFFFFFFFD`).

#![allow(non_camel_case_types)]
#![allow(non_upper_case_globals)]

pub type byte = u8;
pub type int32 = i32;
pub type int64 = i64;
pub type uint8 = u8;
pub type uint16 = u16;
pub type uint32 = u32;
pub type uint64 = u64;

pub type AppId_t = u32;
pub type PackageId_t = u32;
pub type PID_t = u32;
pub type AccountID_t = u32;
pub type HAuthTicket = u32;
pub type HCONNECTION = u32;

pub type HSteamPipe = i32;
pub type HSteamUser = i32;

pub type GID_t = u64;
pub type SteamAPICall_t = u64;
pub type JobID_t = GID_t;

pub const k_uAppIdInvalid: AppId_t = 0x0;
pub const k_uPackageIdFreeSub: PackageId_t = 0x0;
pub const k_uPackageIdInvalid: PackageId_t = 0xFFFF_FFFF;
/// C++: `PackageId_t k_uPackageIdWallet = -2;` -> wraps to 0xFFFFFFFE.
pub const k_uPackageIdWallet: PackageId_t = 0xFFFF_FFFE;
/// C++: `PackageId_t k_uPackageIdMicroTxn = -3;` -> wraps to 0xFFFFFFFD.
pub const k_uPackageIdMicroTxn: PackageId_t = 0xFFFF_FFFD;
pub const k_GIDNil: GID_t = 0xFFFF_FFFF_FFFF_FFFF;
pub const k_uAPICallInvalid: SteamAPICall_t = 0x0;

#[cfg(test)]

    use super::*;
    use core::mem::size_of;

    #[test]

        assert_eq!(size_of::<byte>(), 1);
        assert_eq!(size_of::<int32>(), 4);
        assert_eq!(size_of::<int64>(), 8);
        assert_eq!(size_of::<uint8>(), 1);
        assert_eq!(size_of::<uint16>(), 2);

    }

        assert_eq!(size_of::<GID_t>(), 8);
        assert_eq!(size_of::<SteamAPICall_t>(), 8);
        assert_eq!(size_of::<JobID_t>(), 8);
    }

    #[test]

        assert_eq!(k_uPackageIdMicroTxn, 0xFFFF_FFFDu32);

        assert_eq!(k_uAPICallInvalid, 0);
        assert_eq!(k_uAppIdInvalid, 0);
    }

===== FILE: src\utils\cloud_redirect\host.rs =====
//! Cloud save redirection host. Source: `CloudRedirectHost.cpp`.
//!
//! Loads `cloud_redirect.dll` from the Steam directory, resolves its
//! `CR_*` exports, and exposes wrappers the NetPacket hook will use to
//! answer `Cloud.*` RPCs locally. All entry points are no-ops unless
//! `[cloud].enabled` is set and the DLL loaded successfully.
//!
//! The `CR_*` ABI is declared locally, matching the C++ which declared
//! it inline rather than pulling in CloudRedirect's headers.

use std::ffi::c_void;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};
use std::sync::Mutex;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, AtomicPtr, Ordering};

use crate::platform::dynamic_library::{self, ModuleHandle};
use crate::utils::config::{config, lua_config};

// ── CR_* ABI ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

type CrNotifyFn = extern "C" fn(i32, *const i8, *const i8);

type CrInitCloudSaveFn = extern "C" fn(*const i8, CrNotifyFn) -> bool;
type CrHandleCloudRpcFn = extern "C" fn(
    *const i8, u32, u32,
    *const u8, u32,
    *mut u8, u32,
    *mut u32, *mut i32,
) -> bool;
type CrSetAppsFn = extern "C" fn(*const u32, u32);
type CrIsAppFn = extern "C" fn(u32) -> bool;
type CrShutdownFn = extern "C" fn();
type CrEnableStatsSyncFn = extern "C" fn(bool, bool);
type CrSetAccountIdFn = extern "C" fn(u32);
type CrNotifyAppRunningFn = extern "C" fn(u32, bool);
type CrNotifyStatsStoredFn = extern "C" fn(u32);

#[repr(C)]
#[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct AchievementBlock {
    pub stat_id: u32,
    pub bits: u32,
    pub unlock_times: [u32; 32],
}

type CrGetAchievementsFn = extern "C" fn(u32, *mut AchievementBlock, u32) -> u32;
type CrInstallVtableHooksFn = extern "C" fn() -> bool;

// ── Globals ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

struct State {
    active: bool,
    module: ModuleHandle,
    init_cloud_save: Option<CrInitCloudSaveFn>,
    handle_cloud_rpc: Option<CrHandleCloudRpcFn>,
    set_apps: Option<CrSetAppsFn>,
    is_app: Option<CrIsAppFn>,
    shutdown: Option<CrShutdownFn>,
    enable_stats_sync: Option<CrEnableStatsSyncFn>,
    set_account_id: Option<CrSetAccountIdFn>,
    notify_app_running: Option<CrNotifyAppRunningFn>,
    notify_stats_stored: Option<CrNotifyStatsStoredFn>,
    get_achievements: Option<CrGetAchievementsFn>,
    install_vtable_hooks: Option<CrInstallVtableHooksFn>,
}

static STATE: Mutex<Option<State>> = Mutex::new(None);
static ACTIVE: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);

fn with_state<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&State) -> R) -> Option<R> {
    let g = STATE.lock().expect("poisoned");
    g.as_ref().map(f)
}

// ── Notify shim ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

extern "C" fn cloud_notify(level: i32, title: *const i8, message: *const i8) {
    let t = if title.is_null() { "CloudRedirect".to_string() }
            else { unsafe { std::ffi::CStr::from_ptr(title) }.to_string_lossy().into_owned() };
    let m = if message.is_null() { String::new() }
            else { unsafe { std::ffi::CStr::from_ptr(message) }.to_string_lossy().into_owned() };
    match level {
        2 => LOG_ERROR!("[CloudRedirect] {}: {}", t, m),
        1 => LOG_WARN!("[CloudRedirect] {}: {}", t, m),
        _ => LOG_INFO!("[CloudRedirect] {}: {}", t, m),
    }
}

// ── Symbol resolution ───────────────────────────────────────────────

fn resolve_symbol<T: Copy>(module: ModuleHandle, name: &str, out: &mut Option<T>) -> bool {
    let ptr = unsafe { dynamic_library::get_symbol(module, name) };
    if ptr.is_null() {
        LOG_WARN!("CloudRedirect: export {} not found in cloud_redirect.dll", name);
        return false;
    }
    *out = Some(unsafe { std::mem::transmute_copy(&ptr) });
    true
}

fn resolve_optional<T: Copy>(module: ModuleHandle, name: &str, out: &mut Option<T>) {
    let ptr = unsafe { dynamic_library::get_symbol(module, name) };
    if !ptr.is_null() {
        *out = Some(unsafe { std::mem::transmute_copy(&ptr) });
    }
}

fn resolve_library_path(steam_root: &str, configured: &str) -> PathBuf {
    if configured.is_empty() {
        return PathBuf::from(steam_root).join("cloud_redirect.dll");
    }
    let p = Path::new(configured);
    if p.is_absolute() { p.to_path_buf() } else { PathBuf::from(steam_root).join(p) }
}

// ── Public API ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

pub fn initialize(steam_install_path: &str) {
    let cloud = config::get_cloud_settings();
    if !cloud.enabled {
        LOG_INFO!("CloudRedirect: [cloud].enabled is false, cloud save redirection disabled");
        return;
    }
    if steam_install_path.is_empty() {
        LOG_WARN!("CloudRedirect: empty Steam install path, cannot initialise");
        return;
    }

    if ACTIVE.load(Ordering::Acquire) { return; }

    let lib_path = resolve_library_path(steam_install_path, &cloud.library);
    if !lib_path.exists() {
        LOG_WARN!("CloudRedirect: cloud_redirect.dll not found at {}", lib_path.display());
        return;
    }

    let module = dynamic_library::load(&lib_path);
    if module.is_null() {
        LOG_WARN!("CloudRedirect: failed to load {} (err={})",
                  lib_path.display(), dynamic_library::get_last_error_code());
        return;
    }

    let mut state = State {
        active: false,
        module,
        init_cloud_save: None,
        handle_cloud_rpc: None,
        set_apps: None,
        is_app: None,
        shutdown: None,
        enable_stats_sync: None,
        set_account_id: None,
        notify_app_running: None,
        notify_stats_stored: None,
        get_achievements: None,
        install_vtable_hooks: None,
    };

    let mut ok = true;
    ok &= resolve_symbol(module, "CR_InitCloudSave",  &mut state.init_cloud_save);
    ok &= resolve_symbol(module, "CR_HandleCloudRpc", &mut state.handle_cloud_rpc);
    ok &= resolve_symbol(module, "CR_SetApps",        &mut state.set_apps);
    ok &= resolve_symbol(module, "CR_IsApp",          &mut state.is_app);
    ok &= resolve_symbol(module, "CR_Shutdown",       &mut state.shutdown);
    if !ok {
        LOG_WARN!("CloudRedirect: cloud_redirect.dll is missing required exports, disabling");
        return;
    }

    resolve_optional(module, "CR_EnableStatsSync",    &mut state.enable_stats_sync);
    resolve_optional(module, "CR_SetAccountId",       &mut state.set_account_id);
    resolve_optional(module, "CR_NotifyAppRunning",   &mut state.notify_app_running);
    resolve_optional(module, "CR_NotifyStatsStored",  &mut state.notify_stats_stored);
    resolve_optional(module, "CR_GetAchievements",    &mut state.get_achievements);
    resolve_optional(module, "CR_InstallVtableHooks", &mut state.install_vtable_hooks);

    let steam_path_c = match std::ffi::CString::new(steam_install_path) {
        Ok(c) => c,
        Err(_) => { LOG_WARN!("CloudRedirect: Steam path has interior NUL"); return; }
    };

    let init = state.init_cloud_save.unwrap();
    if !init(steam_path_c.as_ptr() as *const i8, cloud_notify) {
        LOG_WARN!("CloudRedirect: CR_InitCloudSave failed, disabling cloud save redirection");
        return;
    }

    state.active = true;
    LOG_INFO!("CloudRedirect: loaded {} and initialised cloud save redirection",
              lib_path.display());

    if let Some(enable) = state.enable_stats_sync {
        enable(true, true);
        LOG_INFO!("CloudRedirect: stats sync registered");
    }

    let depots = lua_config::get_all_depot_ids();
    let set_apps = state.set_apps.unwrap();
    set_apps(
        if depots.is_empty() { std::ptr::null() } else { depots.as_ptr() },
        depots.len() as u32,
    );
    LOG_INFO!("CloudRedirect: registered {} redirected app(s)", depots.len());

    if let Some(install) = state.install_vtable_hooks {
        if install() {
            LOG_INFO!("CloudRedirect: vtable hooks installed");
        } else {
            LOG_WARN!("CloudRedirect: vtable hook install failed, using packet-layer path");
        }
    }

    *STATE.lock().expect("poisoned") = Some(state);
    ACTIVE.store(true, Ordering::Release);
}

pub fn sync_app_set() {
    if !ACTIVE.load(Ordering::Acquire) { return; }
    let depots = lua_config::get_all_depot_ids();
    with_state(|s| {
        if let Some(set_apps) = s.set_apps {
            set_apps(
                if depots.is_empty() { std::ptr::null() } else { depots.as_ptr() },
                depots.len() as u32,
            );
            LOG_DEBUG!("CloudRedirect: re-synced redirected app set ({} app(s))", depots.len());
        }
    });
}

pub fn is_active() -> bool { ACTIVE.load(Ordering::Acquire) }

pub fn is_app(app_id: u32) -> bool {
    if !ACTIVE.load(Ordering::Acquire) { return false; }
    with_state(|s| s.is_app.map(|f| f(app_id)).unwrap_or(false)).unwrap_or(false)
}

pub fn handle_cloud_rpc(
    method: &str,
    app_id: u32,
    account_id: u32,
    req_body: &[u8],
    resp_buf: &mut [u8],
) -> Option<(usize, i32)> {
    if !ACTIVE.load(Ordering::Acquire) { return None; }
    let method_c = std::ffi::CString::new(method).ok()?;
    with_state(|s| {
        let f = s.handle_cloud_rpc?;
        let mut resp_len: u32 = 0;
        let mut eresult: i32 = 2; // k_EResultFail default
        let ok = f(
            method_c.as_ptr() as *const i8,
            app_id,
            account_id,
            req_body.as_ptr(),
            req_body.len() as u32,
            resp_buf.as_mut_ptr(),
            resp_buf.len() as u32,
            &mut resp_len,
            &mut eresult,
        );
        if ok { Some((resp_len as usize, eresult)) } else { None }
    }).flatten()
}

pub fn set_account_id(account_id: u32) {
    if !ACTIVE.load(Ordering::Acquire) { return; }
    with_state(|s| { if let Some(f) = s.set_account_id { f(account_id); } });
}

pub fn notify_app_running(app_id: u32, running: bool) {
    if !ACTIVE.load(Ordering::Acquire) { return; }
    with_state(|s| { if let Some(f) = s.notify_app_running { f(app_id, running); } });
}

pub fn notify_stats_stored(app_id: u32) {
    if !ACTIVE.load(Ordering::Acquire) { return; }
    with_state(|s| { if let Some(f) = s.notify_stats_stored { f(app_id); } });
}

pub fn get_achievements(app_id: u32, out: &mut [AchievementBlock]) -> usize {
    if !ACTIVE.load(Ordering::Acquire) { return 0; }
    with_state(|s| {
        s.get_achievements
            .map(|f| f(app_id, out.as_mut_ptr(), out.len() as u32) as usize)
            .unwrap_or(0)
    }).unwrap_or(0)
}

pub fn shutdown() {
    if !ACTIVE.swap(false, Ordering::AcqRel) { return; }
    let taken = STATE.lock().expect("poisoned").take();
    if let Some(s) = taken {
        if let Some(f) = s.shutdown { f(); }
        LOG_INFO!("CloudRedirect: shut down");
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn resolve_library_path_bare_name() {
        let p = resolve_library_path("C:\\Steam", "");
        assert_eq!(p, PathBuf::from("C:\\Steam").join("cloud_redirect.dll"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn resolve_library_path_absolute_wins() {
        let p = resolve_library_path("C:\\Steam", "D:\\other\\cr.dll");
        assert_eq!(p, PathBuf::from("D:\\other\\cr.dll"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn resolve_library_path_relative_joins() {
        let p = resolve_library_path("C:\\Steam", "bin\\cr.dll");
        assert_eq!(p, PathBuf::from("C:\\Steam").join("bin\\cr.dll"));
    }

    #[test]
    fn inactive_is_app_is_false() {
        // Global state may have been initialized by another test in a
        // shared-process run. Guard with the active check.
        if !is_active() {
            assert!(!is_app(12345));
        }
    }
}
