//! TOML configuration. Source: `Utils/Config/Config.cpp`, `Config.h`

use std::path::Path;
use std::sync::Mutex;

use serde::Deserialize;

use crate::bridge;

#[repr(i32)]
#[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum LogLevel { Trace, Debug, Info, Warn, Error }

impl LogLevel {
    pub fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            LogLevel::Trace => "trace",
            LogLevel::Debug => "debug",
            LogLevel::Info  => "info",
            LogLevel::Warn  => "warn",
            LogLevel::Error => "error",
        }
    }
}

#[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct ManifestTimeouts {
    pub resolve: u32, pub connect: u32, pub send: u32, pub recv: u32,
}

impl Default for ManifestTimeouts {
    fn default() -> Self { Self { resolve: 5000, connect: 5000, send: 10000, recv: 10000 } }
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct InjectDll {
    pub path: String,
    pub when_cmdline: String,
    pub when_appids: std::collections::HashSet<u32>,
    pub all_games: bool,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct CloudSettings { pub enabled: bool, pub library: String }

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct DonateSettings {
    pub enabled: bool, pub url: String,
    pub interval_secs: u32, pub max_mints_per_cycle: u32,
    pub min_mint_interval_ms: u32, pub max_mints_per_session: u32,
    pub wanted_refresh_secs: u32,
}

impl Default for DonateSettings {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self { enabled: true, url: String::new(), interval_secs: 30,
               max_mints_per_cycle: 25, min_mint_interval_ms: 2000,
               max_mints_per_session: 0, wanted_refresh_secs: 300 }
    }
}

#[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct LoadResult { pub applied: bool, pub lua_paths_changed: bool }

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
struct Snapshot {
    manifest_provider: String,
    manifest_timeouts: ManifestTimeouts,
    log_level: LogLevel,
    log_dir: String,
    lua_paths: Vec<String>,
    remote_url_templates: Vec<String>,
    stats_enable_api: bool,
    update_enabled: bool,
    donate: DonateSettings,
    inject_dlls: Vec<InjectDll>,
    cloud: CloudSettings,
}

impl Default for Snapshot {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            manifest_provider: "opensteamtool".into(),
            manifest_timeouts: ManifestTimeouts::default(),
            log_level: LogLevel::Debug,
            log_dir: String::new(),
            lua_paths: Vec::new(),
            remote_url_templates: Vec::new(),
            stats_enable_api: true,
            update_enabled: true,
            donate: DonateSettings::default(),
            inject_dlls: Vec::new(),
            cloud: CloudSettings::default(),
        }
    }
}

struct State { snapshot: Snapshot, loaded_once: bool }

static STATE: Mutex<State> = Mutex::new(State {
    snapshot: Snapshot {
        manifest_provider: String::new(),
        manifest_timeouts: ManifestTimeouts { resolve: 5000, connect: 5000, send: 10000, recv: 10000 },
        log_level: LogLevel::Debug,
        log_dir: String::new(),
        lua_paths: Vec::new(),
        remote_url_templates: Vec::new(),
        stats_enable_api: true,
        update_enabled: true,
        donate: DonateSettings { enabled: true, url: String::new(), interval_secs: 30,
                                  max_mints_per_cycle: 25, min_mint_interval_ms: 2000,
                                  max_mints_per_session: 0, wanted_refresh_secs: 300 },
        inject_dlls: Vec::new(),
        cloud: CloudSettings { enabled: false, library: String::new() },
    },
    loaded_once: false,
});

#[derive(Deserialize, Default)]
struct TomlManifest {
    url: Option<String>,
    timeout_resolve_ms: Option<i64>,
    timeout_connect_ms: Option<i64>,
    timeout_send_ms: Option<i64>,
    timeout_recv_ms: Option<i64>,
}
#[derive(Deserialize, Default)] struct TomlLog { level: Option<String> }
#[derive(Deserialize, Default)] struct TomlLua { paths: Option<Vec<String>> }
#[derive(Deserialize, Default)] struct TomlRemote { url_template: Option<StringOrVec> }
#[derive(Deserialize)]
#[serde(untagged)]
enum StringOrVec { Single(String), Multi(Vec<String>) }
#[derive(Deserialize, Default)] struct TomlStats { enable_api: Option<bool> }
#[derive(Deserialize, Default)] struct TomlUpdate { enabled: Option<bool> }
#[derive(Deserialize, Default)]
struct TomlDonate {
    enabled: Option<bool>, url: Option<String>,
    interval_secs: Option<i64>, max_mints_per_cycle: Option<i64>,
    min_mint_interval_ms: Option<i64>, max_mints_per_session: Option<i64>,
    wanted_refresh_secs: Option<i64>,
}
#[derive(Deserialize, Default)]
struct TomlInject {
    path: Option<String>, when_cmdline: Option<String>,
    all_games: Option<bool>, when_appids: Option<Vec<i64>>,
}
#[derive(Deserialize, Default)] struct TomlCloud { enabled: Option<bool>, library: Option<String> }

#[derive(Deserialize, Default)]
struct TomlConfig {
    #[serde(default)] manifest: TomlManifest,
    #[serde(default)] log: TomlLog,
    #[serde(default)] lua: TomlLua,
    #[serde(default)] remote: TomlRemote,
    #[serde(default)] stats: TomlStats,
    #[serde(default)] update: TomlUpdate,
    #[serde(default)] donate: TomlDonate,
    #[serde(default)] inject: Vec<TomlInject>,
    #[serde(default)] cloud: TomlCloud,
}

fn parse_log_level(s: &str) -> Option<LogLevel> {
    match s {
        "trace" => Some(LogLevel::Trace), "debug" => Some(LogLevel::Debug),
        "info"  => Some(LogLevel::Info),  "warn"  => Some(LogLevel::Warn),
        "error" => Some(LogLevel::Error), _ => None,
    }
}

fn clamp_i64(v: Option<i64>, lo: u32, hi: u32, cur: u32, key: &str) -> u32 {
    let Some(v) = v else { return cur };
    if v < lo as i64 || v > hi as i64 {
        LOG_WARN!("[donate] {} = {} out of range [{}, {}], keeping {}", key, v, lo, hi, cur);
        return cur;
    }
    v as u32
}

fn snapshot_from_toml(toml_cfg: &TomlConfig, config_path: &Path) -> Snapshot {
    let mut s = Snapshot::default();
    let parent = config_path.parent().unwrap_or_else(|| Path::new("."));
    s.log_dir = parent.join("rustytools").to_string_lossy().into_owned();

    if let Some(v) = &toml_cfg.manifest.url { s.manifest_provider = v.clone(); }
    if let Some(v) = toml_cfg.manifest.timeout_resolve_ms { s.manifest_timeouts.resolve = v as u32; }
    if let Some(v) = toml_cfg.manifest.timeout_connect_ms { s.manifest_timeouts.connect = v as u32; }
    if let Some(v) = toml_cfg.manifest.timeout_send_ms    { s.manifest_timeouts.send    = v as u32; }
    if let Some(v) = toml_cfg.manifest.timeout_recv_ms    { s.manifest_timeouts.recv    = v as u32; }

    if let Some(v) = &toml_cfg.log.level {
        if let Some(lvl) = parse_log_level(v) { s.log_level = lvl; }
    }
    if let Some(v) = &toml_cfg.lua.paths { s.lua_paths = v.clone(); }
    if let Some(rt) = &toml_cfg.remote.url_template {
        match rt {
            StringOrVec::Single(x) => s.remote_url_templates.push(x.clone()),
            StringOrVec::Multi(xs) => s.remote_url_templates.extend(xs.iter().cloned()),
        }
    }
    if let Some(v) = toml_cfg.stats.enable_api { s.stats_enable_api = v; }
    if let Some(v) = toml_cfg.update.enabled   { s.update_enabled   = v; }

    let d = &toml_cfg.donate;
    if let Some(v) = d.enabled { s.donate.enabled = v; }
    if let Some(v) = &d.url   { s.donate.url = v.clone(); }
    s.donate.interval_secs        = clamp_i64(d.interval_secs,        30,  86400, s.donate.interval_secs,        "interval_secs");
    s.donate.max_mints_per_cycle  = clamp_i64(d.max_mints_per_cycle,   1,    500, s.donate.max_mints_per_cycle,  "max_mints_per_cycle");
    s.donate.min_mint_interval_ms = clamp_i64(d.min_mint_interval_ms,  0,  60000, s.donate.min_mint_interval_ms, "min_mint_interval_ms");
    s.donate.max_mints_per_session= clamp_i64(d.max_mints_per_session, 0, 100000, s.donate.max_mints_per_session,"max_mints_per_session");
    s.donate.wanted_refresh_secs  = clamp_i64(d.wanted_refresh_secs,  30,  86400, s.donate.wanted_refresh_secs,  "wanted_refresh_secs");

    let steam_dir = config_path.parent().unwrap_or_else(|| Path::new("."));
    for entry in &toml_cfg.inject {
        let Some(p) = &entry.path else { continue };
        if p.is_empty() { continue; }
        let full = { let fp = Path::new(p); if fp.is_relative() { steam_dir.join(fp) } else { fp.to_path_buf() } };
        if !full.exists() { LOG_WARN!("inject dll not found: {}", full.display()); continue; }
        let mut when = std::collections::HashSet::new();
        if let Some(ids) = &entry.when_appids { for &id in ids { when.insert(id as u32); } }
        s.inject_dlls.push(InjectDll {
            path: full.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
            when_cmdline: entry.when_cmdline.clone().unwrap_or_default(),
            when_appids: when,
            all_games: entry.all_games.unwrap_or(false),
        });
    }
    if let Some(v) = toml_cfg.cloud.enabled { s.cloud.enabled = v; }
    if let Some(v) = &toml_cfg.cloud.library { s.cloud.library = v.clone(); }
    s
}

fn apply_snapshot(snapshot: &Snapshot) -> LoadResult {
    let mut g = STATE.lock().expect("config mutex poisoned");
    let lua_changed = g.snapshot.lua_paths != snapshot.lua_paths;
    g.snapshot = snapshot.clone();
    g.loaded_once = true;
    LoadResult { applied: true, lua_paths_changed: lua_changed }
}

fn apply_manifest_provider(name: &str) {
    if !bridge::manifest_set_provider(name) {
        LOG_WARN!("Unknown manifest.url \"{}\", keeping default", name);
        bridge::manifest_set_provider("opensteamtool");
    }
}

pub fn load(config_path: &str) -> LoadResult {
    let path = Path::new(config_path);
    let toml_cfg = if path.exists() {
        match std::fs::read_to_string(path) {
            Ok(text) => match toml::from_str::<TomlConfig>(&text) {
                Ok(t) => t,
                Err(e) => {
                    LOG_WARN!("Config parse error: {}", e);
                    let g = STATE.lock().expect("poisoned");
                    if !g.loaded_once {
                        drop(g);
                        let s = Snapshot::default();
                        apply_manifest_provider(&s.manifest_provider);
                        return apply_snapshot(&s);
                    }
                    return LoadResult::default();
                }
            },
            Err(e) => {
                LOG_WARN!("Config read error: {}", e);
                let g = STATE.lock().expect("poisoned");
                if !g.loaded_once {
                    drop(g);
                    let s = Snapshot::default();
                    apply_manifest_provider(&s.manifest_provider);
                    return apply_snapshot(&s);
                }
                return LoadResult::default();
            }
        }
    } else {
        LOG_INFO!("Config file not found, using defaults");
        let s = Snapshot::default();
        apply_manifest_provider(&s.manifest_provider);
        let r = apply_snapshot(&s);
        log_loaded();
        return r;
    };

    let snapshot = snapshot_from_toml(&toml_cfg, path);
    apply_manifest_provider(&snapshot.manifest_provider);
    let r = apply_snapshot(&snapshot);
    log_loaded();
    r
}

fn log_loaded() {
    let g = STATE.lock().expect("poisoned");
    LOG_INFO!(
        "Config loaded: manifest.url={} log.level={} lua.paths={} stats.enable_api={} remote.url_templates={}",
        bridge::manifest_active_provider_name(),
        g.snapshot.log_level.as_str(),
        g.snapshot.lua_paths.len(),
        g.snapshot.stats_enable_api,
        g.snapshot.remote_url_templates.len(),
    );
}

macro_rules! getter {
    ($name:ident, $ty:ty, $field:ident) => {
        pub fn $name() -> $ty { STATE.lock().expect("poisoned").snapshot.$field.clone() }
    };
}
getter!(get_lua_paths, Vec<String>, lua_paths);
getter!(get_remote_url_templates, Vec<String>, remote_url_templates);
getter!(get_log_dir, String, log_dir);
getter!(get_inject_dlls, Vec<InjectDll>, inject_dlls);

pub fn get_log_level() -> LogLevel { STATE.lock().expect("poisoned").snapshot.log_level }
pub fn get_stats_enable_api() -> bool { STATE.lock().expect("poisoned").snapshot.stats_enable_api }
pub fn get_update_enabled() -> bool { STATE.lock().expect("poisoned").snapshot.update_enabled }
pub fn get_manifest_timeouts() -> ManifestTimeouts { STATE.lock().expect("poisoned").snapshot.manifest_timeouts }
pub fn get_donate_settings() -> DonateSettings { STATE.lock().expect("poisoned").snapshot.donate.clone() }
pub fn get_cloud_settings() -> CloudSettings { STATE.lock().expect("poisoned").snapshot.cloud.clone() }

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test] fn parse_log_level_covers_all() {
        assert_eq!(parse_log_level("trace"), Some(LogLevel::Trace));
        assert_eq!(parse_log_level("error"), Some(LogLevel::Error));
        assert_eq!(parse_log_level("nope"), None);
    }
    #[test] fn default_snapshot_matches_cpp() {
        let s = Snapshot::default();
        assert_eq!(s.manifest_provider, "opensteamtool");
        assert_eq!(s.manifest_timeouts.resolve, 5000);
        assert_eq!(s.manifest_timeouts.recv,    10000);
        assert!(s.stats_enable_api);
        assert!(s.update_enabled);
        assert!(s.donate.enabled);
        assert_eq!(s.donate.interval_secs, 30);
    }
    #[test] fn toml_parses_known_shape() {
        let text = r#"
[manifest]
url = "steamrun"
timeout_recv_ms = 20000
[log]
level = "info"
[lua]
paths = ["C:\\a", "C:\\b"]
[donate]
interval_secs = 60
max_mints_per_cycle = 10
[cloud]
enabled = true
library = "cloud_redirect.dll"
"#;
        let t: TomlConfig = toml::from_str(text).unwrap();
        let s = snapshot_from_toml(&t, Path::new("C:\\steam\\opensteamtool.toml"));
        assert_eq!(s.manifest_provider, "steamrun");
        assert_eq!(s.manifest_timeouts.recv, 20000);
        assert_eq!(s.log_level, LogLevel::Info);
        assert_eq!(s.lua_paths.len(), 2);
        assert_eq!(s.donate.interval_secs, 60);
        assert_eq!(s.donate.max_mints_per_cycle, 10);
        assert!(s.cloud.enabled);
    }
    #[test] fn remote_url_template_accepts_both_shapes() {
        let single: TomlConfig = toml::from_str(r#"[remote]
url_template = "https://x/{sha256}""#).unwrap();
        let s = snapshot_from_toml(&single, Path::new("a.toml"));
        assert_eq!(s.remote_url_templates, vec!["https://x/{sha256}"]);
        let multi: TomlConfig = toml::from_str(r#"[remote]
url_template = ["https://a", "https://b"]"#).unwrap();
        let s = snapshot_from_toml(&multi, Path::new("a.toml"));
        assert_eq!(s.remote_url_templates, vec!["https://a", "https://b"]);
    }
}


===== FILE: src\utils\config\config_file_watcher.rs =====
//! `Utils/Config/ConfigFileWatcher.cpp`. Watches the TOML config file
//! and the Lua directory. Reloads the config on TOML change; rescans
//! the Lua directories on new/removed `.lua` files.
//!
//! One worker thread, one `DirectoryWatch::Watch` for the config's
//! parent directory and one for the Lua directory. The two are tagged
//! so a change event routes to the correct handler.

use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
use std::sync::Mutex;
use std::thread::JoinHandle;
use std::time::Duration;

use crate::platform::directory_watch::{self, WaitStatus, Watch};

const K_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS: u32 = 500;
const K_DEBOUNCE_MS: u64 = 200;
const K_WATCH_BUFFER_BYTES: u32 = 4096;

#[derive(Copy, Clone)]
enum Tag {
    Config,
    LuaDir,
}

static RUNNING: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
static SHUTDOWN: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
static HANDLE: Mutex<Option<JoinHandle<()>>> = Mutex::new(None);

pub fn start(config_path: &str, lua_dir: &str) {
    if RUNNING.swap(true, Ordering::SeqCst) {
        return;
    }
    SHUTDOWN.store(false, Ordering::SeqCst);

    let config_path = config_path.to_string();
    let lua_dir = lua_dir.to_string();
    let h = std::thread::Builder::new()
        .name("ost-cfg-watch".into())
        .spawn(move || worker(config_path, lua_dir))
        .ok();
    *HANDLE.lock().expect("config watcher handle poisoned") = h;
}

pub fn stop() {
    SHUTDOWN.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
    let h = HANDLE.lock().expect("config watcher handle poisoned").take();
    if let Some(h) = h {
        let _ = h.join();
    }
    RUNNING.store(false, Ordering::SeqCst);
}

fn worker(config_path: String, lua_dir: String) {
    let config_parent = PathBuf::from(&config_path)
        .parent()
        .map(|p| p.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
        .unwrap_or_default();
    let config_name = PathBuf::from(&config_path)
        .file_name()
        .map(|f| f.to_string_lossy().into_owned())
        .unwrap_or_default();

    let mut watches: Vec<Watch> = Vec::new();
    let mut tags: Vec<Tag> = Vec::new();

    if !config_parent.is_empty() {
        let mut w = Watch::new();
        if w.open(&config_parent, K_WATCH_BUFFER_BYTES) {
            let _ = w.issue_read();
            watches.push(w);
            tags.push(Tag::Config);
        } else {
            LOG_WARN!("ConfigFileWatcher: could not open watch on {}", config_parent);
        }
    }
    if !lua_dir.is_empty() {
        let mut w = Watch::new();
        if w.open(&lua_dir, K_WATCH_BUFFER_BYTES) {
            let _ = w.issue_read();
            watches.push(w);
            tags.push(Tag::LuaDir);
        } else {
            LOG_WARN!("ConfigFileWatcher: could not open watch on {}", lua_dir);
        }
    }
    if watches.is_empty() {
        LOG_WARN!("ConfigFileWatcher: no directories could be watched");
        return;
    }

    while !SHUTDOWN.load(Ordering::SeqCst) {
        let mut refs: Vec<&mut Watch> = watches.iter_mut().collect();
        let r = directory_watch::wait_any(&mut refs, K_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS);
        match r.status {
            WaitStatus::Signaled => {
                let mut reload_config = false;
                let mut reload_lua = false;
                for (i, w) in watches.iter_mut().enumerate() {
                    for c in w.drain() {
                        match tags[i] {
                            Tag::Config => {
                                if c.relative_path.eq_ignore_ascii_case(&config_name) {
                                    reload_config = true;
                                }
                            }
                            Tag::LuaDir => {
                                if c.relative_path.to_ascii_lowercase().ends_with(".lua") {
                                    reload_lua = true;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }

                // Debounce: a save often produces several events in a
                // few ms. Sleep, then discard whatever accumulated.
                std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(K_DEBOUNCE_MS));
                for w in watches.iter_mut() {
                    let _ = w.drain();
                }
                if SHUTDOWN.load(Ordering::SeqCst) { break; }

                if reload_config {
                    LOG_INFO!("ConfigFileWatcher: {} changed, reloading", config_path);
                    let result = crate::utils::config::config::load(&config_path);
                    crate::utils::logging::init_modules_public();
                    // A changed `[lua].paths` list means the Lua watch
                    // set has to be rebuilt from the new config.
                    if result.lua_paths_changed {
                        let new_dirs = crate::utils::config::lua_config::merge_watch_dirs(
                            &crate::utils::config::config::get_lua_paths(),
                            &lua_dir,
                        );
                        crate::utils::config::lua_config::reload_directories(&new_dirs, true);
                    }
                }
                if reload_lua {
                    LOG_INFO!("ConfigFileWatcher: lua dir changed, rescanning");
                    let dirs = crate::utils::config::lua_config::merge_watch_dirs(
                        &crate::utils::config::config::get_lua_paths(),
                        &lua_dir,
                    );
                    crate::utils::config::lua_config::reload_directories(&dirs, false);
                }

                for w in watches.iter_mut() {
                    let _ = w.issue_read();
                }
            }
            WaitStatus::Timeout => { /* loop */ }
            WaitStatus::Failed => {
                LOG_WARN!("ConfigFileWatcher: wait_any failed, stopping");
                break;
            }
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn stop_before_start_is_noop() {
        SHUTDOWN.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
        stop();
    }
}


===== FILE: src\utils\config\lua_config.rs =====
//! Lua configuration. Source: `Utils/Config/LuaConfig.cpp`, `LuaConfig.h`
//!
//! Uses `mlua` 0.9 (Lua 5.4 vendored). State is a global
//! `Mutex<Option<State>>`; every public query binds the result to a
//! local before returning, so the `MutexGuard` temporaries drop in the
//! right order.

use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};
use std::path::Path;
use std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};

use mlua::{Lua, Value};

use crate::bridge;

#[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug, Default)]
pub struct ManifestOverride { pub gid: u64, pub size: u64 }

#[derive(Default)]
struct Store {
    depot_key_set: HashMap<u32, String>,
    access_token_set: HashMap<u32, u64>,
    legacy_cd_key_set: HashMap<u32, String>,
    pinned_apps: HashSet<u32>,
    manifest_overrides: HashMap<u64, ManifestOverride>,
    stat_steam_id_set: HashMap<u32, u64>,
    owned_app_id_set: HashSet<u32>,
    process_name_app_id_map: HashMap<String, u32>,
    forced_denuvo_set: HashSet<u32>,
    eticket_url: String,
    current_file: String,
    file_depots: HashMap<String, HashSet<u32>>,
    file_manifest_overrides: HashMap<String, HashMap<u64, ManifestOverride>>,
    file_parse_sequence: HashMap<String, u64>,
    next_file_parse_sequence: u64,
    depot_ref_count: HashMap<u32, u32>,
    file_mtime: HashMap<String, u32>,
    purchase_time: HashMap<u32, u32>,
    pending_removals: Vec<u32>,
    pending_additions: Vec<u32>,
    has_manifest_code_func: bool,
    has_manifest_code_func_ex: bool,
}

struct State { lua: Lua, store: Arc<Mutex<Store>> }

static STATE: Mutex<Option<State>> = Mutex::new(None);

const DEFAULT_STAT_STEAM_ID: u64 = 76561198028121353;

fn parse_hex_byte(s: &str) -> u8 {
    crate::platform::numbers::parse_hex_u8(s).unwrap_or(0)
}

fn rebuild_manifest_override(store: &mut Store, depot_id: u64) {
    let mut best: Option<ManifestOverride> = None;
    let mut best_seq: u64 = 0;
    for (file, overrides) in &store.file_manifest_overrides {
        let Some(ov) = overrides.get(&depot_id) else { continue };
        let Some(&seq) = store.file_parse_sequence.get(file) else { continue };
        if best.is_none() || seq > best_seq { best = Some(*ov); best_seq = seq; }
    }
    match best {
        Some(ov) => { store.manifest_overrides.insert(depot_id, ov); }
        None     => { store.manifest_overrides.remove(&depot_id); }
    }
}

fn decode_hex(hex: &str) -> Vec<u8> {
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity((hex.len() + 1) / 2);
    let bytes = hex.as_bytes();
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < bytes.len() {
        let a = bytes[i] as char;
        let b = if i + 1 < bytes.len() { bytes[i + 1] as char } else { '0' };
        let s: String = [a, b].iter().collect();
        out.push(parse_hex_byte(&s));
        i += 2;
    }
    out
}

/// Serialise a Lua `{ key = value, ... }` table into the
/// `"Key: Value\r\n"` form that WinHTTP request headers take.
///
/// Matches the C++ `LuaHeadersToWstr`. Keys and values are
/// stringified with `to_string_lossy`; non-scalar entries (tables,
/// functions, userdata) are skipped, which mirrors `lua_tostring`
/// returning NULL for those types.
fn headers_table_to_string(tbl: mlua::Table<'_>) -> mlua::Result<String> {
    let mut out = String::new();
    for pair in tbl.pairs::<Value, Value>() {
        let (k, v) = pair?;
        let key = match k {
            Value::String(s) => s.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
            Value::Integer(i) => i.to_string(),
            Value::Number(n) => n.to_string(),
            Value::Boolean(b) => b.to_string(),
            _ => continue,
        };
        let val = match v {
            Value::String(s) => s.to_string_lossy().into_owned(),
            Value::Integer(i) => i.to_string(),
            Value::Number(n) => n.to_string(),
            Value::Boolean(b) => b.to_string(),
            _ => continue,
        };
        out.push_str(&key);
        out.push_str(": ");
        out.push_str(&val);
        out.push_str("\r\n");
    }
    Ok(out)
}

/// Shared body for the Lua `http_get` / `http_post` functions.
///
/// The C++ implementation routes through `OSTPlatform::Http::Execute`
/// (WinHTTP); this does the same through `platform::http::execute`.
/// Timeouts are the platform defaults, matching the C++ call sites
/// that omit the timeout arguments.
fn do_http<'lua>(
    lua: &'lua Lua,
    method: &str,
    url: &str,
    body: Option<&[u8]>,
    headers: Option<mlua::Table<'lua>>,
) -> mlua::Result<(Value<'lua>, Value<'lua>)> {
    let header_string = match headers {
        Some(tbl) => headers_table_to_string(tbl)?,
        None => String::new(),
    };

    let mut req = crate::platform::http::Request::new(method, url);
    req.body = body;
    if !header_string.is_empty() {
        req.headers = Some(header_string.as_str());
    }

    let resp = crate::platform::http::execute(&req);
    if resp.ok {
        let body_val = lua.create_string(&resp.body)?;
        Ok((Value::String(body_val), Value::Integer(resp.status as i64)))
    } else {
        let msg = lua.create_string(b"HTTP request failed")?;
        Ok((Value::Nil, Value::String(msg)))
    }
}

/// Install a metatable on `_G` whose `__index` lowercases the
/// requested name and re-tries the raw lookup. Matches the C++
/// `case_insensitive_global_index`: `setAppTicket`, `SETAPPTICKET`,
/// `SetAppticket`, and `setappticket` all resolve to the same
/// function.
///
/// The metamethod only fires on a *miss*, so the common case (a
/// lowercase name present in the globals table) is not affected.
/// The `raw_get` inside the metamethod bypasses the metatable,
/// avoiding recursion into the same metamethod.
fn install_case_insensitive_index(lua: &Lua) {
    let globals = lua.globals();
    let mt = match lua.create_table() {
        Ok(t) => t,
        Err(_) => return,
    };
    let index = match lua.create_function(|lua, (_tbl, key): (mlua::Table, Value)| {
        // Only string keys can be case-folded.
        let Value::String(s) = key else { return Ok(Value::Nil); };
        let name = s.to_string_lossy();
        let lower = name.to_ascii_lowercase();
        if lower == name.as_ref() {
            // The raw lookup in `_G` already failed for this exact
            // spelling; there is no lowercased variant to try.
            return Ok(Value::Nil);
        }
        // `raw_get` avoids recursing back into this metamethod.
        let globals = lua.globals();
        globals.raw_get::<_, Value>(lower)
    }) {
        Ok(f) => f,
        Err(_) => return,
    };
    if mt.set("__index", index).is_err() { return; }
    let _ = globals.set_metatable(Some(mt));
}

fn initialize() -> bool {
    let mut guard = STATE.lock().expect("poisoned");
    if guard.is_some() { return true; }
    let lua = Lua::new();
    let _ = lua.load_from_std_lib(mlua::StdLib::ALL_SAFE);
    let store = Arc::new(Mutex::new(Store::default()));
    register_all(&lua, &store);
    install_case_insensitive_index(&lua);
    *guard = Some(State { lua, store });
    true
}

fn register_all(lua: &Lua, store: &Arc<Mutex<Store>>) {
    // addappid(id, [flag], [key_hex])
    let s = store.clone();
    let f = lua.create_function(move |_, (id, a, b): (i64, Option<Value>, Option<Value>)| {
        let mut st = s.lock().unwrap();
        let depot_id = id as u32;
        let mut key = String::new();
        // Accept both (id, key) and (id, 0, key) shapes.
        let third_str = b.as_ref().and_then(|v| match v { Value::String(s) => s.to_str().ok().map(|c| c.to_owned()), _ => None });
        let second_str = a.as_ref().and_then(|v| match v { Value::String(s) => s.to_str().ok().map(|c| c.to_owned()), _ => None });
        if let Some(k) = third_str.or(second_str) { if k.len() == 64 { key = k; } }
        if !key.is_empty() || !st.depot_key_set.contains_key(&depot_id) {
            st.depot_key_set.insert(depot_id, key);
        }
        if !st.current_file.is_empty() {
            let cur = st.current_file.clone();
            let entry = st.file_depots.entry(cur).or_default();
            if entry.insert(depot_id) {
                let rc = st.depot_ref_count.entry(depot_id).or_insert(0);
                *rc += 1;
                if *rc == 1 { st.pending_additions.push(depot_id); }
                if let Some(&mt) = st.file_mtime.get(&st.current_file) {
                    let slot = st.purchase_time.entry(depot_id).or_insert(0);
                    if mt > *slot { *slot = mt; }
                }
            }
        }
        Ok(())
    }).unwrap();
    lua.globals().set("addappid", f).ok();

    let s = store.clone();
    let f = lua.create_function(move |_, (id, token): (i64, String)| {
        let mut st = s.lock().unwrap();
        if let Some(v) = crate::platform::numbers::parse_u64(&token) {
            st.access_token_set.insert(id as u32, v);
        }
        Ok(())
    }).unwrap();
    lua.globals().set("addtoken", f).ok();

    let s = store.clone();
    let f = lua.create_function(move |_, (id, key): (i64, String)| {
        let mut st = s.lock().unwrap();
        st.legacy_cd_key_set.insert(id as u32, key);
        Ok(())
    }).unwrap();
    lua.globals().set("setlegacycdkey", f).ok();

    let s = store.clone();
    let f = lua.create_function(move |_, (id, name): (i64, String)| {
        let mut st = s.lock().unwrap();
        if id <= 0 || id as u64 > u32::MAX as u64 {
            return Err(mlua::Error::RuntimeError("addprocess: appid out of range".into()));
        }
        st.process_name_app_id_map.insert(name.to_ascii_lowercase(), id as u32);
        Ok(())
    }).unwrap();
    lua.globals().set("addprocess", f).ok();

    let s = store.clone();
    let f = lua.create_function(move |_, id: i64| {
        let mut st = s.lock().unwrap();
        if id <= 0 || id as u64 > u32::MAX as u64 {
            return Err(mlua::Error::RuntimeError("forcedenuvo: appid out of range".into()));
        }
        st.forced_denuvo_set.insert(id as u32);
        Ok(())
    }).unwrap();
    lua.globals().set("forcedenuvo", f).ok();

    let s = store.clone();
    let f = lua.create_function(move |_, url: String| {
        let mut st = s.lock().unwrap();
        st.eticket_url = url;
        Ok(())
    }).unwrap();
    lua.globals().set("seteticketurl", f).ok();

    let s = store.clone();
    let f = lua.create_function(move |_, (id, gid_str): (i64, String)| {
        let mut st = s.lock().unwrap();
        let depot_id = id as u64;
        let Some(gid) = crate::platform::numbers::parse_u64(&gid_str) else {
            return Err(mlua::Error::RuntimeError("setManifestid: gid must be all digits".into()));
        };
        let ov = ManifestOverride { gid, size: 0 };
        if !st.current_file.is_empty() {
            let cur = st.current_file.clone();
            st.file_manifest_overrides.entry(cur).or_default().insert(depot_id, ov);
            rebuild_manifest_override(&mut st, depot_id);
        } else {
            st.manifest_overrides.insert(depot_id, ov);
        }
        Ok(())
    }).unwrap();
    lua.globals().set("setmanifestid", f).ok();

    let f = lua.create_function(move |_, (app_id, hex): (i64, String)| {
        let data = decode_hex(&hex);
        if !bridge::appticket_write_ownership_ticket(app_id as u32, &data) {
            return Err(mlua::Error::RuntimeError("setAppTicket: failed to write credential store".into()));
        }
        Ok(())
    }).unwrap();
    lua.globals().set("setappticket", f).ok();

    let f = lua.create_function(move |_, (app_id, hex): (i64, String)| {
        let data = decode_hex(&hex);
        if !bridge::appticket_write_encrypted_ticket(app_id as u32, &data) {
            return Err(mlua::Error::RuntimeError("setETicket: failed to write credential store".into()));
        }
        Ok(())
    }).unwrap();
    lua.globals().set("seteticket", f).ok();

    let s = store.clone();
    let f = lua.create_function(move |_, (app_id, steam_id): (i64, String)| {
        let mut st = s.lock().unwrap();
        let Some(v) = crate::platform::numbers::parse_u64(&steam_id) else {
            return Err(mlua::Error::RuntimeError("setStat: steamId must be all digits".into()));
        };
        st.stat_steam_id_set.insert(app_id as u32, v);
        Ok(())
    }).unwrap();
    lua.globals().set("setstat", f).ok();

    // http_get / http_post. Real WinHTTP calls through
    // `platform::http::execute`. The return shape matches the C++
    // documented contract:
    //   success -> (body_string, status_code)
    //   failure -> (nil, "HTTP request failed")
    let f = lua.create_function(|lua, (url, headers): (String, Option<mlua::Table>)| {
        do_http(lua, "GET", &url, None, headers)
    }).unwrap();
    lua.globals().set("http_get", f).ok();

    let f = lua.create_function(|lua, (url, body, headers): (String, String, Option<mlua::Table>)| {
        do_http(lua, "POST", &url, Some(body.as_bytes()), headers)
    }).unwrap();
    lua.globals().set("http_post", f).ok();
}

// ── Public API ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

pub fn has_depot(app_id: u32, exclude_owned: bool) -> bool {
    let guard = STATE.lock().unwrap();
    let Some(state) = guard.as_ref() else { return false };
    let store = state.store.lock().unwrap();
    store.depot_key_set.contains_key(&app_id)
        && (!exclude_owned || !store.owned_app_id_set.contains(&app_id))
}

pub fn is_owned(app_id: u32) -> bool {
    let guard = STATE.lock().unwrap();
    let Some(state) = guard.as_ref() else { return false };
    let store = state.store.lock().unwrap();
    store.owned_app_id_set.contains(&app_id)
}

pub fn mark_owned(app_id: u32) {
    let guard = STATE.lock().unwrap();
    let Some(state) = guard.as_ref() else { return };
    let mut store = state.store.lock().unwrap();
    if store.owned_app_id_set.insert(app_id) {
        LOG_PACKAGE_INFO!("Marking app {} as owned", app_id);
    }
}

pub fn get_all_depot_ids() -> Vec<u32> {
    let guard = STATE.lock().unwrap();
    let Some(state) = guard.as_ref() else { return Vec::new() };
    let store = state.store.lock().unwrap();
    store.depot_key_set.keys().copied().collect()
}

pub fn get_decryption_key(depot_id: u32) -> Vec<u8> {
    let guard = STATE.lock().unwrap();
    let Some(state) = guard.as_ref() else { return Vec::new() };
    let store = state.store.lock().unwrap();
    let Some(key_str) = store.depot_key_set.get(&depot_id) else { return Vec::new() };
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(key_str.len() / 2);
    let b = key_str.as_bytes();
    let mut i = 0;
    while i + 1 < b.len() {
        let s: String = [b[i] as char, b[i + 1] as char].iter().collect();
        out.push(parse_hex_byte(&s));
        i += 2;
    }
    out
}

pub fn get_access_token(app_id: u32) -> u64 {
    let guard = STATE.lock().unwrap();
    let Some(state) = guard.as_ref() else { return 0 };
    let store = state.store.lock().unwrap();
    *store.access_token_set.get(&app_id).unwrap_or(&0)
}

pub fn get_legacy_cd_key(app_id: u32) -> Option<String> {
    let guard = STATE.lock().unwrap();
    let Some(state) = guard.as_ref() else { return None };
    let store = state.store.lock().unwrap();
    store.legacy_cd_key_set.get(&app_id).cloned()
}

pub fn get_stat_steam_id(app_id: u32) -> u64 {
    let explicit: Option<u64> = {
        let guard = STATE.lock().unwrap();
        let s = guard.as_ref()
            .and_then(|s| s.store.lock().unwrap().stat_steam_id_set.get(&app_id).copied());
        s
    };
    if let Some(v) = explicit { return v; }
    if let Some(v) = bridge::stats_fetch_stat_steam_id(app_id) { return v; }
    DEFAULT_STAT_STEAM_ID
}

pub fn is_pinned(app_id: u32) -> bool {
    let guard = STATE.lock().unwrap();
    let Some(state) = guard.as_ref() else { return false };
    let store = state.store.lock().unwrap();
    store.pinned_apps.contains(&app_id)
}

pub fn get_purchase_time(app_id: u32) -> u32 {
    let guard = STATE.lock().unwrap();
    let Some(state) = guard.as_ref() else { return 0 };
    let store = state.store.lock().unwrap();
    *store.purchase_time.get(&app_id).unwrap_or(&0)
}

pub fn get_manifest_overrides() -> HashMap<u64, ManifestOverride> {
    let guard = STATE.lock().unwrap();
    let Some(state) = guard.as_ref() else { return HashMap::new() };
    let store = state.store.lock().unwrap();
    store.manifest_overrides.clone()
}

pub fn get_app_id_for_process(image_name: &str) -> u32 {
    let lower = image_name.to_ascii_lowercase();
    let guard = STATE.lock().unwrap();
    let Some(state) = guard.as_ref() else { return 0 };
    let store = state.store.lock().unwrap();
    *store.process_name_app_id_map.get(&lower).unwrap_or(&0)
}

pub fn is_forced_denuvo(app_id: u32) -> bool {
    let guard = STATE.lock().unwrap();
    let Some(state) = guard.as_ref() else { return false };
    let store = state.store.lock().unwrap();
    store.forced_denuvo_set.contains(&app_id)
}

pub fn get_eticket_url() -> String {
    let guard = STATE.lock().unwrap();
    let Some(state) = guard.as_ref() else { return String::new() };
    let store = state.store.lock().unwrap();
    store.eticket_url.clone()
}

pub fn take_pending_removals() -> Vec<u32> {
    let guard = STATE.lock().unwrap();
    let Some(state) = guard.as_ref() else { return Vec::new() };
    let v = std::mem::take(&mut state.store.lock().unwrap().pending_removals);
    v
}

pub fn take_pending_additions() -> Vec<u32> {
    let guard = STATE.lock().unwrap();
    let Some(state) = guard.as_ref() else { return Vec::new() };
    let v = std::mem::take(&mut state.store.lock().unwrap().pending_additions);
    v
}

pub fn has_manifest_code_func() -> bool {
    let guard = STATE.lock().unwrap();
    guard.as_ref().map(|s| s.store.lock().unwrap().has_manifest_code_func).unwrap_or(false)
}

pub fn has_manifest_code_func_ex() -> bool {
    let guard = STATE.lock().unwrap();
    guard.as_ref().map(|s| s.store.lock().unwrap().has_manifest_code_func_ex).unwrap_or(false)
}

pub fn parse_file(file_path: &str) {
    if !initialize() { return; }
    unload_file(file_path);

    let contents = match std::fs::read_to_string(file_path) {
        Ok(c) => c,
        Err(e) => { LOG_WARN!("ParseFile: failed to open {}: {}", file_path, e); return; }
    };
    let mtime = std::fs::metadata(file_path).and_then(|m| m.modified()).ok()
        .and_then(|t| t.duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH).ok())
        .map(|d| d.as_secs() as u32).unwrap_or(0);

    let guard = STATE.lock().unwrap();
    let Some(state) = guard.as_ref() else { return };

    {
        let mut st = state.store.lock().unwrap();
        st.current_file = file_path.to_string();
        st.next_file_parse_sequence += 1;
        let seq = st.next_file_parse_sequence;
        st.file_parse_sequence.insert(file_path.to_string(), seq);
        st.file_mtime.insert(file_path.to_string(), mtime);
    }

    if let Err(e) = state.lua.load(&contents).set_name(file_path).exec() {
        LOG_WARN!("{}: {}", file_path, e);
    }

    let mut st = state.store.lock().unwrap();
    let g = state.lua.globals();
    let f1: Result<Value, _> = g.get("fetch_manifest_code");
    st.has_manifest_code_func = matches!(f1, Ok(Value::Function(_)));
    let f2: Result<Value, _> = g.get("fetch_manifest_code_ex");
    st.has_manifest_code_func_ex = matches!(f2, Ok(Value::Function(_)));
    st.current_file.clear();
}

pub fn unload_file(file_path: &str) {
    let guard = STATE.lock().unwrap();
    let Some(state) = guard.as_ref() else { return };
    let mut st = state.store.lock().unwrap();
    let Some(depots) = st.file_depots.remove(file_path) else {
        if let Some(overrides) = st.file_manifest_overrides.remove(file_path) {
            let affected: Vec<u64> = overrides.keys().copied().collect();
            for id in affected { rebuild_manifest_override(&mut st, id); }
        }
        st.file_parse_sequence.remove(file_path);
        st.file_mtime.remove(file_path);
        return;
    };

    for id in depots {
        if let Some(rc) = st.depot_ref_count.get_mut(&id) {
            *rc -= 1;
            if *rc == 0 {
                st.depot_ref_count.remove(&id);
                st.depot_key_set.remove(&id);
                st.purchase_time.remove(&id);
                st.pending_removals.push(id);
            }
        }
    }
    if let Some(overrides) = st.file_manifest_overrides.remove(file_path) {
        let affected: Vec<u64> = overrides.keys().copied().collect();
        for id in affected { rebuild_manifest_override(&mut st, id); }
    }
    st.file_parse_sequence.remove(file_path);
    st.file_mtime.remove(file_path);
}

fn collect_lua_files(directory: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    let dir = Path::new(directory);
    let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(dir);
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    let entries = match std::fs::read_dir(dir) { Ok(e) => e, Err(_) => return out };
    for entry in entries.flatten() {
        let p = entry.path();
        if p.is_file() && p.extension().and_then(|s| s.to_str()) == Some("lua") {
            if let Some(s) = p.to_str() { out.push(s.to_string()); }
        }
    }
    out
}

pub fn parse_directory(directory: &str) {
    if !initialize() { return; }
    for path in collect_lua_files(directory) { parse_file(&path); }
    let guard = STATE.lock().unwrap();
    if let Some(state) = guard.as_ref() {
        state.store.lock().unwrap().pending_additions.clear();
    }
}

pub fn merge_watch_dirs(configured: &[String], default_dir: &str) -> Vec<String> {
    fn key(p: &str) -> String {
        let p = Path::new(p);
        let c = std::fs::canonicalize(p).unwrap_or_else(|_| p.to_path_buf());
        c.to_string_lossy().to_ascii_lowercase()
    }
    let mut out: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    let mut seen: HashSet<String> = HashSet::new();
    let add = |dir: &str, out: &mut Vec<String>, seen: &mut HashSet<String>| {
        if dir.is_empty() { return; }
        let k = key(dir);
        if seen.insert(k) { out.push(dir.to_string()); }
    };
    for d in configured { add(d, &mut out, &mut seen); }
    add(default_dir, &mut out, &mut seen);
    out
}

pub fn reload_directories(directories: &[String], clear_pending: bool) {
    if !initialize() { return; }
    let mut active: HashSet<String> = HashSet::new();
    let mut ordered: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    for d in directories {
        for path in collect_lua_files(d) {
            if active.insert(path.clone()) { ordered.push(path); }
        }
    }
    let tracked: Vec<String> = {
        let guard = STATE.lock().unwrap();
        let Some(state) = guard.as_ref() else { return };
        let st = state.store.lock().unwrap();
        let mut s: HashSet<String> = HashSet::new();
        for k in st.file_depots.keys() { s.insert(k.clone()); }
        for k in st.file_manifest_overrides.keys() { s.insert(k.clone()); }
        s.into_iter().collect()
    };
    for f in tracked { if !active.contains(&f) { unload_file(&f); } }
    for f in ordered { parse_file(&f); }
    if clear_pending {
        let guard = STATE.lock().unwrap();
        if let Some(state) = guard.as_ref() {
            state.store.lock().unwrap().pending_additions.clear();
        }
    }
}

// â”€â”€ Lua manifest-code callbacks â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€â”€
//
// Ported from `LuaConfig.cpp`'s `CallManifestFetchCode` and
// `CallManifestFetchCodeEx`. Each calls a user-defined Lua function and
// extracts a uint64 from the return value. Returns `None` on any of:
//   * the STATE has not been initialized (no Lua scripts loaded yet)
//   * the function is not defined
//   * the Lua call raised an error
//   * the function returned `nil`
//   * the return value was neither an integer nor a decimal string
//   * the decimal string did not parse as a u64
//
// The caller (`manifest_client`) uses `has_manifest_code_func*` to decide
// whether to try these at all, so the common path is skipped before it
// reaches here. That check and this call are intentionally separate: a
// script can define the function on some parses and not others, and the
// registry would still report the last observed state.

fn extract_u64(result: mlua::Result<Value>) -> Option<u64> {
    let v = result.ok()?;
    match v {
        Value::Integer(i) if i >= 0 => Some(i as u64),
        Value::String(s) => {
            let decoded = s.to_str().ok()?;
            crate::platform::numbers::parse_u64(&decoded)
        }
        _ => None,
    }
}

pub fn call_manifest_fetch_code(gid: u64) -> Option<u64> {
    let guard = STATE.lock().unwrap();
    let state = guard.as_ref()?;
    let globals = state.lua.globals();
    let f: mlua::Function = match globals.get("fetch_manifest_code") {
        Ok(f) => f,
        Err(_) => return None,
    };
    let result = f.call::<_, Value>(gid);
    extract_u64(Ok(result.unwrap_or(Value::Nil)))
}

pub fn call_manifest_fetch_code_ex(app_id: u64, depot_id: u64, gid: u64) -> Option<u64> {
    let guard = STATE.lock().unwrap();
    let state = guard.as_ref()?;
    let globals = state.lua.globals();
    let f: mlua::Function = match globals.get("fetch_manifest_code_ex") {
        Ok(f) => f,
        Err(_) => return None,
    };
    let result = f.call::<_, Value>((app_id, depot_id, gid));
    extract_u64(Ok(result.unwrap_or(Value::Nil)))
}

        // Uses a fresh Lua state so the process-global STATE is
        // not involved; this is a pure formatting test.
        let lua = Lua::new();
        let t = lua.create_table().unwrap();
        t.set("Accept", "application/json").unwrap();
        t.set("X-Custom", "value").unwrap();
        let s = headers_table_to_string(t).unwrap();
        // Lua table iteration order is undefined; check both lines.
        assert!(s.contains("Accept: application/json\r\n"), "missing Accept: {s:?}");
        assert!(s.contains("X-Custom: value\r\n"), "missing X-Custom: {s:?}");
        assert!(s.ends_with("\r\n"), "must end with CRLF: {s:?}");
    }

    #[test]
    fn case_insensitive_lookup_reaches_registered_functions() {
        assert!(initialize());
        let guard = STATE.lock().unwrap();
        let state = guard.as_ref().expect("initialized above");
        let g = state.lua.globals();
        // Exact-case: raw hit, no metamethod fires.
        let exact: mlua::Result<Value> = g.get("addappid");
        assert!(matches!(exact, Ok(Value::Function(_))), "lowercase missing");
        // Mixed-case: raw miss, __index lowercases, raw_get finds it.
        for name in &["AddAppid", "ADDAPPID", "aDdApPiD", "addAppId"] {
            let v: mlua::Result<Value> = g.get(*name);
            assert!(
                matches!(v, Ok(Value::Function(_))),
                "case-insensitive lookup failed for {name}"
            );
        }
        // A genuinely unknown name still returns nil.
        let missing: mlua::Result<Value> = g.get("definitely_not_a_registered_function");
        assert!(matches!(missing, Ok(Value::Nil)));
    }

    #[test]
    fn http_get_invalid_url_returns_nil_and_error() {
        assert!(initialize());
        let guard = STATE.lock().unwrap();
        let state = guard.as_ref().expect("initialized above");
        let g = state.lua.globals();
        let get: mlua::Function = g.get("http_get").expect("http_get registered");
        // An invalid URL fails at WinHTTP parse time, so this
        // returns immediately without touching the network.
        let (body, status): (Value, Value) = get
            .call(("not-a-url", Value::Nil))
            .expect("http_get callable with 2 args");
        assert!(matches!(body, Value::Nil));
        assert!(matches!(status, Value::String(_)));
    }

===== FILE: src\utils\config\lua_file_watcher.rs =====
//! `Utils/Config/LuaFileWatcher.cpp`. Watches the merged Lua
//! directories and reloads the Lua config on any change.
//!
//! One worker thread, one `DirectoryWatch::Watch` per directory. On
//! any change the worker drains, debounces briefly (so a burst of
//! file-save events coalesces into one reload), drains again, and
//! calls `lua_config::reload_directories`.

use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, Ordering};
use std::sync::Mutex;
use std::thread::JoinHandle;
use std::time::Duration;

use crate::platform::directory_watch::{self, WaitStatus, Watch};

const K_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS: u32 = 500;
const K_DEBOUNCE_MS: u64 = 200;
const K_WATCH_BUFFER_BYTES: u32 = 4096;

static RUNNING: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
static SHUTDOWN: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
static HANDLE: Mutex<Option<JoinHandle<()>>> = Mutex::new(None);

pub fn start(dirs: Vec<String>) {
    if RUNNING.swap(true, Ordering::SeqCst) {
        return;
    }
    SHUTDOWN.store(false, Ordering::SeqCst);

    let h = std::thread::Builder::new()
        .name("ost-lua-watch".into())
        .spawn(move || worker(dirs))
        .ok();
    *HANDLE.lock().expect("lua watcher handle poisoned") = h;
}

pub fn stop() {
    SHUTDOWN.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
    let h = HANDLE.lock().expect("lua watcher handle poisoned").take();
    if let Some(h) = h {
        let _ = h.join();
    }
    RUNNING.store(false, Ordering::SeqCst);
}

fn worker(dirs: Vec<String>) {
    let mut watches: Vec<Watch> = Vec::new();
    for d in &dirs {
        let mut w = Watch::new();
        if w.open(d, K_WATCH_BUFFER_BYTES) {
            let _ = w.issue_read();
            watches.push(w);
        } else {
            LOG_WARN!("LuaFileWatcher: could not open watch on {}", d);
        }
    }
    if watches.is_empty() {
        LOG_WARN!("LuaFileWatcher: no directories could be watched");
        return;
    }

    while !SHUTDOWN.load(Ordering::SeqCst) {
        let mut refs: Vec<&mut Watch> = watches.iter_mut().collect();
        let r = directory_watch::wait_any(&mut refs, K_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS);
        match r.status {
            WaitStatus::Signaled => {
                // Drain every watch, then debounce, then drain again
                // to catch files that landed during the sleep.
                for w in watches.iter_mut() {
                    let _ = w.drain();
                }
                std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(K_DEBOUNCE_MS));
                for w in watches.iter_mut() {
                    let _ = w.drain();
                }

                if SHUTDOWN.load(Ordering::SeqCst) { break; }
                LOG_INFO!("LuaFileWatcher: change detected, reloading directories");
                crate::utils::config::lua_config::reload_directories(&dirs, true);

                for w in watches.iter_mut() {
                    let _ = w.issue_read();
                }
            }
            WaitStatus::Timeout => { /* loop */ }
            WaitStatus::Failed => {
                LOG_WARN!("LuaFileWatcher: wait_any failed, stopping");
                break;
            }
        }
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]

    use super::*;

    #[test]

        // SHUTDOWN store + HANDLE.take on an empty handle is safe.
        SHUTDOWN.store(true, Ordering::SeqCst);
        stop();
    }
}

===== FILE: src\utils\logging\level.rs =====
#[repr(u8)]
#[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq, PartialOrd, Ord)]
pub enum Level {
    Trace = 0,
    Debug = 1,
    Info  = 2,
    Warn  = 3,
    Error = 4,
}

impl Level {
    pub const fn as_str(self) -> &'static str {
        match self {
            Level::Trace => "trace",
            Level::Debug => "debug",
            Level::Info  => "info",
            Level::Warn  => "warn",
            Level::Error => "error",
        }
    }

    pub const fn from_u8(v: u8) -> Level {
        match v {
            0 => Level::Trace,
            1 => Level::Debug,
            2 => Level::Info,
            3 => Level::Warn,
            _ => Level::Error,
        }
    }
}


===== FILE: src\utils\logging\logger.rs =====
use std::fs::{File, OpenOptions};
use std::io::Write;
use std::path::Path;
use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicU8, Ordering};

use parking_lot::Mutex;

use super::level::Level;
use super::state::Source;

pub struct Logger {
    file: Mutex<File>,
    level: AtomicU8,
}

impl Logger {
    pub fn open(path: &Path, level: Level) -> std::io::Result<Self> {
        let file = OpenOptions::new()
            .create(true)
            .write(true)
            .truncate(true)
            .open(path)?;
        Ok(Self {
            file: Mutex::new(file),
            level: AtomicU8::new(level as u8),
        })
    }

    pub fn set_level(&self, level: Level) {
        self.level.store(level as u8, Ordering::Relaxed);
    }

    pub fn is_enabled(&self, level: Level) -> bool {
        (level as u8) >= self.level.load(Ordering::Relaxed)
    }

    pub fn log(&self, level: Level, msg: std::fmt::Arguments<'_>, src: &Source) {
        if !self.is_enabled(level) {
            return;
        }
        let now = chrono::Local::now();
        let tid = {
            use std::hash::{Hash, Hasher};
            let id = std::thread::current().id();
            let mut h = std::collections::hash_map::DefaultHasher::new();
            id.hash(&mut h);
            h.finish() as u32
        };
        let mut file = self.file.lock();
        let _ = writeln!(
            file,
            "[{}] [{}] [tid={}] [{}:{}] {}",
            now.format("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S%.3f"),
            level.as_str(),
            tid,
            src.file,
            src.line,
            msg,
        );
        let _ = file.flush();
    }
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;
    use std::io::Read;

    #[test]
    fn logger_writes_and_respects_level() {
        let dir = std::env::temp_dir().join("ost_logger_test");
        let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir);
        let path = dir.join("test.log");
        let l = Logger::open(&path, Level::Info).unwrap();
        l.log(Level::Debug, format_args!("hidden"), &Source { file: "f", line: 1, function: "" });
        l.log(Level::Info,  format_args!("visible"), &Source { file: "f", line: 2, function: "" });
        drop(l);
        let mut s = String::new();
        std::fs::File::open(&path).unwrap().read_to_string(&mut s).unwrap();
        assert!(!s.contains("hidden"));
        assert!(s.contains("visible"));
        assert!(s.contains("f:2"));
        let _ = std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);
    }

pub enum LogModule {

        LogModule::Manifest,

        LogModule::Pipe,

===== FILE: src\utils\logging\state.rs =====
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::{Arc, OnceLock};

use parking_lot::RwLock;

use crate::platform::dynamic_library::{self, ModuleHandle};
use super::level::Level;
use super::logger::Logger;
use super::module::LogModule;

#[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Source {
    pub file: &'static str,
    pub line: u32,
    pub function: &'static str,
}

struct State {
    loggers: Vec<Logger>,
    #[allow(dead_code)]
    log_dir: PathBuf,
}

static STATE: OnceLock<State> = OnceLock::new();
static LEVEL: RwLock<Level> = RwLock::new(Level::Trace);

pub fn init_main(self_module: ModuleHandle) {
    let dir = {
        let d = dynamic_library::get_module_directory(self_module);
        if d.as_os_str().is_empty() {
            std::env::current_dir().unwrap_or_else(|_| PathBuf::from("."))
        } else { d }
    };
    let log_dir = dir.join("rustytools");
    let _ = std::fs::create_dir_all(&log_dir);

    let mut loggers = Vec::with_capacity(LogModule::COUNT);
    for module in LogModule::ALL {
        let path = log_dir.join(format!("{}.log", module.file_name()));
        let l = match Logger::open(&path, Level::Trace) {
            Ok(l) => l,
            Err(_) => {
                // Fall back to a temp path so init doesn't fail.
                let tmp = std::env::temp_dir().join(format!("ost-{}.log", module.file_name()));
                Logger::open(&tmp, Level::Trace).expect("cannot open log")
            }
        };
        loggers.push(l);
    }

    let _ = STATE.set(State { loggers, log_dir });
}

/// Called from `Config::load` consumers after config is available.
pub fn init_modules() {
    let state = match STATE.get() { Some(s) => s, None => return };
    let lvl = *LEVEL.read();
    for l in &state.loggers { l.set_level(lvl); }
}

pub fn apply_config_level() { init_modules(); }

/// Update the level used by `init_modules` / `apply_config_level`.
pub fn set_level(lvl: Level) { *LEVEL.write() = lvl; }

pub fn current_level() -> Level { *LEVEL.read() }

pub fn install_platform_log_sink() {
    crate::platform::logging::set_sink(Arc::new(|level, src, msg| {
        let our = match level {
            crate::platform::logging::Level::Trace => Level::Trace,
            crate::platform::logging::Level::Debug => Level::Debug,
            crate::platform::logging::Level::Info  => Level::Info,
            crate::platform::logging::Level::Warn  => Level::Warn,
            crate::platform::logging::Level::Error => Level::Error,
        };
        log_at(
            LogModule::Platform,
            our,
            format_args!("{}", msg),
            Source { file: src.file, line: src.line, function: src.function },
        );
    }));
}

pub fn log_at(module: LogModule, level: Level, args: std::fmt::Arguments<'_>, src: Source) {
    if let Some(state) = STATE.get() {
        if let Some(logger) = state.loggers.get(module.as_index()) {
            logger.log(level, args, &src);
        }
    }
}

//! IPC method metadata loader. Source: `IPCLoader.cpp`.

use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};
use std::sync::Mutex;

use crate::platform::numbers;
use super::remote_toml::{self, Request as RtRequest};
use super::steam_diagnostics;

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Method {
    pub interface_id: u8,
    pub name: String,
    pub func_hash: u32,
    pub fencepost: u32,
    pub argc: u32,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct Interface {
    pub id: u8,
    pub name: String,
    pub vtable_rva: u32,
    pub methods: Vec<Method>,
}

struct Registry {
    interfaces: Vec<Interface>,
    by_id: HashMap<u8, usize>,
    by_name: HashMap<String, usize>,
}

impl Registry {
    fn new() -> Self {
        Self { interfaces: Vec::new(), by_id: HashMap::new(), by_name: HashMap::new() }
    }
    fn add(&mut self, iface: Interface) {
        let idx = self.interfaces.len();
        self.by_id.insert(iface.id, idx);
        self.by_name.insert(iface.name.clone(), idx);
        self.interfaces.push(iface);
    }
    fn find_by_hash(&self, id: u8, func_hash: u32) -> Option<&Method> {
        let idx = *self.by_id.get(&id)?;
        self.interfaces[idx].methods.iter().find(|m| m.func_hash == func_hash)
    }
    fn find_by_name(&self, iface: &str, method: &str) -> Option<&Method> {
        let idx = *self.by_name.get(iface)?;
        self.interfaces[idx].methods.iter().find(|m| m.name == method)
    }
    fn method_count(&self) -> usize {
        self.interfaces.iter().map(|i| i.methods.len()).sum()
    }
}

static REGISTRY: Mutex<Option<Registry>> = Mutex::new(None);

fn with_registry<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut Registry) -> R) -> R {
    let mut g = REGISTRY.lock().expect("poisoned");
    if g.is_none() { *g = Some(Registry::new()); }
    f(g.as_mut().unwrap())
}

/// Maps EIPCInterface name → numeric ID. Port of `EIPCInterfaceFromName`.

        "IClientGameStats" => 21,
        "IClientHTTP" => 22,
        "IClientScreenshots" => 23,

fn parse_interface(name: &str, tbl: &toml::value::Table, out: &mut Interface) -> bool {
    out.name = name.to_string();
    let Some(expected) = eipc_from_name(name) else {
        LOG_WARN!("IPCLoader: [{}] is not declared in EIPCInterface", name);
        return false;
    };
    out.id = expected;

    if let Some(v) = tbl.get("interface_id").and_then(|v| v.as_integer()) {
        if v < 0 || v > 0xFF {
            LOG_WARN!("IPCLoader: [{}] interface_id out of range ({})", name, v);
            return false;
        }
        if v as u8 != out.id {
            LOG_WARN!("IPCLoader: [{}] interface_id {} disagrees with generated value {}",
                      name, v, out.id);
            return false;
        }
    }

    if let Some(v) = tbl.get("vtable_rva").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
        if let Some(rva) = numbers::parse_hex_u32(v) { out.vtable_rva = rva; }
    }

    for (k, val) in tbl {
        let Some(mtbl) = val.as_table() else { continue };
        let Some(hash_str) = mtbl.get("funcHash").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) else {
            LOG_WARN!("IPCLoader: [{}.{}] missing funcHash", name, k);
            continue;
        };
        let Some(func_hash) = numbers::parse_hex_u32(hash_str) else {
            LOG_WARN!("IPCLoader: [{}.{}] bad funcHash '{}'", name, k, hash_str);
            continue;
        };
        let mut m = Method {
            interface_id: out.id,
            name: k.clone(),
            func_hash,
            fencepost: 0,
            argc: 0,
        };
        if let Some(v) = mtbl.get("fencepost").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
            if let Some(f) = numbers::parse_hex_u32(v) { m.fencepost = f; }
        }
        if let Some(v) = mtbl.get("argc").and_then(|v| v.as_integer()) {
            m.argc = v as u32;
        }
        out.methods.push(m);
    }
    true
}

fn show_missing_popup(sha: &str) {
    steam_diagnostics::show_warning(
        "rusty_tools - IPC spec missing".to_string(),
        format!(
            "rusty_tools: IPC spec file not found.\n\nIPC interception is disabled for this session; pattern-based hooks are unaffected.\n\nYou can:\n  1. Wait for the next upstream publish and restart Steam.\n  2. Drop a matching TOML at:\n       <Steam>\\rustytools\\ipc\\steamclient\\{}.toml\n  3. Check upstream:\n       https://github.com/madoiscool/steam-monitor/tree/ipc/steamclient",
            sha
        ),
    );
}

pub const IPC_CHANNEL: &str = "ipc";

pub fn load(steamclient_path: &str) -> bool {
    with_registry(|r| { r.interfaces.clear(); r.by_id.clear(); r.by_name.clear(); });

    let r = remote_toml::fetch(&RtRequest {
        channel: IPC_CHANNEL.into(),
        component: "steamclient".into(),
        dll_path: steamclient_path.into(),
    });

    if !r.ok {
        let sha = if r.sha256.is_empty() { "(hash failed)" } else { &r.sha256 };
        show_missing_popup(sha);
        return false;
    }

    let parsed: toml::Value = match toml::from_str(&r.body) {
        Ok(v) => v,
        Err(e) => {
            LOG_WARN!("IPCLoader: TOML parse error: {}", e);
            show_missing_popup(&r.sha256);
            return false;
        }
    };
    let Some(root) = parsed.as_table() else {
        show_missing_popup(&r.sha256);
        return false;
    };

    let mut added = 0;
    for (k, v) in root {
        let Some(tbl) = v.as_table() else { continue };
        let mut iface = Interface { id: 0, name: String::new(), vtable_rva: 0, methods: Vec::new() };
        if !parse_interface(k, tbl, &mut iface) { continue; }
        with_registry(|r| r.add(iface));
        added += 1;
    }

    let (mc, ic) = with_registry(|r| (r.method_count(), r.interfaces.len()));
    LOG_INFO!("IPCLoader: loaded {} methods across {} interfaces ({})",
              mc, ic, if added > 0 && !r.from_cache { "remote" } else { "cache fallback" });
    true
}

pub fn find_by_hash(interface_id: u8, func_hash: u32) -> Option<Method> {
    with_registry(|r| r.find_by_hash(interface_id, func_hash).cloned())
}

pub fn find_by_name(iface: &str, method: &str) -> Option<Method> {
    with_registry(|r| r.find_by_name(iface, method).cloned())
}

pub fn interface_count() -> usize { with_registry(|r| r.interfaces.len()) }
pub fn method_count() -> usize { with_registry(|r| r.method_count()) }

//! Manifest archive cache. Source: `ManifestCache.cpp`.
//!
//! Reads and writes to `<steam>/depotcache/<depot>_<gid>.manifest`.
//! Negative-cache TTL for 404s; atomic write via rename.

use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};
use std::path::PathBuf;
use std::sync::Mutex;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use crate::platform::{dynamic_library, http};
use crate::utils::config::config;

const ARCHIVE_BASE_URL: &str = "https://manifest.luastools.xyz";
const MAX_BODY_BYTES: u32 = 64 * 1024 * 1024;
const RECV_TIMEOUT_MS: u32 = 60000;
const NEGATIVE_TTL: Duration = Duration::from_secs(600);
const MIN_BODY_BYTES: usize = 16;
const PAYLOAD_MAGIC: [u8; 4] = [0xD0, 0x17, 0xF6, 0x71];
const EOF_MAGIC: [u8; 4] = [0xAB, 0x15, 0xC4, 0x32];

struct NegativeCache {
    map: HashMap<String, Instant>,
    in_flight: HashSet<String>,
}

static CACHE: Mutex<Option<NegativeCache>> = Mutex::new(None);

fn with_cache<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut NegativeCache) -> R) -> R {
    let mut g = CACHE.lock().expect("poisoned");
    if g.is_none() {
        *g = Some(NegativeCache { map: HashMap::new(), in_flight: HashSet::new() });
    }
    f(g.as_mut().unwrap())
}

struct InFlightGuard { key: String, acquired: bool }
impl InFlightGuard {
    fn new(key: String) -> Self {
        let acquired = with_cache(|c| c.in_flight.insert(key.clone()));
        Self { key, acquired }
    }
}
impl Drop for InFlightGuard {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        if !self.acquired { return; }
        with_cache(|c| { c.in_flight.remove(&self.key); });
    }
}

fn depot_cache_dir() -> Option<PathBuf> {
    let exe = dynamic_library::get_main_executable_path();
    if exe.as_os_str().is_empty() { return None; }
    Some(exe.parent()?.join("depotcache"))
}

fn looks_like_manifest(body: &[u8]) -> bool {
    if body.len() < MIN_BODY_BYTES { return false; }
    if &body[..4] != PAYLOAD_MAGIC { return false; }
    if &body[body.len() - 4..] != EOF_MAGIC { return false; }
    true
}

fn write_atomic(dest: &std::path::Path, body: &[u8]) -> bool {
    if let Some(parent) = dest.parent() {
        if let Err(e) = std::fs::create_dir_all(parent) {
            LOG_MANIFEST_WARN!("ManifestCache: cannot create {}: {}", parent.display(), e);
            return false;
        }
    }
    let tmp = dest.with_extension(format!("{}.tmp", std::process::id()));
    if let Err(e) = std::fs::write(&tmp, body) {
        LOG_MANIFEST_WARN!("ManifestCache: write failed for {}: {}", tmp.display(), e);
        return false;
    }
    match std::fs::rename(&tmp, dest) {
        Ok(_) => true,
        Err(e) => {
            LOG_MANIFEST_WARN!("ManifestCache: rename {} -> {} failed: {}",
                               tmp.display(), dest.display(), e);
            let _ = std::fs::remove_file(&tmp);
            false
        }
    }
}

/// Ensure `<steam>/depotcache/<depot>_<gid>.manifest` exists, fetching from
/// the archive if not. Returns true when the file is present afterwards.
pub fn ensure_cached(
    app: u32,
    depot: u32,
    gid: u64,
    recv_timeout_ms: u32,
    bypass_negative_cache: bool,
) -> bool {
    ensure_cached_ex(app, depot, gid, recv_timeout_ms, bypass_negative_cache).0
}

/// Extended version that also reports "definitively not archived" (404).
pub fn ensure_cached_ex(
    _app: u32,
    depot: u32,
    gid: u64,
    recv_timeout_ms: u32,
    bypass_negative_cache: bool,
) -> (bool, bool) {
    if depot == 0 || gid == 0 { return (false, false); }

    let Some(dir) = depot_cache_dir() else {
        LOG_MANIFEST_WARN!("ManifestCache: could not resolve depotcache dir");
        return (false, false);
    };
    let dest = dir.join(format!("{}_{}.manifest", depot, gid));
    if dest.exists() { return (true, false); }

    let key = format!("{}_{}", depot, gid);

    if !bypass_negative_cache {
        let cached_at = with_cache(|c| c.map.get(&key).copied());
        if let Some(t) = cached_at {
            if t.elapsed() < NEGATIVE_TTL { return (false, false); }
            with_cache(|c| { c.map.remove(&key); });
        }
    }

    let guard = InFlightGuard::new(key.clone());
    if !guard.acquired { return (false, false); }

    if dest.exists() { return (true, false); }

    let url = format!("{}/m/{}/{}", ARCHIVE_BASE_URL, depot, gid);
    let to = config::get_manifest_timeouts();
    let mut req = http::Request::new("GET", &url);
    req.timeout_resolve_ms = to.resolve;
    req.timeout_connect_ms = to.connect;
    req.timeout_send_ms = to.send;
    req.timeout_recv_ms = if recv_timeout_ms != 0 { recv_timeout_ms } else { RECV_TIMEOUT_MS };
    req.max_body_bytes = MAX_BODY_BYTES;

    let resp = http::execute(&req);

    if !resp.ok || resp.status != 200 {
        let not_archived = resp.ok && resp.status == 404;
        if not_archived {
            with_cache(|c| { c.map.insert(key, Instant::now()); });
        }
        LOG_MANIFEST_TRACE!("ManifestCache: miss depot={} gid={} status={}", depot, gid, resp.status);
        return (false, not_archived);
    }

    if !looks_like_manifest(&resp.body) {
        LOG_MANIFEST_WARN!("ManifestCache: rejected body for depot={} gid={} ({} bytes)",
                           depot, gid, resp.body.len());
        return (false, false);
    }

    if !write_atomic(&dest, &resp.body) { return (false, false); }

    LOG_MANIFEST_INFO!("ManifestCache: cached depot={} gid={} ({} bytes) -> {}",
                       depot, gid, resp.body.len(), dest.display());
    (true, false)
}

        body[0] = 0;
        assert!(!looks_like_manifest(&body));

===== FILE: src\utils\steam_metadata\manifest_client.rs =====
//! Manifest request-code client. Source: `ManifestClient.cpp`.

use std::sync::Mutex;

use crate::platform::http;
use crate::utils::config::{config, lua_config};

struct Provider {
    name: &'static str,
    url_template: &'static str,
    url_template_ex: Option<&'static str>,
    parse: fn(&[u8]) -> Option<u64>,
}

const PROVIDERS: &[Provider] = &[
    Provider {
        name: "opensteamtool",
        url_template: "https://manifest.opensteamtool.com/%llu",
        url_template_ex: Some("https://manifest.opensteamtool.com/%u/%u/%llu"),
        parse: parse_plain_uint,
    },
    Provider {
        name: "wudrm",
        url_template: "http://gmrc.wudrm.com/manifest/%llu",
        url_template_ex: None,
        parse: parse_plain_uint,
    },
    Provider {
        name: "steamrun",
        url_template: "https://manifest.steam.run/api/manifest/%llu",
        url_template_ex: None,
        parse: parse_steam_run_json,
    },
];

static ACTIVE_INDEX: Mutex<usize> = Mutex::new(0);

fn parse_plain_uint(body: &[u8]) -> Option<u64> {
    std::str::from_utf8(body).ok().and_then(|s| s.parse::<u64>().ok())
}

fn parse_steam_run_json(body: &[u8]) -> Option<u64> {
    let s = std::str::from_utf8(body).ok()?;
    let key = s.find("\"content\"")?;
    let q1 = s[key + 9..].find('"')? + key + 9;
    let q2 = s[q1 + 1..].find('"')? + q1 + 1;
    parse_plain_uint(s[q1 + 1..q2].as_bytes())
}

/// Builds a URL from a `%llu`/`%u` template. Order of `%u` in `template_ex`
/// matches the C++ snprintf: app_id, depot_id, gid.
fn format_url(template: &str, app_id: u32, depot_id: u32, gid: u64) -> String {
    let mut out = template.to_string();
    if out.contains("%u/%u/%llu") {
        out = out.replacen("%u", &app_id.to_string(), 1);
        out = out.replacen("%u", &depot_id.to_string(), 1);
        out = out.replacen("%llu", &gid.to_string(), 1);
    } else {
        out = out.replacen("%llu", &gid.to_string(), 1);
    }
    out
}

pub fn set_provider(name: &str) -> bool {
    for (i, p) in PROVIDERS.iter().enumerate() {
        if p.name == name {
            *ACTIVE_INDEX.lock().expect("poisoned") = i;
            return true;
        }
    }
    false
}

pub fn active_provider_name() -> &'static str {
    PROVIDERS[*ACTIVE_INDEX.lock().expect("poisoned")].name
}

pub fn shutdown() {}

fn fetch_active(gid: u64, app_id: u32, depot_id: u32) -> Option<u64> {
    let idx = *ACTIVE_INDEX.lock().expect("poisoned");
    let p = &PROVIDERS[idx];
    let to = config::get_manifest_timeouts();

    let (url, shape) = match p.url_template_ex {
        Some(ex) if depot_id != 0 => (format_url(ex, app_id, depot_id, gid), "app/depot/gid"),
        _ => (format_url(p.url_template, app_id, depot_id, gid), "gid-only"),
    };

    let mut req = http::Request::new("GET", &url);
    req.timeout_resolve_ms = to.resolve;
    req.timeout_connect_ms = to.connect;
    req.timeout_send_ms = to.send;
    req.timeout_recv_ms = to.recv;
    let r = http::execute(&req);

    LOG_MANIFEST_INFO!("Manifest {} status={} gid={} depot={} shape={}",
                       p.name, r.status, gid, depot_id, shape);

    if !r.ok || r.status != 200 { return None; }
    (p.parse)(&r.body)
}

pub fn fetch_manifest_request_code(gid: u64, app_id: u32, depot_id: u32) -> Option<u64> {
    if app_id != 0 && depot_id != 0 && lua_config::has_manifest_code_func_ex() {
        if let Some(code) = lua_config::call_manifest_fetch_code_ex(app_id as u64, depot_id as u64, gid) {
            LOG_MANIFEST_INFO!("Manifest gid={} resolved via fetch_manifest_code_ex", gid);
            return Some(code);
        }
        LOG_MANIFEST_WARN!("Manifest gid={} fetch_manifest_code_ex returned nil, trying fetch_manifest_code", gid);
    }
    if lua_config::has_manifest_code_func() {
        if let Some(code) = lua_config::call_manifest_fetch_code(gid) {
            LOG_MANIFEST_INFO!("Manifest gid={} resolved via manifest.lua", gid);
            return Some(code);
        }
        LOG_MANIFEST_WARN!("Manifest gid={} lua returned nil, falling back to config", gid);
    }
    fetch_active(gid, app_id, depot_id)
}
