//! Manifest code donor. Source: `ManifestDonor.cpp`.
//!
//! Two paths:
//!   * active worker mints codes for owned depots in the wanted list;
//!   * `submit_captured_code` fires on every real download.
//!
//! Both post to `<base>/manifestcode/submit`. The wanted list is fetched
//! from `<base>/manifestwanted`. Both are plain text lines
//! `app:depot:gid` / `depot:gid:code`.

use std::sync::atomic::{AtomicBool, AtomicU32, Ordering};
use std::sync::Mutex;
use std::time::{Duration, Instant};

use crate::bridge;
use crate::platform::http;
use crate::utils::config::config;

const DEFAULT_BASE_URL: &str = "https://manifest.luastools.xyz";

static RUNNING: AtomicBool = AtomicBool::new(false);
static MINTED_THIS_SESSION: AtomicU32 = AtomicU32::new(0);

struct Wanted { app_id: u32, depot_id: u32, gid: u64 }

struct WantedCache {
    items: Vec<Wanted>,
    fetched_at: Option<Instant>,
}

static WANTED: Mutex<Option<WantedCache>> = Mutex::new(None);

fn base_url() -> String {
    let cfg = config::get_donate_settings();
    let mut base = if cfg.url.is_empty() { DEFAULT_BASE_URL.to_string() } else { cfg.url };
    while base.ends_with('/') { base.pop(); }
    base
}

fn parse_wanted_line(line: &str) -> Option<Wanted> {
    let mut it = line.split(':');
    let app: u32 = it.next()?.parse().ok()?;
    let depot: u32 = it.next()?.parse().ok()?;
    let gid: u64 = it.next()?.parse().ok()?;
    if depot == 0 || gid == 0 { return None; }
    Some(Wanted { app_id: app, depot_id: depot, gid })
}

fn fetch_wanted() -> Vec<Wanted> {
    let url = format!("{}/manifestwanted", base_url());
    let mut req = http::Request::new("GET", &url);
    req.timeout_resolve_ms = 5000;
    req.timeout_connect_ms = 5000;
    req.timeout_send_ms = 10000;
    req.timeout_recv_ms = 30000;
    req.max_body_bytes = 32 * 1024 * 1024;

    let r = http::execute(&req);
    if !r.ok || r.status != 200 {
        LOG_MANIFEST_DEBUG!("Donor: wanted list unavailable (ok={} status={})", r.ok, r.status);
        return Vec::new();
    }

    let text = String::from_utf8_lossy(&r.body);
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for line in text.lines() {
        let trimmed = line.trim();
        if trimmed.is_empty() { continue; }
        match parse_wanted_line(trimmed) {
            Some(w) => out.push(w),
            None => LOG_MANIFEST_DEBUG!("Donor: ignoring malformed wanted line \"{}\"", trimmed),
        }
    }
    LOG_MANIFEST_DEBUG!("Donor: {} wanted entr(ies)", out.len());
    out
}

fn submit(body: &str, count: usize) {
    let url = format!("{}/manifestcode/submit", base_url());
    let mut req = http::Request::new("POST", &url);
    req.body = Some(body.as_bytes());
    req.headers = Some("Content-Type: text/plain\r\n");
    let r = http::execute(&req);
    if r.ok && r.status == 200 {
        LOG_MANIFEST_INFO!("Donor: submitted {} code(s)", count);
    } else {
        LOG_MANIFEST_WARN!("Donor: submit failed (ok={} status={}) for {} code(s)",
                           r.ok, r.status, count);
    }
}

fn already_cached(depot: u32, gid: u64) -> bool {
    let url = format!("{}/m/{}/{}", base_url(), depot, gid);
    let mut req = http::Request::new("HEAD", &url);
    req.timeout_resolve_ms = 5000;
    req.timeout_connect_ms = 5000;
    req.timeout_send_ms = 5000;
    req.timeout_recv_ms = 5000;
    let r = http::execute(&req);
    r.ok && r.status == 200
}

fn refresh_wanted_if_stale() {
    let refresh_secs = config::get_donate_settings().wanted_refresh_secs as u64;
    let needs = {
        let g = WANTED.lock().expect("poisoned");
        match g.as_ref() {
            None => true,
            Some(c) => match c.fetched_at {
                None => true,
                Some(t) => t.elapsed() >= Duration::from_secs(refresh_secs),
            },
        }
    };
    if !needs { return; }

    let fresh = fetch_wanted();
    let mut g = WANTED.lock().expect("poisoned");
    if !fresh.is_empty() {
        *g = Some(WantedCache { items: fresh, fetched_at: Some(Instant::now()) });
    } else if g.is_none() {
        *g = Some(WantedCache { items: Vec::new(), fetched_at: Some(Instant::now()) });
    }
}

fn run_cycle() {
    let cfg = config::get_donate_settings();

    // Owned depot set from the hook layer (stubbed today: not ready).
    let owned = bridge::hooks_get_owned_depots();
    if !owned.0 {
        LOG_MANIFEST_DEBUG!("Donor: owned depots not resolved yet, skipping cycle");
        return;
    }
    if cfg.max_mints_per_session != 0
        && MINTED_THIS_SESSION.load(Ordering::Relaxed) >= cfg.max_mints_per_session
    {
        LOG_MANIFEST_DEBUG!("Donor: session cap reached ({}), idle until restart", cfg.max_mints_per_session);
        return;
    }

    refresh_wanted_if_stale();
    let wanted: Vec<Wanted> = {
        let g = WANTED.lock().expect("poisoned");
        g.as_ref().map(|c| c.items.iter().map(|w| Wanted { app_id: w.app_id, depot_id: w.depot_id, gid: w.gid }).collect()).unwrap_or_default()
    };
    if wanted.is_empty() { return; }

    let mut body = String::new();
    let mut submitted: usize = 0;
    let mut skipped: usize = 0;
    let mut refused: usize = 0;
    let mut already: usize = 0;
    let mut minted = false;

    for w in wanted {
        if !RUNNING.load(Ordering::Relaxed) { break; }
        if submitted >= cfg.max_mints_per_cycle as usize { break; }
        if cfg.max_mints_per_session != 0
            && MINTED_THIS_SESSION.load(Ordering::Relaxed) >= cfg.max_mints_per_session { break; }

        if !owned.1.contains(&w.depot_id) { skipped += 1; continue; }
        if already_cached(w.depot_id, w.gid) { already += 1; continue; }

        if minted && cfg.min_mint_interval_ms != 0 {
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(cfg.min_mint_interval_ms as u64));
            if !RUNNING.load(Ordering::Relaxed) { break; }
        }
        minted = true;

        let mut app_id = w.app_id;
        if app_id == 0 {
            if let Some((known_app, _)) = bridge::hooks_lookup_depot(w.depot_id) {
                if known_app != 0 {
                    app_id = known_app;
                    LOG_MANIFEST_DEBUG!("Donor: depot={} app_id 0 -> {}", w.depot_id, app_id);
                }
            }
        }

        let code = bridge::hooks_request_manifest_code(app_id, w.depot_id, w.gid);
        MINTED_THIS_SESSION.fetch_add(1, Ordering::Relaxed);

        if code == 0 { refused += 1; }
        else {
            body.push_str(&format!("{}:{}:{}\n", w.depot_id, w.gid, code));
            submitted += 1;
            LOG_MANIFEST_DEBUG!("Donor: minted depot={} gid={}", w.depot_id, w.gid);
        }
    }

    LOG_MANIFEST_INFO!("Donor: cycle done — {} minted, {} already archived, {} not owned, {} refused by Steam ({} this session)",
                       submitted, already, skipped, refused, MINTED_THIS_SESSION.load(Ordering::Relaxed));

    if submitted > 0 { submit(&body, submitted); }
}

fn worker_main() {
    LOG_MANIFEST_INFO!("Donor: started");
    while RUNNING.load(Ordering::Relaxed) {
        let cfg = config::get_donate_settings();
        if cfg.enabled { run_cycle(); }
        for _ in 0..cfg.interval_secs {
            if !RUNNING.load(Ordering::Relaxed) { break; }
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_secs(1));
        }
    }
    LOG_MANIFEST_INFO!("Donor: stopped");
}

pub fn submit_captured_code(depot_id: u32, gid: u64, code: u64) {
    if depot_id == 0 || gid == 0 || code == 0 { return; }
    if !config::get_donate_settings().enabled { return; }

    std::thread::spawn(move || {
        let body = format!("{}:{}:{}\n", depot_id, gid, code);
        submit(&body, 1);
    });
}

pub fn start() {
    if !config::get_donate_settings().enabled {
        LOG_MANIFEST_INFO!("Donor: disabled by config");
        return;
    }
    if RUNNING.swap(true, Ordering::Relaxed) {
        LOG_MANIFEST_WARN!("Donor: already running");
        return;
    }
    std::thread::Builder::new()
        .name("ost-donor".into())
        .spawn(worker_main)
        .map(|_| ())
        .unwrap_or_else(|_| {
            LOG_MANIFEST_WARN!("Donor: failed to start worker thread");
            RUNNING.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed);
        });
}

pub fn stop() { RUNNING.store(false, Ordering::Relaxed); }

        assert_eq!(w.depot_id, 100);
        assert_eq!(w.gid, 200);

        assert!(parse_wanted_line("1:2").is_none());
        assert!(parse_wanted_line("1:2:x").is_none());
    }
}

//! Delivery mirror chain. Source: `Mirror.cpp`.

use crate::platform::http;

const BASE_TEMPLATES: &[&str] = &[
    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/madoiscool/BetterSteamTools/updates/{path}",
    "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/madoiscool/BetterSteamTools@updates/{path}",
    "https://git.lua.tools/luatools/BetterSteamTools/raw/branch/updates/{path}",
];

fn expand(tmpl: &str, rel_path: &str) -> String {
    tmpl.replace("{path}", rel_path)
}

/// Try each mirror in order; return the first 200 body.
pub fn fetch(rel_path: &str) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
    for (i, tmpl) in BASE_TEMPLATES.iter().enumerate() {
        let url = expand(tmpl, rel_path);
        LOG_INFO!("Mirror: fetching {}", url);

        let mut req = http::Request::new("GET", &url);
        // Raise the body cap: updates carry a multi-MB DLL.
        req.max_body_bytes = 16 * 1024 * 1024;
        let r = http::execute(&req);

        if r.ok && r.status == 200 && !r.body.is_empty() {
            return Some(r.body);
        }

        let tail = if i + 1 < BASE_TEMPLATES.len() { ", trying next" } else { ", no more mirrors" };
        LOG_WARN!("Mirror: {} failed (ok={} HTTP={}){}", url, r.ok, r.status, tail);
    }
    None
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn expand_replaces_path() {
        let u = expand("https://x/{path}", "foo/bar.toml");
        assert_eq!(u, "https://x/foo/bar.toml");
    }
}

//! Pattern loader. Source: `PatternLoader.cpp`.
//!
//! `ModuleHandle` does not implement `Hash`, so the maps are keyed on the
//! raw pointer value as `usize`.

use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};
use std::sync::Mutex;

use crate::platform::dynamic_library::{self, ModuleHandle};
use crate::platform::memory;
use crate::platform::numbers;
use crate::utils::support::fnv::fnv1a_hash;

use super::remote_toml::{self, Request as RtRequest};
use super::steam_diagnostics;

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
struct PatternEntry {
    name: String,
    rva: usize,
    sig: String,
}

type PatternMap = HashMap<u32, PatternEntry>;

static MODULE_MAPS: Mutex<Option<HashMap<usize, PatternMap>>> = Mutex::new(None);
static FAILED_MODULES: Mutex<Option<HashSet<usize>>> = Mutex::new(None);
static MISSING: Mutex<Option<Vec<String>>> = Mutex::new(None);

fn with_maps<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut HashMap<usize, PatternMap>) -> R) -> R {
    let mut g = MODULE_MAPS.lock().expect("poisoned");
    if g.is_none() { *g = Some(HashMap::new()); }
    f(g.as_mut().unwrap())
}
fn with_failed<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut HashSet<usize>) -> R) -> R {
    let mut g = FAILED_MODULES.lock().expect("poisoned");
    if g.is_none() { *g = Some(HashSet::new()); }
    f(g.as_mut().unwrap())
}
fn with_missing<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut Vec<String>) -> R) -> R {
    let mut g = MISSING.lock().expect("poisoned");
    if g.is_none() { *g = Some(Vec::new()); }
    f(g.as_mut().unwrap())
}

fn parse_sig(s: &str) -> Option<(Vec<u8>, Vec<u8>)> {
    let mut bytes = Vec::new();
    let mut mask = Vec::new();
    let b = s.as_bytes();
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < b.len() {
        let c = b[i] as char;
        if c == ' ' || c == '\t' || c == ',' { i += 1; continue; }
        if i + 1 < b.len() && c == '?' && b[i + 1] == b'?' {
            bytes.push(0); mask.push(0); i += 2; continue;
        }
        if i + 1 >= b.len() { return None; }
        let nib = |ch: u8| -> Option<u8> {
            let c = ch as char;
            match c {
                '0'..='9' => Some(c as u8 - b'0'),
                'a'..='f' => Some(c as u8 - b'a' + 10),
                'A'..='F' => Some(c as u8 - b'A' + 10),
                _ => None,
            }
        };
        let h = nib(b[i])?;
        let l = nib(b[i + 1])?;
        bytes.push((h << 4) | l);
        mask.push(1);
        i += 2;
    }
    if bytes.is_empty() { None } else { Some((bytes, mask)) }
}

unsafe fn scan_module(module: ModuleHandle, bytes: &[u8], mask: &[u8]) -> *mut u8 {
    let Some(img) = memory::get_module_image(module) else { return std::ptr::null_mut() };
    if img.size < bytes.len() { return std::ptr::null_mut(); }
    let slice = std::slice::from_raw_parts(img.base as *const u8, img.size);
    let pat_len = bytes.len();
    'outer: for i in 0..=(slice.len() - pat_len) {
        for j in 0..pat_len {
            if mask[j] != 0 && slice[i + j] != bytes[j] { continue 'outer; }
        }
        return img.base.add(i);
    }
    std::ptr::null_mut()
}

fn parse_pattern_toml(body: &str) -> PatternMap {
    let mut map = PatternMap::new();
    let parsed: toml::Value = match toml::from_str(body) { Ok(v) => v, Err(_) => return map };
    let Some(tbl) = parsed.as_table() else { return map };
    for (k, v) in tbl {
        let Some(sub) = v.as_table() else { continue };
        let Some(hash_key) = numbers::parse_hex_u32(k) else { continue };
        let mut entry = PatternEntry::default();
        if let Some(s) = sub.get("name").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) { entry.name = s.into(); }
        if let Some(s) = sub.get("rva").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) {
            if let Some(rva) = numbers::parse_hex_u64(s) { entry.rva = rva as usize; }
        }
        if let Some(s) = sub.get("sig").and_then(|v| v.as_str()) { entry.sig = s.into(); }
        map.insert(hash_key, entry);
    }
    map
}

fn show_download_failed_popup(dll_name: &str, sha: &str, component: &str) {
    steam_diagnostics::show_warning(
        "rusty_tools - Unsupported Steam Version".to_string(),
        format!(
            "rusty_tools: signature file not found for {}.\n\nHooks that depend on {} are disabled for this session; other modules are unaffected.\n\nYou can:\n  1. Wait for the next signature update, then restart Steam.\n  2. Drop a matching TOML at:\n       <Steam>\\rustytools\\pattern\\{}\\{}.toml\n  3. Check upstream:\n       https://github.com/madoiscool/steam-monitor/tree/pattern/{}\n  4. Report the diagnostics below:\n       https://github.com/madoiscool/BetterSteamTools/issues",
            dll_name, dll_name, component, sha, component
        ),
    );
}

pub const PATTERN_CHANNEL: &str = "pattern";

pub fn load(module: ModuleHandle, dll_path: &str, component: &str) -> bool {
    let r = remote_toml::fetch(&RtRequest {
        channel: PATTERN_CHANNEL.into(),
        component: component.into(),
        dll_path: dll_path.into(),
    });

    if r.ok {
        let map = parse_pattern_toml(&r.body);
        if !map.is_empty() {
            LOG_INFO!("PatternLoader: loaded {} patterns for {} ({})",
                      map.len(), component, if r.from_cache { "cache fallback" } else { "remote" });
            with_maps(|m| { m.insert(module.0 as usize, map); });
            return true;
        }
        LOG_WARN!("PatternLoader: TOML for {} parsed empty", component);
    }

    let dll_name = std::path::Path::new(dll_path)
        .file_name().and_then(|s| s.to_str()).unwrap_or("?");
    let sha = if r.sha256.is_empty() { "(hash failed)" } else { &r.sha256 };
    show_download_failed_popup(dll_name, sha, component);
    with_failed(|f| { f.insert(module.0 as usize); });
    false
}

pub fn find_pattern(module: ModuleHandle, func_name: &str) -> *mut std::ffi::c_void {
    let key = module.0 as usize;
    if with_failed(|f| f.contains(&key)) { return std::ptr::null_mut(); }

    let hash_key = fnv1a_hash(func_name);

    let entry = with_maps(|m| {
        let Some(map) = m.get(&key) else { return None };
        map.get(&hash_key).cloned()
    });

    let Some(entry) = entry else {
        // Either Load was never called or there's no entry.
        let loaded = with_maps(|m| m.contains_key(&key));
        if !loaded {
            LOG_WARN!("PatternLoader: FindPattern called for module that was never loaded ('{}')", func_name);
        } else {
            LOG_WARN!("PatternLoader: no entry for '{}' (key=0x{:08X})", func_name, hash_key);
        }
        with_missing(|v| v.push(func_name.to_string()));
        return std::ptr::null_mut();
    };

    if entry.rva != 0 {
        let addr = (module.0 as usize + entry.rva) as *mut std::ffi::c_void;
        LOG_DEBUG!("PatternLoader: {} resolved via RVA 0x{:X}", func_name, entry.rva);
        return addr;
    }

    if !entry.sig.is_empty() {
        if let Some((bytes, mask)) = parse_sig(&entry.sig) {
            let addr = unsafe { scan_module(module, &bytes, &mask) };
            if !addr.is_null() {
                let rva = addr as usize - module.0 as usize;
                LOG_DEBUG!("PatternLoader: {} resolved via sig @ RVA 0x{:X}", func_name, rva);
                return addr as *mut std::ffi::c_void;
            }
            LOG_WARN!("PatternLoader: sig scan miss for '{}'", func_name);
        } else {
            LOG_WARN!("PatternLoader: malformed sig for '{}'", func_name);
        }
    } else {
        LOG_WARN!("PatternLoader: entry for '{}' has neither rva nor sig", func_name);
    }

    with_missing(|v| v.push(func_name.to_string()));
    std::ptr::null_mut()
}

pub fn report_missing_functions() {
    let list = with_missing(|v| std::mem::take(v));
    if list.is_empty() { return; }
    let mut body = String::from("rusty_tools: some functions could not be located.\n\nThe following functions were not found in the signature file:\n");
    for name in &list { body.push_str("  - "); body.push_str(name); body.push('\n'); }
    body.push_str("\nHooks for these functions are disabled for this session.\n\nPlease report this at:\nhttps://github.com/madoiscool/BetterSteamTools/issues");
    steam_diagnostics::show_warning("rusty_tools - Missing Signatures".to_string(), body);
}

===== FILE: src\utils\steam_metadata\remote_toml.rs =====
//! Remote TOML fetch + cache. Source: `RemoteToml.cpp`.

use std::path::PathBuf;

use crate::platform::http;
use crate::utils::config::config;
use super::steam_diagnostics;

pub struct Request {
    pub channel: String,
    pub component: String,
    pub dll_path: String,
}

#[derive(Default)]
pub struct Result {
    pub ok: bool,
    pub from_cache: bool,
    pub body: String,
    pub sha256: String,
}

const DEFAULT_TEMPLATES: &[&str] = &[
    "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/madoiscool/steam-monitor/{channel}/{component}/{sha256}.toml",
    "https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/madoiscool/steam-monitor@{channel}/{component}/{sha256}.toml",
    "https://git.lua.tools/luatools/steam-monitor/raw/branch/{channel}/{component}/{sha256}.toml",
];

fn is_valid_template(t: &str) -> bool {
    t.contains("{channel}") && t.contains("{component}") && t.contains("{sha256}")
}

fn expand(tmpl: &str, req: &Request, sha: &str) -> String {
    tmpl.replace("{channel}", &req.channel)
        .replace("{component}", &req.component)
        .replace("{sha256}", sha)
}

fn build_url_templates() -> Vec<String> {
    let configured = config::get_remote_url_templates();
    if configured.is_empty() {
        return DEFAULT_TEMPLATES.iter().map(|s| s.to_string()).collect();
    }
    let mut out = Vec::new();
    for t in &configured {
        if is_valid_template(t) { out.push(t.clone()); }
        else { LOG_WARN!("RemoteToml: remote.url_template entry missing {{channel}}/{{component}}/{{sha256}}, skipping: {}", t); }
    }
    if out.is_empty() { LOG_WARN!("RemoteToml: no valid remote.url_template entries; remote fetch disabled"); }
    out
}

pub fn fetch(req: &Request) -> Result {
    let mut out = Result::default();

    out.sha256 = steam_diagnostics::sha256_of(&req.dll_path);
    if out.sha256.is_empty() {
        LOG_WARN!("RemoteToml({}/{}): Sha256OfFile failed for {}", req.channel, req.component, req.dll_path);
        return out;
    }
    LOG_INFO!("RemoteToml({}/{}): sha256 = {}", req.channel, req.component, out.sha256);

    let dll_path = PathBuf::from(&req.dll_path);
    let steam_root = dll_path.parent().map(|p| p.to_path_buf()).unwrap_or_default();
    let cache_dir = steam_root.join("rustytools").join(&req.channel).join(&req.component);
    let cache_path = cache_dir.join(format!("{}.toml", out.sha256));

    if let Err(e) = std::fs::create_dir_all(&cache_dir) {
        LOG_WARN!("RemoteToml({}/{}): could not create cache dir {} ({})",
                  req.channel, req.component, cache_dir.display(), e);
    }

    let templates = build_url_templates();
    let mut last_status: u32 = 0;
    let mut last_url = String::new();
    let mut got_body: Option<Vec<u8>> = None;

    for tmpl in &templates {
        let url = expand(tmpl, req, &out.sha256);
        last_url = url.clone();
        LOG_INFO!("RemoteToml({}/{}): downloading {}", req.channel, req.component, url);
        let r = http::execute(&http::Request::new("GET", &url));
        last_status = r.status;
        if r.ok && r.status == 200 { got_body = Some(r.body); break; }
        let tail = if last_url == url { "trying next" } else { "no more mirrors" };
        LOG_WARN!("RemoteToml({}/{}): mirror failed ({} ok={} HTTP={}), {}",
                  req.channel, req.component, url, r.ok, r.status, tail);
    }

    if let Some(body) = got_body {
        if !body.is_empty() {
            if let Err(e) = std::fs::write(&cache_path, &body) {
                LOG_WARN!("RemoteToml({}/{}): could not write {} ({})",
                          req.channel, req.component, cache_path.display(), e);
            } else {
                LOG_INFO!("RemoteToml({}/{}): cached to {}",
                          req.channel, req.component, cache_path.display());
            }
            out.body = String::from_utf8_lossy(&body).into_owned();
            out.ok = true;
            return out;
        }
    }

    if cache_path.exists() {
        LOG_WARN!("RemoteToml({}/{}): remote failed (last URL {} HTTP {}); falling back to local cache {}",
                  req.channel, req.component, last_url, last_status, cache_path.display());
        match std::fs::read_to_string(&cache_path) {
            Ok(buf) if !buf.is_empty() => {
                out.body = buf;
                out.ok = true;
                out.from_cache = true;
                return out;
            }
            Ok(_) => LOG_WARN!("RemoteToml({}/{}): cache file empty: {}",
                               req.channel, req.component, cache_path.display()),
            Err(e) => LOG_WARN!("RemoteToml({}/{}): could not open cache file: {} ({})",
                                req.channel, req.component, cache_path.display(), e),
        }
    }

    LOG_WARN!("RemoteToml({}/{}): no source available (last URL: {} HTTP {})",
              req.channel, req.component, last_url, last_status);
    out
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {

===== FILE: src\utils\steam_metadata\stats_client.rs =====
//! Stats API client. Source: `StatsClient.cpp`.

use std::collections::HashMap;
use std::sync::Mutex;

use crate::platform::http;
use crate::platform::numbers;
use crate::utils::config::config;

static CACHE: Mutex<Option<HashMap<u32, u64>>> = Mutex::new(None);

fn with_cache<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut HashMap<u32, u64>) -> R) -> R {
    let mut g = CACHE.lock().expect("stats cache poisoned");
    if g.is_none() { *g = Some(HashMap::new()); }
    f(g.as_mut().unwrap())
}

pub fn fetch_stat_steam_id(app_id: u32) -> Option<u64> {
    if app_id == 0 { return None; }
    if !config::get_stats_enable_api() {
        LOG_ACHIEVEMENT_DEBUG!("Stats SteamID API disabled for appid={}", app_id);
        return None;
    }

    if let Some(v) = with_cache(|c| c.get(&app_id).copied()) {
        LOG_ACHIEVEMENT_DEBUG!("Stats SteamID API cache hit appid={} steamid={}", app_id, v);
        return Some(v);
    }

    let url = format!("https://stats.opensteamtool.com/{}", app_id);
    let req = http::Request::new("GET", &url);
    let r = http::execute(&req);
    LOG_ACHIEVEMENT_INFO!("Stats SteamID API status={} appid={}", r.status, app_id);

    if !r.ok || r.status != 200 {
        LOG_ACHIEVEMENT_WARN!("Stats SteamID API failed appid={} status={} ok={}", app_id, r.status, r.ok);
        return None;
    }

    let body = match std::str::from_utf8(&r.body) {
        Ok(s) => s,
        Err(_) => {
            LOG_ACHIEVEMENT_WARN!("Stats SteamID API returned non-UTF8 body appid={}", app_id);
            return None;
        }
    };

    let Some(parsed) = numbers::parse_u64(body) else {
        LOG_ACHIEVEMENT_WARN!("Stats SteamID API returned invalid body appid={} bytes={}", app_id, r.body.len());
        return None;
    };
    if parsed == 0 { return None; }

    with_cache(|c| { c.insert(app_id, parsed); });
    LOG_ACHIEVEMENT_INFO!("Stats SteamID API resolved appid={} steamid={}", app_id, parsed);
    Some(parsed)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn zero_app_id_returns_none() {
        assert_eq!(fetch_stat_steam_id(0), None);
    }
}


===== FILE: src\utils\steam_metadata\steam_diagnostics.rs =====
//! Steam client diagnostics captured at init. Source: `SteamDiagnostics.cpp`.

use std::path::Path;
use std::sync::Mutex;

use crate::platform::dynamic_library;
use crate::platform::hash;

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
struct Snapshot {
    opensteamtool_version: String,
    build_id: String,
    steamclient_path: String,
    steamclient_sha256: String,
    steamui_path: String,
    steamui_sha256: String,
}

static SNAPSHOT: Mutex<Option<Snapshot>> = Mutex::new(None);

const UNAVAILABLE: &str = "(unavailable)";

fn detect_steam_build_id() -> String {
    let steam = dynamic_library::get_loaded("steam.exe");
    if steam.is_null() { 
        LOG_WARN!("SteamDiagnostics: steam.exe module not loaded; build id unavailable");
        return UNAVAILABLE.into();
    }
    type GetBootstrapperVersionFn = unsafe extern "system" fn() -> i64;
    let f = unsafe { dynamic_library::get_symbol(steam, "GetBootstrapperVersion") };
    if f.is_null() {
        LOG_WARN!("SteamDiagnostics: steam.exe!GetBootstrapperVersion not exported");
        return UNAVAILABLE.into();
    }
    let f: GetBootstrapperVersionFn = unsafe { std::mem::transmute(f) };
    unsafe { f() }.to_string()
}

fn hash_or_unavailable(path: &str) -> String {
    let h = hash::sha256_of_file(Path::new(path));
    if h.is_empty() { UNAVAILABLE.into() } else { h }
}

pub fn initialize(steamclient_path: &str, steamui_path: &str) {
    let snap = Snapshot {
        opensteamtool_version: crate::VERSION.to_string(),
        build_id: detect_steam_build_id(),
        steamclient_path: steamclient_path.to_string(),
        steamclient_sha256: hash_or_unavailable(steamclient_path),
        steamui_path: steamui_path.to_string(),
        steamui_sha256: hash_or_unavailable(steamui_path),
    };
    LOG_INFO!(
        "SteamDiagnostics: ost.version={} build={} steamclient64.sha256={} steamui.sha256={}",
        snap.opensteamtool_version, snap.build_id,
        snap.steamclient_sha256, snap.steamui_sha256
    );
    *SNAPSHOT.lock().expect("snapshot mutex poisoned") = Some(snap);
}

pub fn sha256_of(path: &str) -> String {
    let g = SNAPSHOT.lock().expect("poisoned");
    if let Some(snap) = g.as_ref() {
        if path == snap.steamclient_path {
            return if snap.steamclient_sha256 == UNAVAILABLE { String::new() } else { snap.steamclient_sha256.clone() };
        }
        if path == snap.steamui_path {
            return if snap.steamui_sha256 == UNAVAILABLE { String::new() } else { snap.steamui_sha256.clone() };
        }
    }
    drop(g);
    hash::sha256_of_file(Path::new(path))
}

pub fn show_warning(title: String, message: String) {
    let full_message = {
        let g = SNAPSHOT.lock().expect("poisoned");
        let base = message;
        match g.as_ref() {
            Some(s) => format!(
                "{}\n\nSteam diagnostics:\n  rusty_tools version: {}\n  Build ID:              {}\n  steamclient64.dll SHA: {}\n  steamui.dll SHA:       {}",
                base, s.opensteamtool_version, s.build_id, s.steamclient_sha256, s.steamui_sha256
            ),
            None => base,
        }
    };
    std::thread::spawn(move || {
        crate::platform::dialog::show_warning(&title, &full_message);
    });
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn sha256_of_unknown_path_hashes_on_demand() {
        // A path we know isn't cached in the snapshot hashes on demand.
        let h = sha256_of("definitely-not-a-real-file-xyz");
        assert_eq!(h, "");
    }
}

//! FNV-1a 32-bit hash. Source: `Utils/Support/FnvHash.h`

/// Compile-time FNV-1a hash of a byte string.
pub const fn fnv1a_hash(s: &str) -> u32 {
    let mut hash: u32 = 0x811c9dc5;
    let bytes = s.as_bytes();
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < bytes.len() {
        hash ^= bytes[i] as u32;
        hash = hash.wrapping_mul(0x01000193);
        i += 1;
    }
    hash
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn known_values() {
        // Empty string hash is the FNV-1a offset basis.
        assert_eq!(fnv1a_hash(""), 0x811c9dc5);
        assert_eq!(fnv1a_hash("a"), 0xe40c292c);
        assert_eq!(fnv1a_hash("foobar"), 0xbf9cf968);
    }

    #[test]
    fn const_evaluable() {
        const H: u32 = fnv1a_hash("BBuildAndAsyncSendFrame");
        // Value taken from the C++ static_assert in PatternLoader.cpp.
        assert_eq!(H, 0x82428E37);
    }
}

//! App ownership / encrypted tickets. Source: `Utils/Tickets/AppTicket.cpp`.

use crate::bridge;
use crate::platform::steam_credential_store as creds;
use crate::utils::config::lua_config;

pub const K_APP_TICKET_STEAMID_OFFSET: u32 = 8;
pub const K_APP_TICKET_APPID_OFFSET: u32 = 16;
pub const K_APP_TICKET_SIGNATURE_SIZE: u32 = 128;

const K_LOCAL_APP_TICKET_SOURCE_APPID: u32 = 7;
const K_STEAMID_TICKET_MINIMUM_SIZE: usize = 16;

#[derive(Copy, Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)]
pub enum AppTicketSource {
    CredentialStoreOnly,
    ForgeOnly,
    CredentialStoreThenForge,
}

#[derive(Clone, Debug)]
pub struct AppOwnershipTicket {
    pub data: Vec<u8>,
    pub total_size: u32,
    pub app_id_offset: u32,
    pub steam_id_offset: u32,
    pub signature_offset: u32,
    pub signature_size: u32,
}

impl Default for AppOwnershipTicket {
    fn default() -> Self {
        Self {
            data: Vec::new(),
            total_size: 0,
            app_id_offset: K_APP_TICKET_APPID_OFFSET,
            steam_id_offset: K_APP_TICKET_STEAMID_OFFSET,
            signature_offset: 0,
            signature_size: K_APP_TICKET_SIGNATURE_SIZE,
        }
    }
}

fn get_steam_id_from_credential_store(app_id: u32) -> u64 {
    match creds::get_steam_id(app_id) {
        Ok(v) => {
            LOG_DEBUG!("GetSpoofSteamID for AppId {}: SteamID credential -> 0x{:X}({})",
                       app_id, v, v);
            v
        }
        Err(status) => {
            LOG_TRACE!("GetSpoofSteamID for AppId {}: SteamID unavailable in credential store ({})",
                       app_id, status.as_str());
            0
        }
    }
}

pub fn get_app_ownership_ticket_from_credential_store(app_id: u32) -> Vec<u8> {
    if !lua_config::has_depot(app_id, true) {
        LOG_DEBUG!("GetAppOwnershipTicketFromCredentialStore for AppId {}: not in addappid, skip", app_id);
        return Vec::new();
    }
    match creds::get_app_ticket(app_id) {
        Ok(ticket) => {
            LOG_INFO!("Successfully retrieved App Ownership Ticket from credential store, AppId: {}, Ticket Size: {}",
                      app_id, ticket.len());
            ticket
        }
        Err(status) => {
            LOG_TRACE!("Read App Ownership Ticket for AppId {}: cached credential unavailable ({})",
                       app_id, status.as_str());
            Vec::new()
        }
    }
}

/// Exploit steamdrmp's off-by-four ticket parsing: take the local source
/// appticket (for app 7), strip its 128-byte signature, insert our 4-byte
/// appid, and re-append the signature.
fn forge_local_app_ownership_ticket(app_id: u32) -> Vec<u8> {
    let source = bridge::hooks_get_cache_app_ownership_ticket(K_LOCAL_APP_TICKET_SOURCE_APPID);
    if source.len() <= K_APP_TICKET_SIGNATURE_SIZE as usize {
        LOG_DEBUG!("ForgeLocalAppOwnershipTicket for AppId {}: no source appticket", app_id);
        return Vec::new();
    }

    let signed_size = source.len() - K_APP_TICKET_SIGNATURE_SIZE as usize;
    let mut ticket = Vec::with_capacity(source.len() + 4);
    ticket.extend_from_slice(&source[..signed_size]);
    ticket.extend_from_slice(&app_id.to_le_bytes());
    ticket.extend_from_slice(&source[signed_size..]);

    LOG_INFO!("Forged App Ownership Ticket, AppId: {}, SourceAppId: {}, Physical Size: {}, Total Size: {}",
              app_id, K_LOCAL_APP_TICKET_SOURCE_APPID, ticket.len(), source.len());
    ticket
}

pub fn get_app_ownership_ticket(app_id: u32, source: AppTicketSource) -> Option<AppOwnershipTicket> {
    if matches!(source, AppTicketSource::CredentialStoreOnly | AppTicketSource::CredentialStoreThenForge) {
        let data = get_app_ownership_ticket_from_credential_store(app_id);
        if !data.is_empty() && data.len() >= 4 {
            let sig_off = u32::from_le_bytes([data[0], data[1], data[2], data[3]]);
            return Some(AppOwnershipTicket {
                total_size: data.len() as u32,
                app_id_offset: K_APP_TICKET_APPID_OFFSET,
                steam_id_offset: K_APP_TICKET_STEAMID_OFFSET,
                signature_offset: sig_off,
                signature_size: K_APP_TICKET_SIGNATURE_SIZE,
                data,
            });
        }
    }
    if matches!(source, AppTicketSource::CredentialStoreOnly) { return None; }

    let data = forge_local_app_ownership_ticket(app_id);
    if data.is_empty() { return None; }

    let total_size = (data.len() - 4) as u32;
    let app_id_offset = total_size - K_APP_TICKET_SIGNATURE_SIZE;
    Some(AppOwnershipTicket {
        total_size,
        app_id_offset,
        steam_id_offset: K_APP_TICKET_STEAMID_OFFSET,
        signature_offset: app_id_offset + 4,
        signature_size: K_APP_TICKET_SIGNATURE_SIZE,
        data,
    })
}

pub fn get_encrypted_ticket_from_credential_store(app_id: u32) -> Vec<u8> {
    if !lua_config::has_depot(app_id, true) {
        LOG_DEBUG!("GetEncryptedTicketFromCredentialStore for AppId {}: not in addappid, skip", app_id);
        return Vec::new();
    }
    match creds::get_e_ticket(app_id) {
        Ok(ticket) => {
            LOG_INFO!("Successfully retrieved Encrypted App Ticket from credential store, AppId: {}, Ticket Size: {}",
                      app_id, ticket.len());
            ticket
        }
        Err(status) => {
            LOG_TRACE!("Read Encrypted App Ticket for AppId {}: cached credential unavailable ({})",
                       app_id, status.as_str());
            Vec::new()
        }
    }
}

pub fn write_app_ownership_ticket(app_id: u32, data: &[u8]) -> bool {
    match creds::write_app_ticket(app_id, data) {
        creds::Status::Ok => {
            LOG_INFO!("Wrote AppTicket for AppId {} ({} bytes)", app_id, data.len());
            true
        }
        s => {
            LOG_ERROR!("Failed to write AppTicket for AppId {} to credential store: {}",
                       app_id, s.as_str());
            false
        }
    }
}

pub fn write_encrypted_ticket(app_id: u32, data: &[u8]) -> bool {
    match creds::write_e_ticket(app_id, data) {
        creds::Status::Ok => {
            LOG_INFO!("Wrote ETicket for AppId {} ({} bytes)", app_id, data.len());
            true
        }
        s => {
            LOG_ERROR!("Failed to write ETicket for AppId {} to credential store: {}",
                       app_id, s.as_str());
            false
        }
    }
}

pub fn write_steam_id(app_id: u32, steam_id: u64) -> bool {
    match creds::write_steam_id(app_id, steam_id) {
        creds::Status::Ok => {
            LOG_INFO!("Wrote SteamID for AppId {} ({})", app_id, steam_id);
            true
        }
        s => {
            LOG_ERROR!("Failed to write SteamID for AppId {} to credential store: {}",
                       app_id, s.as_str());
            false
        }
    }
}

pub fn extract_steam_id_from_ticket_bytes(ticket: &[u8]) -> u64 {
    if ticket.len() < K_STEAMID_TICKET_MINIMUM_SIZE { return 0; }
    // Layout: [u32 Size][u32 Version][u64 SteamID][...].
    // Read bytes [8..16] as little-endian u64. Uses byte-by-byte
    // construction because the Vec's alignment is not guaranteed.
    u64::from_le_bytes([
        ticket[8], ticket[9], ticket[10], ticket[11],
        ticket[12], ticket[13], ticket[14], ticket[15],
    ])
}

pub fn get_spoof_steam_id(app_id: u32) -> u64 {
    if !lua_config::has_depot(app_id, true) {
        LOG_DEBUG!("GetSpoofSteamID for AppId {}: not in addappid, skip spoofing", app_id);
        return 0;
    }
    let credential_steam_id = get_steam_id_from_credential_store(app_id);
    if credential_steam_id != 0 { return credential_steam_id; }

    let ticket = get_app_ownership_ticket_from_credential_store(app_id);
    let steam_id = extract_steam_id_from_ticket_bytes(&ticket);
    if steam_id != 0 {
        LOG_DEBUG!("GetSpoofSteamID for AppId {}: -> 0x{:X}({})", app_id, steam_id, steam_id);
    }
    steam_id
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn extract_steam_id_short_ticket() {
        assert_eq!(extract_steam_id_from_ticket_bytes(&[]), 0);
        assert_eq!(extract_steam_id_from_ticket_bytes(&[0u8; 15]), 0);
    }

    #[test]
    fn extract_steam_id_reads_offset_8() {
        let mut bytes = vec![0u8; 24];
        let id: u64 = 0x1122334455667788;
        bytes[8..16].copy_from_slice(&id.to_le_bytes());
        assert_eq!(extract_steam_id_from_ticket_bytes(&bytes), id);
    }

    #[test]
    fn credential_store_path_extracts_signature_offset() {
        // Simulate a 24-byte ticket whose first u32 says the signature
        // starts at 0x40.
        let mut data = vec![0u8; 24];
        data[0..4].copy_from_slice(&0x40u32.to_le_bytes());
        let sig_off = u32::from_le_bytes([data[0], data[1], data[2], data[3]]);
        assert_eq!(sig_off, 0x40);
    }
}


===== FILE: src\utils\tickets\eticket_client.rs =====
//! On-demand eticket mint. Source: `Utils/Tickets/EticketClient.cpp`.
//!
//! Backend URL resolves in two steps, matching the C++:
//!   1. `seteticketurl()` in the Lua config (runtime override).
//!   2. `option_env!("OST_ETICKET_URL")` — set at build time with
//!      `cargo:rustc-env=OST_ETICKET_URL=...` via `.cargo/config.toml`
//!      or the environment.
//!
//! Empty in both cases means the feature is off and no network call is
//! ever made.

use std::collections::{HashMap, HashSet};
use std::sync::Mutex;

use crate::platform::http;
use crate::utils::config::lua_config;

const K_RESOLVE_MS: u32 = 2000;
const K_CONNECT_MS: u32 = 2000;
const K_SEND_MS:    u32 = 3000;
const K_RECV_MS:    u32 = 8000;

#[derive(Clone, Debug, Default)]
struct CachedTickets {
    eticket: Vec<u8>,
    ownership: Vec<u8>,
    steam_id: u64,
}

#[derive(Default)]
struct Cache {
    tickets: HashMap<u32, CachedTickets>,
    no_owner_apps: HashSet<u32>,
}

static CACHE: Mutex<Option<Cache>> = Mutex::new(None);

fn with_cache<R>(f: impl FnOnce(&mut Cache) -> R) -> R {
    let mut g = CACHE.lock().expect("eticket cache poisoned");
    if g.is_none() { *g = Some(Cache::default()); }
    f(g.as_mut().unwrap())
}

fn eticket_url() -> String {
    let configured = lua_config::get_eticket_url();
    if !configured.is_empty() { return configured; }
    option_env!("OST_ETICKET_URL").unwrap_or("").to_string()
}

fn to_hex(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
    const DIGITS: &[u8; 16] = b"0123456789ABCDEF";
    let mut out = String::with_capacity(bytes.len() * 2);
    for &b in bytes {
        out.push(DIGITS[(b >> 4) as usize] as char);
        out.push(DIGITS[(b & 0x0F) as usize] as char);
    }
    out
}

fn hex_nibble(c: u8) -> Option<u8> {
    match c {
        b'0'..=b'9' => Some(c - b'0'),
        b'a'..=b'f' => Some(c - b'a' + 10),
        b'A'..=b'F' => Some(c - b'A' + 10),
        _ => None,
    }
}

fn from_hex(hex: &str) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
    if hex.is_empty() || hex.len() % 2 != 0 { return None; }
    let b = hex.as_bytes();
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(b.len() / 2);
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < b.len() {
        let hi = hex_nibble(b[i])?;
        let lo = hex_nibble(b[i + 1])?;
        out.push((hi << 4) | lo);
        i += 2;
    }
    Some(out)
}

/// Extract a string field ("key":"VALUE") from the backend's flat JSON.
/// Returns false when the key is absent, its value is null, or the
/// value is empty.
fn extract_string_field(body: &str, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let needle = format!("\"{}\"", key);
    let k = body.find(&needle)?;
    let colon = body[k + needle.len()..].find(':')? + k + needle.len();
    let q1 = body[colon + 1..].find('"')? + colon + 1;
    // A null value has no opening quote before the next delimiter.
    if let Some(delim) = body[colon + 1..].find(|c| c == ',' || c == '}') {
        if q1 > colon + 1 + delim { return None; }
    }
    let q2 = body[q1 + 1..].find('"')? + q1 + 1;
    let v = &body[q1 + 1..q2];
    if v.is_empty() { None } else { Some(v.to_string()) }
}

/// Ensure a mint has been attempted for `app_id`. On success, copies
/// the cached tickets into `out`.
///
/// Returns false if the feature is disabled, the backend refused, or
/// the response was unusable. On "no owning account" (a 409 without
/// `foreign_account:true`), marks the app as sticky-no-owner for the
/// session.
fn ensure_fetched(
    app_id: u32,
    nonce: &[u8],
    existing_steam_id: u64,
    out: &mut CachedTickets,
) -> bool {
    if eticket_url().is_empty() { return false; }

    {
        let cached = with_cache(|c| {
            if c.no_owner_apps.contains(&app_id) { return None; }
            c.tickets.get(&app_id).cloned()
        });
        if let Some(hit) = cached {
            // Evict if the registry's current account differs from the
            // cached one.
            let cached_id = hit.steam_id;
            if existing_steam_id != 0 && cached_id != 0 && cached_id != existing_steam_id {
                LOG_IPC_DEBUG!("EticketClient: appid={} registry SteamID={} differs from cached SteamID={} — evicting stale cache entry and re-minting",
                               app_id, existing_steam_id, cached_id);
                with_cache(|c| { c.tickets.remove(&app_id); });
            } else {
                *out = hit;
                return true;
            }
        }
        // If we didn't early-return, either the entry was evicted or
        // never existed. The `no_owner_apps` check ran inside the
        // closure above; if it returned None with no cached entry, we
        // might still be blocked.
        let blocked = with_cache(|c| c.no_owner_apps.contains(&app_id));
        if blocked { return false; }
    }

    let nonce_hex = to_hex(nonce);
    let mut req_body = format!("{{\"app_id\":\"{}\",\"nonce\":\"{}\"", app_id, nonce_hex);
    if existing_steam_id != 0 {
        req_body.push_str(&format!(",\"existing_steam_id\":\"{}\"", existing_steam_id));
    }
    req_body.push('}');

    let url = eticket_url();
    let mut req = http::Request::new("POST", &url);
    req.body = Some(req_body.as_bytes());
    req.headers = Some("Content-Type: application/json\r\n");
    req.timeout_resolve_ms = K_RESOLVE_MS;
    req.timeout_connect_ms = K_CONNECT_MS;
    req.timeout_send_ms    = K_SEND_MS;
    req.timeout_recv_ms    = K_RECV_MS;

    let r = http::execute(&req);

    if !r.ok {
        LOG_IPC_WARN!("EticketClient: on-demand fetch failed appid={} status={} ok={} (fallback to credential store)",
                      app_id, r.status, r.ok);
        return false;
    }

    let body_str = String::from_utf8_lossy(&r.body).into_owned();

    if r.status == 409 {
        if body_str.contains("\"foreign_account\":true") {
            LOG_IPC_DEBUG!("EticketClient: appid={} existing ticket belongs to an account outside our pool — skipping on-demand override for this launch",
                           app_id);
        } else {
            with_cache(|c| { c.no_owner_apps.insert(app_id); });
            LOG_IPC_DEBUG!("EticketClient: appid={} no owning account in pool — skipping on-demand for this session",
                           app_id);
        }
        return false;
    }

    if r.status != 200 {
        LOG_IPC_WARN!("EticketClient: on-demand fetch failed appid={} status={} ok={} (fallback to credential store)",
                      app_id, r.status, r.ok);
        return false;
    }

    let mut fetched = CachedTickets::default();
    if let Some(hex) = extract_string_field(&body_str, "eticket") {
        if let Some(bytes) = from_hex(&hex) { fetched.eticket = bytes; }
    }
    if let Some(hex) = extract_string_field(&body_str, "appticket") {
        if let Some(bytes) = from_hex(&hex) { fetched.ownership = bytes; }
    }
    if fetched.eticket.is_empty() && fetched.ownership.is_empty() {
        LOG_IPC_WARN!("EticketClient: backend returned no usable tickets appid={} bytes={}",
                      app_id, r.body.len());
        return false;
    }
    if let Some(sid) = extract_string_field(&body_str, "steam_id") {
        fetched.steam_id = sid.parse::<u64>().unwrap_or(0);
    }

    with_cache(|c| { c.tickets.insert(app_id, fetched.clone()); });
    LOG_IPC_INFO!("EticketClient: minted appid={} eticket_bytes={} ownership_bytes={} nonce_bytes={}",
                  app_id, fetched.eticket.len(), fetched.ownership.len(), nonce.len());
    *out = fetched;
    true
}

pub fn fetch_fresh_eticket(app_id: u32, nonce: &[u8], existing_steam_id: u64) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
    let mut t = CachedTickets::default();
    if !ensure_fetched(app_id, nonce, existing_steam_id, &mut t) || t.eticket.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    Some(t.eticket)
}

pub fn fetch_ownership_ticket(app_id: u32, nonce: &[u8], existing_steam_id: u64) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
    let mut t = CachedTickets::default();
    if !ensure_fetched(app_id, nonce, existing_steam_id, &mut t) || t.ownership.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }
    Some(t.ownership)
}

===== FILE: src\utils\tickets\legacy_cd_key.rs =====
//! Legacy CD-key resolution. Source: `Utils/Tickets/LegacyCDKey.cpp`.

use crate::utils::config::lua_config;
use crate::utils::support::fnv::fnv1a_hash;

const ALPHABET: &[u8; 32] = b"0123456789ABCDEFGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ";

fn synthesize(app_id: u32, account_id: u32) -> String {
    let seed_a = format!("{}:{}", app_id, account_id);
    let seed_b = format!("OST:{}:{}", account_id, app_id);

    let mut bits: u64 = ((fnv1a_hash(&seed_a) as u64) << 32) | fnv1a_hash(&seed_b) as u64;

    let mut key = String::with_capacity(19);
    for i in 0..16 {
        if i != 0 && i % 4 == 0 { key.push('-'); }
        key.push(ALPHABET[(bits & 31) as usize] as char);
        bits = (bits >> 4) | (bits << 60);
    }
    key
}

/// Resolve a legacy CD key for a managed app.
///
/// `None` means "not an app we manage" — callers must let Steam's real
/// flow run. `Some` means we have a value to serve (either a user
/// override or a synthesized one).
pub fn resolve(app_id: u32, account_id: u32) -> Option<String> {
    if !lua_config::has_depot(app_id, true) {
        LOG_TRACE!("LegacyCDKey: appId={} not managed, passing through", app_id);
        return None;
    }
    if let Some(override_) = lua_config::get_legacy_cd_key(app_id) {
        LOG_INFO!("LegacyCDKey: appId={} -> override", app_id);
        return Some(override_);
    }
    let synth = synthesize(app_id, account_id);
    LOG_INFO!("LegacyCDKey: appId={} -> synthesised {}", app_id, synth);
    Some(synth)
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::*;

    #[test]
    fn synthesize_shape() {
        let k = synthesize(1234567, 99999);
        // 16 alphabet chars + 3 dashes
        assert_eq!(k.len(), 19);
        assert_eq!(&k[4..5], "-");
        assert_eq!(&k[9..10], "-");
        assert_eq!(&k[14..15], "-");
    }

    #[test]
    fn synthesize_is_deterministic() {
        let a = synthesize(100, 200);
        let b = synthesize(100, 200);
        assert_eq!(a, b);
    }

    #[test]
    fn synthesize_differs_by_app() {
        assert_ne!(synthesize(100, 200), synthesize(101, 200));
    }

    #[test]
    fn synthesize_differs_by_account() {
        assert_ne!(synthesize(100, 200), synthesize(100, 201));
    }

    #[test]
    fn synthesize_alphabet_is_crockford() {
        let k = synthesize(1, 1);
        for c in k.chars() {
            if c == '-' { continue; }
            assert!(ALPHABET.contains(&(c as u8)), "char {} not in alphabet", c);
        }
    }
}

===== FILE: src\utils\tokeer\bridge.rs =====
//! Tokeer code-redemption bridge. Source: `TokeerBridge.cpp`.
//!
//! Two entry points: `handle_uri` (called from the rundll32 handler) and
//! `register_uri_scheme` (called once at startup to install the scheme
//! under HKCU so `bst://...` launches this DLL).
//!
//! The server URL is resolved from `option_env!("OST_TOKEER_URL")`. The
//! C++ defaulted to `https://luastools.xyz` when nothing was configured
//! at build time; we do the same. Set `OST_TOKEER_URL` at build time to
//! point at a different host.

use crate::platform::dialog;
use crate::platform::http;
use crate::platform::numbers;
use crate::platform::steam_credential_store as creds;

const DEFAULT_TOKEER_URL: &str = "https://luastools.xyz";

fn tokeer_base_url() -> String {
    let mut url = option_env!("OST_TOKEER_URL").unwrap_or(DEFAULT_TOKEER_URL).to_string();
    while url.ends_with('/') { url.pop(); }
    url
}

fn hex_nibble(c: u8) -> Option<u8> {
    match c {
        b'0'..=b'9' => Some(c - b'0'),
        b'a'..=b'f' => Some(c - b'a' + 10),
        b'A'..=b'F' => Some(c - b'A' + 10),
        _ => None,
    }
}

fn hex_to_bytes(hex: &str) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
    if hex.is_empty() || hex.len() % 2 != 0 { return None; }
    let b = hex.as_bytes();
    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(b.len() / 2);
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < b.len() {
        let hi = hex_nibble(b[i])?;
        let lo = hex_nibble(b[i + 1])?;
        out.push((hi << 4) | lo);
        i += 2;
    }
    Some(out)
}

/// Extract a string field ("key":"VALUE") from the server's flat JSON.
/// Returns None when the key is absent, or when the value is null /
/// missing (no opening quote before the next delimiter).
fn json_string(body: &str, key: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let needle = format!("\"{}\"", key);
    let k = body.find(&needle)?;
    let colon = body[k + needle.len()..].find(':')? + k + needle.len();
    let q1 = body[colon + 1..].find('"')? + colon + 1;
    if let Some(delim) = body[colon + 1..].find(|c| c == ',' || c == '}') {
        if q1 > colon + 1 + delim { return None; }
    }
    let q2 = body[q1 + 1..].find('"')? + q1 + 1;
    Some(body[q1 + 1..q2].to_string())
}

fn json_true(body: &str, key: &str) -> bool {
    let needle = format!("\"{}\"", key);
    let Some(k) = body.find(&needle) else { return false; };
    let Some(colon) = body[k + needle.len()..].find(':') else { return false; };
    let after = colon + k + needle.len() + 1;
    let rest = &body[after..];
    let first_nonspace = rest.find(|c: char| c != ' ' && c != '\t').unwrap_or(rest.len());
    rest[first_nonspace..].starts_with("true")
}

/// POST the code to `<base>/drm/redeem`, write the returned tickets to the
/// credential store, then prompt the user to launch the game.
pub fn redeem(code: &str) {
    let url = format!("{}/drm/redeem", tokeer_base_url());
    let req_body = format!("{{\"code\":\"{}\"}}", code);

    let mut req = http::Request::new("POST", &url);
    req.body = Some(req_body.as_bytes());
    req.headers = Some("Content-Type: application/json\r\n");
    req.timeout_resolve_ms = 5000;
    req.timeout_connect_ms = 5000;
    req.timeout_send_ms    = 10000;
    req.timeout_recv_ms    = 20000;
    req.max_body_bytes     = 4 * 1024 * 1024;
    let r = http::execute(&req);

    let body_str = String::from_utf8_lossy(&r.body).into_owned();

    if !r.ok || r.status != 200 || !json_true(&body_str, "success") {
        let reason = json_string(&body_str, "reason")
            .or_else(|| json_string(&body_str, "error"))
            .unwrap_or_else(|| format!("Server error {}", r.status));
        LOG_WARN!("TokeerBridge: redeem failed (HTTP {}): {}", r.status, reason);
        dialog::show_warning("BetterSteamTools", &format!("Redeem failed:\n\n{}", reason));
        return;
    }

    let app_id_str = json_string(&body_str, "app_id").unwrap_or_default();
    let app_hex    = json_string(&body_str, "appticket").unwrap_or_default();
    let et_hex     = json_string(&body_str, "eticket").unwrap_or_default();

    let app_id = match numbers::parse_u32(&app_id_str) {
        Some(v) => v,
        None => {
            LOG_WARN!("TokeerBridge: redeem returned an incomplete/invalid ticket");
            dialog::show_warning("BetterSteamTools", "The server returned an incomplete ticket.");
            return;
        }
    };
    let app_bytes = match hex_to_bytes(&app_hex) {
        Some(v) if !v.is_empty() => v,
        _ => {
            LOG_WARN!("TokeerBridge: redeem returned an incomplete/invalid ticket");
            dialog::show_warning("BetterSteamTools", "The server returned an incomplete ticket.");
            return;
        }
    };
    let et_bytes = match hex_to_bytes(&et_hex) {
        Some(v) if !v.is_empty() => v,
        _ => {
            LOG_WARN!("TokeerBridge: redeem returned an incomplete/invalid ticket");
            dialog::show_warning("BetterSteamTools", "The server returned an incomplete ticket.");
            return;
        }
    };

    if creds::write_app_ticket(app_id, &app_bytes) != creds::Status::Ok
        || creds::write_e_ticket(app_id, &et_bytes) != creds::Status::Ok
    {
        LOG_ERROR!("TokeerBridge: failed to write tickets for app {}", app_id);
        dialog::show_warning("BetterSteamTools", "Could not write the ticket to Steam.");
        return;
    }

    LOG_INFO!("TokeerBridge: redeemed code for app {} ({} + {} bytes)",
              app_id, app_bytes.len(), et_bytes.len());

    let launch = dialog::show_confirm(
        "Code Redeemed!",
        &format!("Added app {} to your library.\n\nLaunch it now?", app_id),
    );
    if launch {
        let steam_url = format!("steam://rungameid/{}", app_id);
        LOG_INFO!("TokeerBridge: launching app {} via {}", app_id, steam_url);
        #[cfg(windows)]
        unsafe {
            // ShellExecuteA wants a NUL-terminated string.
            let op = b"open\0";
            let mut url = steam_url.into_bytes();
            url.push(0);
            windows_sys::Win32::UI::Shell::ShellExecuteA(
                std::ptr::null_mut(),
                op.as_ptr() as *const u8,
                url.as_ptr() as *const u8,
                std::ptr::null(),
                std::ptr::null(),
                windows_sys::Win32::UI::WindowsAndMessaging::SW_SHOWNORMAL,
            );
        }
    }
}

/// Parse and dispatch a `bst://<action>/<arg>` URL. Unknown actions are
/// logged and ignored. Called from the exported `TokeerUri` handler.
pub fn handle_uri(raw_url: &str) {
    LOG_INFO!("TokeerBridge: handle_uri raw='{}'", raw_url);

    // rundll32 does its own command-line parsing and leaves quotes in
    // place. Strip a single wrapping pair plus incidental whitespace.
    let mut url = raw_url.trim().to_string();
    if url.len() >= 2 {
        let bytes = url.as_bytes();
        let (first, last) = (bytes[0], bytes[bytes.len() - 1]);
        if (first == b'"' && last == b'"') || (first == b'\'' && last == b'\'') {
            url = url[1..url.len() - 1].to_string();
        }
    }

    let prefix = "bst://";
    if !url.starts_with(prefix) {
        LOG_WARN!("TokeerBridge: ignoring non-bst URL (cleaned='{}')", url);
        return;
    }
    let mut rest = url[prefix.len()..].to_string();
    while rest.ends_with(|c| c == '/' || c == '\r' || c == '\n' || c == ' ') {
        rest.pop();
    }

    let (action, arg) = match rest.find('/') {
        Some(i) => (&rest[..i], &rest[i + 1..]),
        None    => (rest.as_str(), ""),
    };

    if action == "redeem" {
        if arg.is_empty() {
            dialog::show_warning("BetterSteamTools", "Missing code in link.");
        } else {
            redeem(arg);
        }
    } else {
        LOG_WARN!("TokeerBridge: unknown action '{}'", action);
    }
}

/// Register the `bst://` URI scheme under HKCU pointing at this DLL via
/// rundll32. Safe to call on every startup; rewrites only if the target
/// changed.
pub fn register_uri_scheme(dll_path: &str) {
    #[cfg(windows)]
    {
        use windows_sys::Win32::System::Registry::{
            RegCreateKeyExA, RegSetValueExA, HKEY_CURRENT_USER, KEY_SET_VALUE,
        };
        let command = format!("rundll32.exe \"{}\",TokeerUri \"%1\"", dll_path);
        let write_key = |sub: &str, value_name: Option<&str>, value: &str| -> bool {
            LOG_INFO!("[wf] register_uri_scheme: write_key sub='{}' name={:?}", sub, value_name);
            let mut key: *mut std::ffi::c_void = std::ptr::null_mut();
            let sub_c = std::ffi::CString::new(sub).unwrap();
                        LOG_INFO!("[wf] register_uri_scheme: RegCreateKeyExA enter sub='{}'", sub);
let s = unsafe {
                RegCreateKeyExA(
                    HKEY_CURRENT_USER,
                    sub_c.as_ptr() as *const u8,
                    0, std::ptr::null(), 0,
                    KEY_SET_VALUE, std::ptr::null(),
                    &mut key, std::ptr::null_mut(),
                )
            };
            if s != 0 { return false; }
            let vn_c = value_name.map(|n| std::ffi::CString::new(n).unwrap());
            let vn_ptr = vn_c.as_ref().map(|c| c.as_ptr() as *const u8).unwrap_or(std::ptr::null());
            let bytes = value.as_bytes();
            let s2 = unsafe {
                RegSetValueExA(
                    key, vn_ptr, 0, 1 /* REG_SZ */,
                    bytes.as_ptr(), (bytes.len() + 1) as u32,
                )
            };
            unsafe { windows_sys::Win32::System::Registry::RegCloseKey(key); }
            s2 == 0
        };
        LOG_INFO!("[wf] register_uri_scheme: call 1/3 (default value)");
        let ok1 = write_key("Software\\Classes\\bst", None, "URL:BetterSteamTools");
        LOG_INFO!("[wf] register_uri_scheme: call 1/3 returned {}", ok1);
        LOG_INFO!("[wf] register_uri_scheme: call 2/3 (URL Protocol)");
        let ok2 = ok1 && write_key("Software\\Classes\\bst", Some("URL Protocol"), "");
        LOG_INFO!("[wf] register_uri_scheme: call 2/3 returned {}", ok2);
        LOG_INFO!("[wf] register_uri_scheme: call 3/3 (shell\\open\\command)");
        let ok3 = ok2 && write_key("Software\\Classes\\bst\\shell\\open\\command", None, &command);
        LOG_INFO!("[wf] register_uri_scheme: call 3/3 returned {}", ok3);
        let ok = ok3;
        if ok {
            LOG_INFO!("TokeerBridge: registered bst:// scheme -> {}", command);
        } else {
            LOG_WARN!("TokeerBridge: failed to register bst:// scheme");
        }
    }
    #[cfg(not(windows))]
    { let _ = dll_path; }
}

===== FILE: src\utils\tokeer\uri.rs =====
//! `rundll32` entry point for `bst://` URI handling.
//!
//! Registered by [`super::bridge::register_uri_scheme`] as:
//! ```text
//!   rundll32.exe "<steam>\OpenSteamTool.dll",TokeerUri "%1"
//! ```
//! When the OS launches this, it runs in a short-lived rundll32 process,
//! **not** steam.exe. The DLL's injection init never runs here, so this
//! function must be self-contained.
//!
//! The C++ version initialises logging against this DLL's own directory
//! before dispatching. In Rust, log initialisation requires a
//! `ModuleHandle`, and computing the module containing an arbitrary
//! function requires `GetModuleHandleExW`. We skip that for now and let
//! logging init be a no-op (or fall through to the default sink, if any
//! has been installed).
//!
//! ## Type of the export
//!
//! Windows `CALLBACK` is `__stdcall`; on x64 that is the same as every
//! other convention, so `extern "system"` (which maps to `__stdcall` on
//! 32-bit Windows and the platform ABI on 64-bit) is correct here.

use super::bridge;

#[cfg(windows)]
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "system" fn TokeerUri(
    _hwnd: *mut std::ffi::c_void,
    _hinst: *mut std::ffi::c_void,
    cmd_line: *const i8,
    _show_cmd: i32,
) {
    let raw = if cmd_line.is_null() {
        String::new()
    } else {
        unsafe {
            let mut len = 0;
            while *cmd_line.add(len) != 0 { len += 1; }
            let bytes = std::slice::from_raw_parts(cmd_line as *const u8, len);
            String::from_utf8_lossy(bytes).into_owned()
        }
    };
    bridge::handle_uri(&raw);
}

/// Non-Windows fallback so the symbol exists on every target.
#[cfg(not(windows))]
#[no_mangle]
pub extern "C" fn TokeerUri(_a: *mut std::ffi::c_void, _b: *mut std::ffi::c_void, _c: *const i8, _d: i32) {
}


===== FILE: STUBS.md =====
# Stub Tracker

Single source of truth for "what is fake." Update when a stub becomes
real or a new one is introduced.

As of Batch 09b, every code path in the port executes its real
implementation. The only remaining items are a small set of
intentional behavioural divergences from the C++, and a set of C++
sources that were deliberately left unported.

---

## Cross-module bridges -- `src/bridge.rs`

`bridge.rs` exists to break dependency cycles between early batches and
later ones: it lets a module in batch N call into a function that lands
in batch N+1 without the call site having to change. Every entry in
this table now delegates to its real implementation.

| Function | Delegates to |
|---|---|
| `manifest_set_provider` | `utils::steam_metadata::manifest_client::set_provider` |
| `manifest_active_provider_name` | `utils::steam_metadata::manifest_client::active_provider_name` |
| `stats_fetch_stat_steam_id` | `utils::steam_metadata::stats_client::fetch_stat_steam_id` |
| `appticket_write_ownership_ticket` | `utils::tickets::app_ticket::write_app_ownership_ticket` |
| `appticket_write_encrypted_ticket` | `utils::tickets::app_ticket::write_encrypted_ticket` |
| `hooks_notify_license_changed` | `hook::package::notify_license_changed` |
| `hooks_probe_manifest` | `hook::netpacket::probe_manifest` |
| `hooks_get_owned_depots` | `hook::package::get_owned_depots` |

| `cloud_sync_app_set` | `utils::cloud_redirect::host::sync_app_set` |

The table is retained as a map of what `bridge.rs` routes where,
because the file is otherwise silent about it. If a future batch
introduces a new stub, add a row.

---

## Deliberately not ported

These were in the C++ codebase but are being skipped for the initial
Rust port. They are all optional or non-critical-path. Revisit if the
scope changes.

| C++ source | Why skipped |
|---|---|
| `Utils/Update/AppUpdater.cpp` | Self-updater for the injected DLL. Fully guarded by `#ifdef OST_ENABLE_UPDATER` in the C++ and never on the critical path for hook functionality. Would need to redeclare `OPENSTEAMTOOL_VERSION` at Rust build time. |
| `Utils/CloudRedirect/...` self-updater pieces | Same reasoning as `AppUpdater`. |
| `Utils/Tokeer/...` clipboard interaction | The C++ `TokeerUri` comment mentions clipboard work but the implementation only uses `ShellExecuteA` plus registry. Nothing to skip. |

---

## Known behavioural divergences

Not stubs -- the code path executes -- but a feature is intentionally
incomplete compared to the C++. These are the items to revisit if the
scope changes.

| Site | Behaviour | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `hook::steamui::BuildCompleteAppOverviewChange` | Installs and passes through. The C++ re-injects removed `removed_appid` entries into the freshly-rebuilt overview so a full library rebuild does not resurrect a removed game. | The C++ calls Steam's protobuf `RepeatedField<uint32>::Add` helper against a message created by the C++ protobuf runtime. prost uses a different in-memory layout for `repeated uint32`, so the same helper cannot be called against prost types. Fix path: resolve `RepeatedFieldUint32_Add` via PatternLoader and call it from Rust with a pointer to whatever Steam hands us. |
| `hook::misc` `GetOrAddAppData` | Not installed. | The install line is commented out in the C++, and the C++ body has a `// TODO: find a more robust way` note. Preserved as a comment in the Rust file. |
| `hook::keyvalues` `install` | Not called from the framework orchestrator. | `HookManager.cpp` calls `Hooks_KeyValues::Install()` in a commented line; the Rust `framework.rs` matches. The module itself is real and works if called. |
| `steam::ipc_facades` | Hand-written, not generated. | The C++ build generates `IPCMessages.gen.h` from `Steam/IPCMessages.steamd` via a small tool. Only `IClientUser` and `IClientUtils` are used by the hook layer, so the Rust side hand-writes just those. A `.steamd`-driven generator would be over-engineering for the current scope. |

---

## How to audit

Search for the strings `stub`, `not ported`, `deferred`, `TODO`, and
`FIXME` across `src/`. Anything a reader finds should be either in one
of the tables above or a false positive (a word used in a comment).

===== FILE: tools\extract_tickets\src\main.rs =====
//! extract_tickets - dump the AppTicket and ETicket hex strings for a
//! given Steam AppID.
//!
//! Standalone; runs in its own process, NOT injected. Reads the Steam
//! install path from `HKCU\Software\Valve\Steam\SteamPath` (32-bit
//! view), loads `steamclient64.dll` from that directory, opens a pipe
//! to the running Steam client, and asks it for the two tickets
//! associated with an AppID.
//!
//! Output goes into `<appid>/` relative to the current working
//! directory:
//!   * `appticket.bin` - raw ownership ticket bytes (if present)
//!   * `eticket.bin`   - raw encrypted app ticket bytes (if present)
//!   * `tickets.txt`   - plain-text hex strings for setAppTicket /
//!                       setETicket
//!
//! ## C++ ABI
//!
//! Steamworks is a C++ API: each interface is a vtable of function
//! pointers, laid out in declaration order. Rust models this as a
//! `#[repr(C)]` struct whose only field is `*const VTable`, plus a
//! `#[repr(C)]` vtable struct of `extern "system"` fn pointers. On x64
//! Windows every calling convention collapses to the platform ABI, so
//! `extern "system"` is correct for the C++ `__cdecl` Steamworks uses
//! on x86.

#![allow(non_snake_case)]
#![allow(non_camel_case_types)]

#[cfg(not(windows))]
fn main() -> std::process::ExitCode {
    eprintln!("extract_tickets must be built for Windows x64.");
    std::process::ExitCode::from(1)
}

#[cfg(windows)]
fn main() -> std::process::ExitCode {
    win::run()
}

#[cfg(windows)]
mod win {
