    // ── Registry helper ─────────────────────────────────────────────

    fn read_hkcu_sz_32(sub_key: &str, value_name: &str) -> Option<String> {
        let sub: Vec<u16> = sub_key.encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect();
        let vn: Vec<u16> = value_name.encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect();

        let mut hkey: HKEY = std::ptr::null_mut();
        let sam: u32 = KEY_READ | KEY_WOW64_32KEY;
        let status = unsafe { RegOpenKeyExW(HKEY_CURRENT_USER, sub.as_ptr(), 0, sam, &mut hkey) };
        if status != 0 { return None; }

        unsafe {
            let mut value_type: u32 = 0;
            let mut value_size: u32 = 0;
            let s1 = RegQueryValueExW(
                hkey, vn.as_ptr(), std::ptr::null(),
                &mut value_type, std::ptr::null_mut(), &mut value_size,
            );
            if s1 != 0 || value_type != REG_SZ || value_size < 2 {
                RegCloseKey(hkey);
                return None;
            }
            let mut buf = vec![0u8; value_size as usize];
            let mut fetched = value_size;
            let s2 = RegQueryValueExW(
                hkey, vn.as_ptr(), std::ptr::null(),
                std::ptr::null_mut(), buf.as_mut_ptr(), &mut fetched,
            );
            RegCloseKey(hkey);
            if s2 != 0 { return None; }
            buf.truncate(fetched as usize);
            if buf.len() >= 2 && buf[buf.len() - 2] == 0 && buf[buf.len() - 1] == 0 {
                buf.truncate(buf.len() - 2);
            }
            let units: Vec<u16> = buf.chunks_exact(2)
                .map(|c| u16::from_le_bytes([c[0], c[1]]))
                .collect();
            String::from_utf16(&units).ok()
        }
    }

    // ── Load + setup ────────────────────────────────────────────────

    fn load_steam_client() -> Option<(*mut c_void, PathBuf)> {
        let steam_path = read_hkcu_sz_32("Software\\Valve\\Steam", "SteamPath");
        let Some(steam_path) = steam_path else {
            eprintln!("Failed to find Steam install path in registry.");
            return None;
        };
        println!("Found SteamPath in HKEY_CURRENT_USER: {steam_path}");

        let dll_path = Path::new(&steam_path).join("steamclient64.dll");
        let wide: Vec<u16> = dll_path.as_os_str().encode_wide()
            .chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect();

        let module = unsafe {
            LoadLibraryExW(wide.as_ptr(), std::ptr::null_mut(), LOAD_WITH_ALTERED_SEARCH_PATH)
        };
        if module.is_null() {
            let e = unsafe { windows_sys::Win32::Foundation::GetLastError() };
            eprintln!("Failed to load {} (GetLastError={e}).", dll_path.display());
            return None;
        }
        Some((module as *mut c_void, dll_path))
    }

    unsafe fn create_steam_client(module: *mut c_void) -> Option<*mut ISteamClient> {
        let name = b"CreateInterface\0";
        let raw = GetProcAddress(module as _, name.as_ptr());
        let Some(f) = raw else {
            eprintln!("steamclient64.dll has no CreateInterface export.");
            return None;
        };
        let create_interface: unsafe extern "system" fn(*const i8, *mut i32) -> *mut c_void =
            std::mem::transmute(f);

        let mut return_code: i32 = 0;
        let client = create_interface(STEAM_CLIENT_VERSION.as_ptr() as *const i8, &mut return_code);
        if client.is_null() {
            eprintln!("CreateInterface(SteamClient023) failed (returnCode={return_code}).");
            return None;
        }
        Some(client as *mut ISteamClient)
    }

    // ── Ticket extraction ───────────────────────────────────────────

    unsafe fn extract_app_ownership_ticket(
        client: *mut ISteamClient, pipe: HSteamPipe, user: HSteamUser, app_id: u32,
    ) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
        let app_ticket = client_get_generic(
            client, user, pipe, STEAM_APP_TICKET_VERSION.as_ptr() as *const i8,
        ) as *mut ISteamAppTicket;
        if app_ticket.is_null() {
            eprintln!("GetISteamGenericInterface(STEAMAPPTICKET_INTERFACE_VERSION001) returned null.");
            return None;
        }

        let mut buf = vec![0u8; 2048];
        let mut app_id_off: u32 = 0;
        let mut steam_id_off: u32 = 0;
        let mut sig_off: u32 = 0;
        let mut sig_size: u32 = 0;
        let written = appticket_get_data(
            app_ticket, app_id,
            buf.as_mut_ptr() as *mut c_void, buf.len() as u32,
            &mut app_id_off, &mut steam_id_off, &mut sig_off, &mut sig_size,
        );
        if written == 0 || written as usize > buf.len() {
            eprintln!(
                "GetAppOwnershipTicketData returned no ticket for AppID {app_id} \
                 (own the app and have it cached locally?)."
            );
            return None;
        }
        buf.truncate(written as usize);
        println!(
            "Ownership ticket {written} bytes (appIdOffset={app_id_off} \
             steamIdOffset={steam_id_off} signatureOffset={sig_off} signatureSize={sig_size})"
        );
        Some(buf)
    }

    unsafe fn extract_encrypted_app_ticket(
        client: *mut ISteamClient, pipe: HSteamPipe, user: HSteamUser, app_id: u32,
    ) -> Option<Vec<u8>> {
        let utils = client_get_utils(client, pipe, STEAM_UTILS_VERSION.as_ptr() as *const i8);
        let steam_user = client_get_user(client, user, pipe, STEAM_USER_VERSION.as_ptr() as *const i8);
        if utils.is_null() || steam_user.is_null() {
            eprintln!("GetISteamUtils/GetISteamUser returned null.");
            return None;
        }

        let call = user_request_encrypted_app_ticket(steam_user, std::ptr::null_mut(), 0);
        if call == 0 {
            eprintln!("RequestEncryptedAppTicket failed to start for AppID {app_id}.");
            return None;
        }

        let start = Instant::now();
        let mut failed: Bool = 0;
        loop {
            if utils_is_api_call_completed(utils, call, &mut failed) != 0 { break; }
            if start.elapsed() >= Duration::from_millis(POLL_MAX_MS) {
                eprintln!("Timed out waiting for EncryptedAppTicketResponse_t.");
                return None;
            }
            std::thread::sleep(Duration::from_millis(POLL_STEP_MS));
        }

        let mut eresult: i32 = 0;
        failed = 0;
        let got = utils_get_api_call_result(
            utils, call,
            &mut eresult as *mut i32 as *mut c_void,
            std::mem::size_of::<i32>() as i32,
            K_ENCRYPTED_APP_TICKET_CALLBACK,
            &mut failed,
        );
        if got == 0 || failed != 0 {
            eprintln!("GetAPICallResult failed for EncryptedAppTicketResponse_t.");
            return None;
        }
        if eresult != K_ERESULT_OK {
            eprintln!("RequestEncryptedAppTicket returned EResult {eresult}.");
            return None;
        }

        let mut cb_ticket: u32 = 0;
        user_get_encrypted_app_ticket(steam_user, std::ptr::null_mut(), 0, &mut cb_ticket);
        if cb_ticket == 0 {
            eprintln!("Encrypted app ticket is empty.");
            return None;
        }
        let mut buf = vec![0u8; cb_ticket as usize];
        if user_get_encrypted_app_ticket(
            steam_user, buf.as_mut_ptr() as *mut c_void,
            buf.len() as i32, &mut cb_ticket,
        ) == 0 {
            eprintln!("GetEncryptedAppTicket failed.");
            return None;
        }
        buf.truncate(cb_ticket as usize);
        println!("Encrypted ticket {cb_ticket} bytes");
        Some(buf)
    }

    // ── Output ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    fn to_hex_lower(bytes: &[u8]) -> String {
        const HEX: &[u8; 16] = b"0123456789abcdef";
        let mut out = String::with_capacity(bytes.len() * 2);
        for &b in bytes {
            out.push(HEX[(b >> 4) as usize] as char);
            out.push(HEX[(b & 0x0F) as usize] as char);
        }
        out
    }

    fn print_hex(label: &str, data: &[u8]) {
        println!("{label} ({} bytes):", data.len());
        const BYTES_PER_ROW: usize = 16;
        const HEX: &[u8; 16] = b"0123456789abcdef";
        let mut row = 0;
        while row < data.len() {
            let mut line = String::new();
            for shift in (0..=12).step_by(4) {
                let nibble = ((row as u32) >> (12 - shift)) & 0xF;
                line.push(HEX[nibble as usize] as char);
            }
            line.push_str("  ");
            let mut ascii = String::new();
            for col in 0..BYTES_PER_ROW {
                if row + col < data.len() {
                    let byte = data[row + col];
                    line.push(HEX[(byte >> 4) as usize] as char);
                    line.push(HEX[(byte & 0x0F) as usize] as char);
                    line.push(' ');
                    ascii.push(if (0x20..0x7F).contains(&byte) { byte as char } else { '.' });
                } else {
                    line.push_str("   ");
                }
                if col == 7 { line.push(' '); }
            }
            println!("{line} {ascii}");
            row += BYTES_PER_ROW;
        }
    }

    fn ticket_line(name: &str, ticket: Option<&[u8]>) -> String {
        match ticket {
            None => format!("{name}:null\n"),
            Some(bytes) => format!("{name}({}bytes):{}\n", bytes.len(), to_hex_lower(bytes)),
        }
    }

    fn write_outputs(app_id: u32, ownership: Option<&[u8]>, encrypted: Option<&[u8]>) -> bool {
        let dir = PathBuf::from(app_id.to_string());
        if let Err(e) = std::fs::create_dir_all(&dir) {
            eprintln!("Failed to create directory {} ({e}).", dir.display());
            return false;
        }
        let mut ok = true;
        if let Some(b) = ownership {
            let p = dir.join("appticket.bin");
            if let Err(e) = std::fs::write(&p, b) {
                eprintln!("Failed to write {} ({e}).", p.display());
                ok = false;
            }
        }
        if let Some(b) = encrypted {
            let p = dir.join("eticket.bin");
            if let Err(e) = std::fs::write(&p, b) {
                eprintln!("Failed to write {} ({e}).", p.display());
                ok = false;
            }
        }
        let text = format!(
            "appid:{app_id}\n{}{}",
            ticket_line("appticket", ownership),
            ticket_line("eticket", encrypted),
        );
        let summary = dir.join("tickets.txt");
        match std::fs::write(&summary, text) {
            Ok(()) => println!("Wrote {}\\", dir.display()),
            Err(e) => {
                eprintln!("Failed to write {} ({e}).", summary.display());
                ok = false;
            }
        }
        ok
    }

    // ── AppID parsing ───────────────────────────────────────────────

    fn parse_app_id(s: &str) -> Option<u32> {
        if s.is_empty() { return None; }
        if !s.bytes().all(|b| b.is_ascii_digit()) { return None; }
        s.parse::<u32>().ok()
    }

    // ── Entry point ─────────────────────────────────────────────────

    pub fn run() -> ExitCode {
        let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().skip(1).collect();
        let app_id = if let Some(a) = args.first() {
            match parse_app_id(a) {
                Some(id) => id,
                None => { eprintln!("Invalid AppID: {a}"); return ExitCode::from(1); }
            }
        } else {
            print!("AppID: ");
            let _ = std::io::stdout().flush();
            let mut line = String::new();
            if std::io::stdin().read_line(&mut line).is_err() {
                eprintln!("Invalid AppID.");
                return ExitCode::from(1);
            }
            match parse_app_id(line.trim()) {
                Some(id) => id,
                None => { eprintln!("Invalid AppID."); return ExitCode::from(1); }
            }
        };

        let id_c = format!("{app_id}\0");
        unsafe {
            SetEnvironmentVariableA(b"SteamAppId\0".as_ptr(), id_c.as_ptr());
            SetEnvironmentVariableA(b"SteamGameId\0".as_ptr(), id_c.as_ptr());
        }

        let Some((module, dll_path)) = load_steam_client() else {
            return pause_and(ExitCode::from(1));
        };
        println!("Loaded {}", dll_path.display());

        let Some(client) = (unsafe { create_steam_client(module) }) else {
            unsafe { FreeLibrary(module as _); }
            return pause_and(ExitCode::from(1));
        };

        let pipe = unsafe { client_create_pipe(client) };
        if pipe == 0 {
            eprintln!("CreateSteamPipe failed. Is Steam running?");
            unsafe { FreeLibrary(module as _); }
            return pause_and(ExitCode::from(1));
        }
        let user = unsafe { client_connect_global(client, pipe) };
        if user == 0 {
            eprintln!("ConnectToGlobalUser failed. Is a user logged in?");
            unsafe {
                client_release_pipe(client, pipe);
                FreeLibrary(module as _);
            }
            return pause_and(ExitCode::from(1));
        }

        let utils = unsafe { client_get_utils(client, pipe, STEAM_UTILS_VERSION.as_ptr() as *const i8) };
        if !utils.is_null() {
            let universe = unsafe { utils_universe(utils) };
            let client_app_id = unsafe { utils_app_id(utils) };
            println!("ConnectedUniverse={universe} ClientAppID={client_app_id}");
        }

        let ownership = unsafe { extract_app_ownership_ticket(client, pipe, user, app_id) };
        if let Some(b) = &ownership { print_hex("Ownership ticket", b); }

        let encrypted = unsafe { extract_encrypted_app_ticket(client, pipe, user, app_id) };
        if let Some(b) = &encrypted { print_hex("Encrypted ticket", b); }

        let ok = write_outputs(app_id, ownership.as_deref(), encrypted.as_deref());

        unsafe {
            client_release_pipe(client, pipe);
            FreeLibrary(module as _);
        }

        pause_and(if ok { ExitCode::SUCCESS } else { ExitCode::from(1) })
    }

    fn pause_and(code: ExitCode) -> ExitCode {
        if std::io::stdin().is_terminal() {
            print!("\nPress Enter to exit...");
            let _ = std::io::stdout().flush();
            let mut s = String::new();
            let _ = std::io::stdin().read_line(&mut s);
        }
        code
    }

    #[cfg(test)]
    mod tests {
        use super::*;

        #[test] fn parse_app_id_accepts_decimal() {
            assert_eq!(parse_app_id("730"), Some(730));
            assert_eq!(parse_app_id("0"), Some(0));
            assert_eq!(parse_app_id("4294967295"), Some(u32::MAX));
        }

        #[test] fn parse_app_id_rejects_invalid() {
            assert_eq!(parse_app_id(""), None);
            assert_eq!(parse_app_id("-1"), None);
            assert_eq!(parse_app_id("+1"), None);
            assert_eq!(parse_app_id("abc"), None);
            assert_eq!(parse_app_id("1.5"), None);
            assert_eq!(parse_app_id("4294967296"), None);
        }

        #[test] fn to_hex_lower_round_trips() {
            assert_eq!(to_hex_lower(&[0x00, 0xFF, 0x10]), "00ff10");
            assert_eq!(to_hex_lower(&[]), "");
        }

        #[test] fn ticket_line_null_when_absent() {
            assert_eq!(ticket_line("appticket", None), "appticket:null\n");
        }

        #[test] fn ticket_line_hex_when_present() {
            assert_eq!(
                ticket_line("eticket", Some(&[0xDE, 0xAD])),
                "eticket(2bytes):dead\n"
            );
        }
    }
}


===== FILE: xinput1_4_proxy\build.rs =====
//! Emits the linker /DEF: directive for the xinput1_4 export table.
//!
//! Unlike dwmapi, this proxy defines real wrapper functions; the .def
//! assigns each of them to a specific ordinal (and marks the six
//! undocumented ordinals NONAME). The ordinals match the real
//! `%WINDIR%\System32\xinput1_4.dll` export table so import-by-ordinal
//! callers (Steam Big Picture reads the guide button via ordinal 100)
//! resolve to our wrapper.

use std::env;
use std::path::PathBuf;

fn main() {
    if env::var("CARGO_CFG_TARGET_OS").as_deref() != Ok("windows") {
        return;
    }

    let manifest_dir = PathBuf::from(env::var("CARGO_MANIFEST_DIR").unwrap());
    let def = manifest_dir.join("xinput1_4.def");

    if !def.exists() {
        panic!(
            "xinput1_4.def not found at {}.\n\
             The proxy DLL cannot be built without its ordinal table.",
            def.display()
        );
    }

    println!("cargo:rerun-if-changed=xinput1_4.def");
    println!("cargo:rustc-cdylib-link-arg=/DEF:{}", def.display());
}

===== FILE: xinput1_4_proxy\src\lib.rs =====
//! xinput1_4.dll loader-hijack proxy.
//!
//! Placed next to `steam.exe`, this DLL is loaded in preference to the
//! system `%WINDIR%\System32\xinput1_4.dll`. Every export forwards to the
//! real DLL, which is loaded lazily on first call so a missing XInput
//! runtime on the host does not fail the proxy load.
//!
//! Wrapper functions exist (unlike the dwmapi proxy) because the real DLL
//! exposes undocumented ordinals — most notably 100, `XInputGetStateEx`,
//! which includes the guide-button state. Steam Big Picture reads the
//! guide button through that ordinal, so the proxy must forward it
//! explicitly. The ordinals are assigned by `xinput1_4.def`.
//!
//! `DllMain` additionally loads `RustyTools.dll` when the host is
//! `steam.exe`, exactly as the dwmapi proxy does.

#![allow(non_snake_case)]
#![allow(non_camel_case_types)]

#[cfg(not(windows))]
mod stub {}

#[cfg(windows)]
mod win {
    use std::ffi::c_void;
    use std::sync::OnceLock;
    use windows_sys::Win32::Foundation::ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED;
    use windows_sys::Win32::System::LibraryLoader::{
        DisableThreadLibraryCalls, GetModuleFileNameA, GetProcAddress, LoadLibraryA,
        LoadLibraryW,
    };
    use windows_sys::Win32::System::SystemInformation::GetSystemDirectoryW;

    const DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH: u32 = 1;
    const DLL_PROCESS_DETACH: u32 = 0;

    // ── Resolved real-DLL function pointer types ──────────────────────
    // Signatures copy from the C++ source verbatim. `WINAPI` / `CALLBACK`
    // is `extern "system"`; DWORD is `u32`, BYTE is `u8`, BOOL is `i32`,
    // LPWSTR is `*mut u16`, UINT is `u32`, UINT* is `*mut u32`.

    type GetState_t           = unsafe extern "system" fn(u32, *mut c_void) -> u32;
    type SetState_t           = unsafe extern "system" fn(u32, *mut c_void) -> u32;
    type GetCapabilities_t    = unsafe extern "system" fn(u32, u32, *mut c_void) -> u32;
    type Enable_t             = unsafe extern "system" fn(i32);
    type GetAudioDeviceIds_t  = unsafe extern "system" fn(u32, *mut u16, *mut u32, *mut u16, *mut u32) -> u32;
    type GetBatteryInfo_t     = unsafe extern "system" fn(u32, u8, *mut c_void) -> u32;
    type GetKeystroke_t       = unsafe extern "system" fn(u32, u32, *mut c_void) -> u32;

    struct RealXInput {
        _module: *mut c_void,
        get_state: Option<GetState_t>,
        set_state: Option<SetState_t>,
        get_capabilities: Option<GetCapabilities_t>,
        enable: Option<Enable_t>,
        get_audio_device_ids: Option<GetAudioDeviceIds_t>,
        get_battery_information: Option<GetBatteryInfo_t>,
        get_keystroke: Option<GetKeystroke_t>,
        // Ordinal-only slots. The proxy calls through these but never
        // exports them under a name.
        ord_100: *mut c_void, // XInputGetStateEx - guide button
        ord_101: *mut c_void, // XInputWaitForGuideButton
        ord_102: *mut c_void, // XInputCancelGuideButtonWait
        ord_103: *mut c_void, // XInputPowerOffController
        ord_104: *mut c_void, // XInputGetBaseBusInformation
        ord_108: *mut c_void, // XInputGetAudioDeviceIdsEx
    }

    // The real module handle is process-global; the pointers are opaque and
    // never freed. `OnceLock` serialises the one-time load and hands every
    // later caller a shared reference.
    unsafe impl Send for RealXInput {}
    unsafe impl Sync for RealXInput {}

    static REAL: OnceLock<Option<RealXInput>> = OnceLock::new();

    /// Return the resolved real XInput, loading it on first use. `None` when
    /// the system library is missing or none of the expected exports resolve
    /// — every wrapper falls back to `ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED` in that case
    /// without panicking.
    fn real() -> Option<&'static RealXInput> {
        REAL.get_or_init(load_real_xinput).as_ref()
    }

    fn to_wide(path: &str) -> Vec<u16> {
        path.encode_utf16().chain(std::iter::once(0)).collect()
    }

    fn system_directory() -> Option<String> {
        let mut buf = [0u16; 260];
        let n = unsafe { GetSystemDirectoryW(buf.as_mut_ptr(), buf.len() as u32) };
        if n == 0 || (n as usize) >= buf.len() {
            return None;
        }
        Some(String::from_utf16_lossy(&buf[..n as usize]))
    }

    /// Resolve an export by name. Returns `None` when the symbol is absent
    /// — treated as "this build does not support it", not an error.
    unsafe fn resolve_named<T: Copy>(module: *mut c_void, name: &str) -> Option<T> {
        let cname = std::ffi::CString::new(name).ok()?;
        let p = GetProcAddress(module, cname.as_ptr() as *const u8);
        match p {
            Some(f) => Some(std::mem::transmute_copy(&(f as *mut c_void))),
            None => None,
        }
    }

    /// Resolve an export by ordinal. `GetProcAddress` treats an integer
    /// cast into the name pointer as an ordinal lookup; anything below
    /// 0x10000 is unambiguously an ordinal because no real module exports
    /// a string that would fit in that range.
    unsafe fn resolve_ordinal(module: *mut c_void, ordinal: u16) -> *mut c_void {
        let p = ordinal as usize as *const u8;
        match GetProcAddress(module, p) {
            Some(f) => f as *mut c_void,
            None => std::ptr::null_mut(),
        }
    }

    fn load_real_xinput() -> Option<RealXInput> {
        let sysdir = system_directory()?;
        let path = format!("{}\\xinput1_4.dll", sysdir);
        let wide = to_wide(&path);

        let module = unsafe { LoadLibraryW(wide.as_ptr()) };
        if module.is_null() {
            return None;
        }

        unsafe {
            Some(RealXInput {
                _module: module,
                get_state: resolve_named(module, "XInputGetState"),
                set_state: resolve_named(module, "XInputSetState"),
                get_capabilities: resolve_named(module, "XInputGetCapabilities"),
                enable: resolve_named(module, "XInputEnable"),
                get_audio_device_ids: resolve_named(module, "XInputGetAudioDeviceIds"),
                get_battery_information: resolve_named(module, "XInputGetBatteryInformation"),
                get_keystroke: resolve_named(module, "XInputGetKeystroke"),
                ord_100: resolve_ordinal(module, 100),
                ord_101: resolve_ordinal(module, 101),
                ord_102: resolve_ordinal(module, 102),
                ord_103: resolve_ordinal(module, 103),
                ord_104: resolve_ordinal(module, 104),
                ord_108: resolve_ordinal(module, 108),
            })
        }
    }

    // ── Named exports ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Each wrapper forwards to the resolved real function, or returns
    // ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED (1167) if the real library or the export
    // is unavailable. Never panics.

    #[no_mangle]
    pub unsafe extern "system" fn XInputGetState(dwUserIndex: u32, pState: *mut c_void) -> u32 {
        let Some(r) = real() else { return ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED };
        match r.get_state {
            Some(f) => f(dwUserIndex, pState),
            None => ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED,
        }
    }

    #[no_mangle]
    pub unsafe extern "system" fn XInputSetState(dwUserIndex: u32, pVibration: *mut c_void) -> u32 {
        let Some(r) = real() else { return ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED };
        match r.set_state {
            Some(f) => f(dwUserIndex, pVibration),
            None => ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED,
        }
    }

    #[no_mangle]
    pub unsafe extern "system" fn XInputGetCapabilities(dwUserIndex: u32, dwFlags: u32, pCapabilities: *mut c_void) -> u32 {
        let Some(r) = real() else { return ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED };
        match r.get_capabilities {
            Some(f) => f(dwUserIndex, dwFlags, pCapabilities),
            None => ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED,
        }
    }

    #[no_mangle]
    pub unsafe extern "system" fn XInputEnable(enable: i32) {
        let Some(r) = real() else { return };
        if let Some(f) = r.enable {
            f(enable);
        }
    }

    #[no_mangle]
    pub unsafe extern "system" fn XInputGetAudioDeviceIds(
        dwUserIndex: u32,
        pRenderDeviceId: *mut u16,
        pRenderCount: *mut u32,
        pCaptureDeviceId: *mut u16,
        pCaptureCount: *mut u32,
    ) -> u32 {
        let Some(r) = real() else { return ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED };
        match r.get_audio_device_ids {
            Some(f) => f(dwUserIndex, pRenderDeviceId, pRenderCount, pCaptureDeviceId, pCaptureCount),
            None => ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED,
        }
    }

    #[no_mangle]
    pub unsafe extern "system" fn XInputGetBatteryInformation(dwUserIndex: u32, devType: u8, pBatteryInformation: *mut c_void) -> u32 {
        let Some(r) = real() else { return ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED };
        match r.get_battery_information {
            Some(f) => f(dwUserIndex, devType, pBatteryInformation),
            None => ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED,
        }
    }

    #[no_mangle]
    pub unsafe extern "system" fn XInputGetKeystroke(dwUserIndex: u32, dwReserved: u32, pKeystroke: *mut c_void) -> u32 {
        let Some(r) = real() else { return ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED };
        match r.get_keystroke {
            Some(f) => f(dwUserIndex, dwReserved, pKeystroke),
            None => ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED,
        }
    }

    // ── Ordinal-only exports ──────────────────────────────────────────
    // Named XInputOrdinalNNN in Rust; the .def exports them at their true
    // ordinals with NONAME so no symbol name leaks.

    #[no_mangle]
    pub unsafe extern "system" fn XInputOrdinal100(a1: u32, a2: *mut c_void) -> u32 {
        let Some(r) = real() else { return ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED };
        if r.ord_100.is_null() { return ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED }
        let f: GetState_t = std::mem::transmute(r.ord_100);
        f(a1, a2)
    }

    #[no_mangle]
    pub unsafe extern "system" fn XInputOrdinal101(a1: u32, a2: u32, a3: *mut c_void) -> u32 {
        let Some(r) = real() else { return ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED };
        if r.ord_101.is_null() { return ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED }
        let f: unsafe extern "system" fn(u32, u32, *mut c_void) -> u32 = std::mem::transmute(r.ord_101);
        f(a1, a2, a3)
    }

    #[no_mangle]
    pub unsafe extern "system" fn XInputOrdinal102(a1: u32) -> u32 {
        let Some(r) = real() else { return ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED };
        if r.ord_102.is_null() { return ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED }
        let f: unsafe extern "system" fn(u32) -> u32 = std::mem::transmute(r.ord_102);
        f(a1)
    }

    #[no_mangle]
    pub unsafe extern "system" fn XInputOrdinal103(a1: u32) -> u32 {
        let Some(r) = real() else { return ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED };
        if r.ord_103.is_null() { return ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED }
        let f: unsafe extern "system" fn(u32) -> u32 = std::mem::transmute(r.ord_103);
        f(a1)
    }

    #[no_mangle]
    pub unsafe extern "system" fn XInputOrdinal104(a1: u32, a2: *mut c_void) -> u32 {
        let Some(r) = real() else { return ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED };
        if r.ord_104.is_null() { return ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED }
        let f: unsafe extern "system" fn(u32, *mut c_void) -> u32 = std::mem::transmute(r.ord_104);
        f(a1, a2)
    }

    #[no_mangle]
    pub unsafe extern "system" fn XInputOrdinal108(
        a1: u32, a2: *mut c_void, a3: *mut c_void, a4: *mut c_void, a5: *mut c_void,
    ) -> u32 {
        let Some(r) = real() else { return ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED };
        if r.ord_108.is_null() { return ERROR_DEVICE_NOT_CONNECTED }
        let f: unsafe extern "system" fn(u32, *mut c_void, *mut c_void, *mut c_void, *mut c_void) -> u32 =
            std::mem::transmute(r.ord_108);
        f(a1, a2, a3, a4, a5)
    }

    // ── Injection ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    // Only steam.exe gets RustyTools.dll loaded. Same rule as the dwmapi
    // proxy; identical body on purpose so the two proxies read the same.

    fn is_steam_host() -> bool {
        let mut buf = [0u8; 260];
        let n = unsafe {
            GetModuleFileNameA(std::ptr::null_mut(), buf.as_mut_ptr(), buf.len() as u32)
        };
        if n == 0 { return false; }
        let path = &buf[..n as usize];
        let name_start = path.iter().rposition(|&b| b == b'\\').map(|i| i + 1).unwrap_or(0);
        let name = &path[name_start..];
        name.eq_ignore_ascii_case(b"steam.exe")
    }

    fn rustytools_load() -> bool {
        if !is_steam_host() { return true; }
        let name = b"RustyTools.dll\0";
        !unsafe { LoadLibraryA(name.as_ptr()) }.is_null()
    }

    #[no_mangle]
    pub unsafe extern "system" fn DllMain(
        hmodule: *mut c_void,
        reason: u32,
        _reserved: *mut c_void,
    ) -> i32 {
        match reason {
            DLL_PROCESS_ATTACH => {
                DisableThreadLibraryCalls(hmodule);
                // EAGER LOAD IN DllMain: matches the C++ behaviour. The
                // real XInput DLL is loaded here rather than lazily on
                // first wrapper call. Lazy load was a Rust-port
                // divergence intended to avoid loader-lock re-entrancy;
                // it turned out to cause a different, worse re-entrancy
                // when steamwebhelper's Chromium UI calls XInputGetState
                // from a context close to the loader.
                let _ = real();
                if !rustytools_load() {
                    return 0; // FALSE
                }
            }
            DLL_PROCESS_DETACH => {}
            _ => {}
        }
        1 // TRUE
    }
}


===== FILE: xinput1_4_proxy\xinput1_4.def =====
; xinput1_4.def - export table for the xinput1_4.dll loader-hijack proxy.
;
; Ordinals and names mirror the real %WINDIR%\System32\xinput1_4.dll so
; callers that import by ordinal (notably Steam Big Picture, which reads
; the guide-button state via XInputGetStateEx at ordinal 100) resolve to
; our wrapper. NONAME on the six undocumented ordinals keeps their export
; table name-less, as on the system DLL.

LIBRARY "xinput1_4"
EXPORTS
    XInputEnable @5
    XInputGetAudioDeviceIds @10
    XInputGetBatteryInformation @7
    XInputGetCapabilities @4
    XInputGetKeystroke @8
    XInputGetState @2
    XInputSetState @3
    XInputOrdinal100 @100 NONAME
    XInputOrdinal101 @101 NONAME
